title: Future Jobs in Informational Crisis Management: A Hybrid Foresight based on Consumer Behavior Dynamics and Organizational Competencies
affiliations: Mansoura University, Mansoura University, Mansoura University and

detail.title: Future Jobs in Informational Crisis Management: A Hybrid Foresight based on Consumer Behavior Dynamics and Organizational Competencies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Academic Journal of Social Sciences, volume 2, issue 2, 2026[10.21608/ajsc.2026.509699]

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study aims to anticipate and identify future job roles in marketing and human resource management through a quantitative analysis of complex interactions between consumer behavior (misinformation, FOMO, panic buying) and employee behavior (creative leadership, crisis management). 
The study adopts a hybrid methodological framework (SOBC-H) integrating Neutrosophic logic, fuzzy logic, artificial neural networks (ANN), and agent-based modeling (ABM).
Methodology: Data was derived from two previous research projects, collecting consumer data (N=637) and leader data (N=384) via electronic questionnaires. A Neutrosophic methodology was applied to transform Likert responses into triads (T, I, F), with the corresponding equations documented. Path analysis (SEM) was conducted to test direct and indirect effects, and moderation analysis was conducted to test the moderating role of misinformation. Two artificial neural networks were built to predict panic buying and crisis management efficiency, followed by ABM simulation across six functional scenarios.
Findings: Results revealed a substantial cognitive stability gap, with leaders showing a Deneutrosophicated weight (D=0.55) compared to consumers (D=0.50-0.53), reflecting a state of complete indeterminacy among consumers toward panic buying. Path analysis showed that the indirect effect of misinformation via FOMO (β=0.4399, p<0.001) is substantially stronger than its direct effect (β=0.0783, p=0.046). Moderation analysis revealed a significant interaction effect (β=0.0973, p=0.010). The ANN achieved R²=0.325 in predicting panic buying, while the creative leadership model achieved R²=0.860 in explaining crisis management efficiency. ABM simulation showed that synergy among the four proposed job roles achieves containment efficiency of up to 95% under ideal simulation conditions. Originality/Value: The research introduces the SOBC-H framework integrating behavioral profiling with computer simulation, with complete documentation of Neutrosophic transformation equations, and proposes four future job roles requiring technical (Python, SQL) and interactive (Digital Emotional Intelligence) competencies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合模糊逻辑、神经网络和基于Agent的建模等方法，量化分析消费者行为（ misinformation、FOMO、恐慌性购买）与员工行为（创造性领导力、危机管理）之间的复杂互动，预测并识别市场营销与人力资源管理领域的未来工作岗位角色。研究发现领导者的认知稳定性显著高于消费者，信息误传通过FOMO的间接效应远强于其直接效应，并提出四种未来工作岗位角色，在理想模拟条件下协同可实现高达95%的遏制效率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过量化分析消费者行为与员工行为之间的复杂互动，预测和识别市场营销与人力资源管理领域未来的工作岗位角色？
AI.motivation: 在信息误传、FOMO和恐慌性购买等消费者行为与创造性领导力、危机管理等员工行为日益复杂交互的背景下，传统方法难以预测未来岗位需求，亟需创新的方法论框架来识别未来工作岗位角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: SOBC-H混合框架（整合中性逻辑、模糊逻辑、人工神经网络和基于Agent的建模）；中性逻辑模糊化方法；路径分析（结构方程模型）；调节效应分析。
AI.method: 采用SOBC-H混合方法论框架，数据来自两个前期研究项目（消费者N=637，领导者N=384）；使用中性逻辑将Likert量表转化为三元组（T, I, F）；进行路径分析（SEM）检验直接和间接效应及调节效应；构建两个人工神经网络分别预测恐慌性购买和危机管理效率；进行基于Agent的建模（ABM）模拟六个功能场景。
AI.findings: 领导者去中性化权重（D=0.55）高于消费者（D=0.50-0.53），表明消费者对恐慌性购买处于完全不确定状态；信息误传通过FOMO的间接效应（β=0.4399, p<0.001）远强于直接效应（β=0.0783, p=0.046）；调节效应显著（β=0.0973, p=0.010）；恐慌性购买预测ANN的R²=0.325，创造性领导力模型R²=0.860；ABM模拟显示四种岗位角色协同可实现高达95%的遏制效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SOBC-H框架，将行为画像与计算机模拟整合；完整记录中性逻辑转化方程；揭示了信息误传通过FOMO影响恐慌性购买的间接机制远强于直接机制；量化了领导者与消费者之间的认知稳定性差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了四种未来工作岗位角色，并明确了所需技术能力（Python、SQL）和互动能力（数字情商），为企业人才规划和岗位设计提供了可操作的建议。

title: The Impact of Social Media Reels on Gen Z Travel Decisions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Social Media Reels on Gen Z Travel Decisions
detail.abstract: As a recent high school graduate, I started paying attention to how my friends and I actually decide where to go on vacation. We don't look at travel brochures or TV commercials; we just scroll through TikTok and Instagram. This study explores how short-form videos, or reels, influence the travel plans of young people. I became interested in this topic after noticing how many travel destinations on my own social media feed were influencing where I wanted to travel inside and outside of Bangladesh. I surveyed 100 young adults to see what kind of videos catch their attention and who they trust. The results showed that almost everyone scored a 4.5 out of 5 or higher when asked if reels make them want to travel. The data suggests that we trust regular creators significantly more than official tourism boards, and that action sports and nature are what actually catch our eye.

AI.tldr: 这项研究调查了短视频（Reels）如何影响年轻人的旅游决策。通过对100名年轻人的调查发现，短视频对旅游意愿有极强的促进作用（评分4.5/5以上），年轻人更信任普通创作者而非官方旅游机构，运动冒险和自然风光类内容最吸引他们。
AI.research_question: 短视频（Reels）如何影响年轻人的旅游目的地选择？具体而言，哪些类型的内容最吸引年轻人，以及他们在旅游信息上更信任谁？
AI.motivation: 研究者作为高中毕业生，观察到自己和朋友们在做旅游决策时不再依赖传统旅游手册或电视广告，而是通过TikTok和Instagram等平台的短视频来获取信息。这一现象激发了研究兴趣，促使作者系统探讨短视频对孟加拉国内外年轻人旅游意愿的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究未明确提及具体理论框架，但隐含了社交媒体影响力理论、用户生成内容（UGC）信任度理论以及视觉内容吸引力理论。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，对100名年轻人进行调研，测量他们对不同类型短视频的关注度以及对不同信息来源的信任程度。
AI.findings: (1) 几乎所有受访者认为Reels让他们产生旅游意愿，评分达4.5/5以上；(2) 年轻人显著更信任普通创作者（UGC）而非官方旅游机构；(3) 运动冒险类和自然风光类视频最能吸引年轻人的注意力。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究丰富了短视频内容对旅游决策影响领域的实证证据，揭示了用户生成内容在旅游信息传播中的重要性高于官方渠道，为社交媒体营销与旅游行为交叉研究提供了数据支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 对旅游目的地营销机构而言，建议优先与普通内容创作者合作而非仅依赖官方宣传；内容制作应侧重运动冒险和自然风光类主题；短视频平台应被视为影响年轻人旅游决策的核心渠道。

title: Credit as Deferred Performance: An Institutional Theory of Credit Opening

detail.title: Credit as Deferred Performance: An Institutional Theory of Credit Opening
detail.abstract: This paper argues that credit is the institutional reality of deferred performance. Existing legal and economic accounts define credit through deferred payment, financial accommodation, claims, debt, purchasing power, balance-sheet expansion, or bank-created money, but they do not fully specify what is constituted at the moment of credit opening. The paper defines credit as a rule-constituted institutional relation across time in which performance is postponed, an obligation is opened, and closure is deferred. Credit opening produces a juridical claim-duty configuration: the creditor obtains a Deferred Performance Claim, while the debtor bears a Deferred Performance Duty. This configuration is the legal result of credit opening, not the ontology of credit itself. Loans, receivables, deposits, notes, bonds, and asset-liability pairs are accounting and financial expressions of deferred performance. The paper distinguishes credit from monetary closure: credit opens obligations, while money or institutionally empowered monetary proxies close them through recognized settlement. It contributes to institutional economics by defining credit not as an asset class, legal claim, or monetary substitute, but as deferred performance made institutionally real.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信用是延期履行的制度实在，区别于传统定义中的延期支付、金融通融或货币创造等概念。信用被定义为一种规则构成的跨期制度关系，其中履行被推迟、义务被打开、结算被延迟。信用开立产生法定的请求权—义务结构，而贷款、存款、债券等只是延期履行的会计和金融表达。文章区分了信用与货币结算：信用打开义务，货币关闭义务。
AI.research_question: 信用的本体论是什么？即在信用开立的那一刻，究竟构成了什么制度实在？
AI.motivation: 现有法律和经济文献将信用定义为延期支付、金融通融、债权、债务、购买力、资产负债表扩张或银行创造的货币，但未能充分阐明信用开立时所构成的东西是什么。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度实在论（institutional reality）、规则构成理论（rule-constituted theory）、法经济学的请求权—义务结构
AI.method: 概念分析与制度本体论论证
AI.findings: 信用是延期履行的制度实在；信用开立产生"延期履行请求权—延期履行义务"的法权结构；贷款、存款、债券等是延期履行的会计和金融表达；信用与货币结算的根本区别在于信用打开义务而货币关闭义务。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信用重新定义为"延期履行的制度实在"，而非资产类别、法律请求权或货币替代品，为制度经济学提供了新的信用本体论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 厘清信用与货币的本质区别，有助于理解金融体系的运作逻辑，为金融监管和法律实践提供更清晰的概念框架。

title: Local Language and China's Dietary Transition

detail.title: Local Language and China's Dietary Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All authors approved the final manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Social Science Fund of China project “Research on the inheritance and protection, innovative development and benefit sharing of China’s pig germplasm resources” (Grant No. 22BJY084) and the Heilongjiang Provincial Philosophy and Social Science Research Planning Project “Research on the mechanism and pathway of integrated development of the whole industrial chain of Harbin cultural tourism” (Grant No. 25ZKA016).

detail.abstract: Does language reshape what people eat? This paper identifies the causal effects of Mandarin proficiency and dialect distance on household food consumption in China, separating a humancapital "modernization channel" from a cultural-capital "local-network channel." Using three independent micro-datasets, the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS 2010 and 2014), the China Labor-force Dynamics Survey (CLDS 2014), and the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS 1989-2015), we employ a three-layer identification strategy, with each layer relying on different identifying assumptions: two-stage least squares (2SLS) in the CFPS, instrumenting Mandarin proficiency with family language and county Mandarin share; an Atkin (2016)-style cross-dialect migrant design in the CHNS with community-by-wave fixed effects; and a bilingual dose-response analysis in the CLDS. Mandarin proficiency raises per-capita food expenditure by 13.85% and lowers animal-oil use, a pattern that replicates across datasets. Within the same community-year, cross-dialect migrants consume 0.93 fewer food types and 0.65 percentage points less protein energy than local residents and take roughly thirty years to assimilate; a 1989 direct-recall item shows that only 49.4% of cross-province migrants retain home foodways, against 90.7% of nonmigrants. We also report a cautionary null: province-level Mandarin penetration appears strongly correlated with dietary diversity but loses all significance once province fixed effects are added, signaling ecological-fallacy risk in cross-province studies. An Ashenfelter-Krueger correction further shows that the OLS-2SLS gap is partly classical measurement-error attenuation, with an implied reliability ratio of 0.27-0.66. Mandarin promotion thus accelerates dietary modernization while potentially eroding dialect-encoded local food knowledge, implying scope to coordinate language and nutrition policy under the "Greater Food Vision.

AI.tldr: 本文利用CFPS、CLDS、CHNS三个微观数据集，通过多种识别策略证实普通话能力显著提高家庭人均食品支出（13.85%）、降低动物油消费，并发现跨方言移民需要约30年才能实现饮食同化，揭示了语言通过"现代化渠道"和"地方网络渠道"双重机制重塑饮食消费的因果效应。
AI.research_question: 普通话能力和方言距离对中国家庭食品消费的因果效应是什么？语言通过何种渠道（人力资本的"现代化渠道" vs. 文化资本的"地方网络渠道"）重塑饮食行为？
AI.motivation: 语言可能通过两种机制影响饮食：一是作为人力资本提升现代化程度（如接触全国性健康信息），二是作为文化资本维系地方饮食传统。但现有研究缺乏因果识别，且存在生态谬误风险。理解这一关系对协调语言政策与营养政策具有重要政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（语言作为技能促进现代化饮食）；文化资本/社会网络理论（方言作为地方网络纽带维系传统饮食）；饮食同化理论（移民饮食行为随时间的趋同过程）。
AI.method: 三层识别策略：①CFPS数据采用2SLS，以家庭语言和县级普通话普及率作为工具变量；②CHNS数据采用Atkin(2016)式跨方言移民设计，加入社区-年份固定效应；③CLDS数据采用双语调适反应分析。此外运用Ashenfelter-Krueger校正处理测量误差。
AI.findings: ①普通话能力提升使家庭人均食品支出增加13.85%，降低动物油消费；②同社区-年份内，跨方言移民比本地居民少消费0.93种食物类型，蛋白质能量低0.65个百分点，约30年才能实现饮食同化；③1989年回忆数据显示仅49.4%跨省移民保留家乡饮食，非移民为90.7%；④省级普通话普及率与饮食多样性的相关性在加入省份固定效应后消失，存在生态谬误风险；⑤OLS-2SLS差距部分源于经典测量误差衰减，信度比为0.27-0.66。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次因果识别语言（普通话能力与方言距离）对饮食消费的双重影响机制（现代化渠道 vs. 地方网络渠道）；揭示了跨方言移民饮食同化的时间跨度（约30年）；警示了语言-饮食关系研究中的生态谬误问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为"大食物观"框架下协调语言推广政策与营养健康政策提供实证依据；提示在推广普通话的同时需关注方言承载的地方饮食知识流失问题；为饮食干预策略的制定提供语言维度的政策参考。

title: Ordering Bias and Ordering Variability: A Three-Step Approach for Interrater Reliability in Ordered Qualitative Coding
affiliations: FernUniversitat in Hagen, University of Melbourne, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid and University of Eastern Finland

detail.title: Ordering Bias and Ordering Variability: A Three-Step Approach for Interrater Reliability in Ordered Qualitative Coding
detail.abstract: Interrater reliability assessment in qualitative coding has historically focused on code detection and agreement regarding the presence of codes. Yet, numerous analytical methods depend on the sequence in which codes appear within an utterance. This paper makes three contributions. First, it introduces two metrics: ordering bias, which quantifies systematic directional disagreement in code placement, and ordering variability, which captures the dispersion of positional disagreement across utterances. Both metrics address the reliability of ordered coding schemes in which the relative position of codes carries substantive meaning. Second, both metrics are conditioned on detection agreement, isolating positional disagreement from detection disagreement at the level of individual codes. Combined with any binary detection metric, they constitute a three-step diagnostic framework for guiding the qualitative coding process and codebook development. Third, validation using synthetic data confirms that both metrics are bounded, symmetric around zero, and sensitive to known agreement conditions across realistic sample sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对质性编码中代码顺序的信度评估问题，提出了两个新指标——排序偏差（ordering bias）和排序变异性（ordering variability），并构建了一个三步诊断框架，用于系统评估有序编码方案的信度。
AI.research_question: 如何评估质性编码中代码顺序的信度（即编码者之间在代码排列顺序上的一致性）？
AI.motivation: 现有质性编码信度评估主要关注代码的检测（即代码是否存在），但许多分析方法依赖于代码在话语中出现的顺序，缺乏专门针对代码顺序一致性的量化指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有序编码理论；检测一致性；位置一致性。
AI.method: 提出两个新指标（排序偏差和排序变异性），并结合已有的二元检测指标，构建三步诊断框架；使用合成数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 两个指标均有界、关于零对称，且在合理的样本量下对已知的一致性条件敏感，能够有效区分检测不一致和位置不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信度评估从代码检测扩展到代码顺序维度，提出了专门度量顺序信度的量化工具，完善了质性编码信度评估的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为质性研究者和编码实践者提供了一个三步诊断框架，可指导编码过程和编码手册的迭代优化，提升编码结果的可靠性和可复现性。

affiliations: , Catholic University of Eichstaett-Ingolstadt and University of Mannheim - Accounting and Taxation

detail.title: More Is Not Always Better: An Economic Assessment of the EU's Anti-Avoidance Tax Framework

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-027
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW – Centre for European Econonomic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-027

detail.abstract: Over the past decade, the European Union has built a comprehensive supranational framework to combat corporate tax avoidance. This article provides the first integrated assessment of the EU's post-2015 anti-avoidance architecture, combining evidence on profit shifting by European multinationals, the effectiveness and side-effects of individual regulatory instruments, and the cumulative costs of tax complexity. While these measures have reduced specific profit-shifting channels, their marginal revenue impact appears limited relative to the rise in tax complexity, compliance costs, and distortions to investment, risk-taking, and innovation. The uneven global implementation of recent instruments-notably the Global Minimum Tax and public countryby-country reporting-has created a competitive asymmetry in which European multinationals bear regulatory burdens that their non-European competitors largely do not. The article concludes with policy recommendations to recalibrate the framework, eliminating rules whose marginal costs outweigh their marginal benefits while restoring the balance between enforcement and competitiveness that the EU's standard of "fair and efficient taxation" demands.

AI.tldr: 欧盟过去十年建立的避税监管框架虽减少了特定利润转移渠道，但边际收入效果有限，反而大幅增加了税收复杂性、合规成本，并对投资、风险承担和创新造成扭曲。由于全球实施不均，欧洲跨国公司面临竞争劣势。文章建议重新校准规则，删除边际成本大于边际收益的条款。
AI.research_question: 欧盟2015年后反避税架构的整体有效性如何？其边际收益是否超过边际成本？
AI.motivation: 欧盟在过去十年构建了全面的超国家反避税框架，但缺乏对其整体效果、副作用和累积成本的综合评估。现有研究多关注单一工具，未从全局视角审视合规成本与竞争力影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收竞争理论、反避税监管的边际成本-收益分析、公平与效率税收原则
AI.method: 综合评估法：整合利润转移证据、单个监管工具的有效性与副作用、税收复杂性累计成本的多维度分析
AI.findings: 1) 措施减少了特定利润转移渠道；2) 边际收入影响有限，但合规成本、税收复杂性显著上升；3) 对投资、风险承担和创新产生扭曲效应；4) 全球最低税和国别报告等工具在全球实施不均，导致欧洲跨国公司面临竞争不对称性
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对欧盟后2015年反避税架构进行整体评估，引入边际成本-收益框架分析监管有效性，揭示了"公平与效率"标准在实际执行中的矛盾
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了具体的规则重新校准建议，指出应删除边际成本大于边际收益的规则，恢复执法与竞争力之间的平衡

title: Beyond Means and Ends: Toward a Contextual Coherence in Eminent Domain Jurisprudence
affiliations: Southern Utah University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Beyond Means and Ends: Toward a Contextual Coherence in Eminent Domain Jurisprudence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human subjects or identifiable private data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines three landmark eminent domain cases, Poletown Neighborhood Council v. Detroit, County of Wayne v. Hathcock, and Kelo v. New London, which are often cited as evidence of inconsistent judicial outcomes. Using a comparative case analysis, it introduces Contextual Cost-Benefit Analysis (CCBA), a framework that interprets takings decisions as pragmatic evaluations in which costs and benefits are weighted by their contextual salience. The analysis shows that courts tend to uphold takings when projected benefits credibly outweigh the displacement and demoralization costs thereby generated, and reject them otherwise. This satisficing logic, grounded in Simon's concept of bounded rationality and North's account of institutional constraints, resembles the heuristic structure of the Hand rule in judicial reasoning rather than the marginal calculus of standard economic models. By identifying this distinct logic, CCBA suggests that accurate costbenefit analysis may require contextual weighting when decision-makers operate under institutional constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较三个著名征用案件（Poletown、Hathcock和Kelo），提出情境成本效益分析（CCBA）框架，揭示法院的征用判决遵循一种基于有限理性和制度约束的"满意化"逻辑——当预期收益可信地超过迁移和士气成本时，法院倾向于支持征用，否则予以驳回。
AI.research_question: 在征用权（ Eminent Domain）案件中，法院的判决为何看似不一致？是否存在一种统一的决策逻辑可以解释这些差异？
AI.motivation: 三个著名的征用案件（Poletown、Hathcock、Kelo）常被引用为司法结果不一致的证据，但这种表面上的不一致可能掩盖了更深层的统一逻辑。现有理论未能充分解释法院在征用案件中的实际推理模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: Simon的有限理性（Bounded Rationality）概念、North的制度约束（Institutional Constraints）理论、满意化（Satisficing）逻辑、汉德规则（Hand Rule）的启发式结构
AI.method: 比较案例分析（Comparative Case Analysis），通过对比三个具有代表性的征用权案件，归纳并提出情境成本效益分析（CCBA）框架。
AI.findings: 法院在征用案件中遵循满意化逻辑：当预期收益可信地超过迁移和士气成本时，法院倾向于支持征用；否则予以驳回。这种逻辑类似于汉德规则的启发式结构，而非标准经济模型的边际计算。CCBA表明，在制度约束下进行成本效益分析需要情境加权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出CCBA框架，将有限理性和制度约束理论整合到征用权司法决策的分析中，揭示了征用判决背后的统一逻辑——满意化逻辑，不同于传统经济学的边际分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解征用权案件的司法判决提供了可解释的分析框架，有助于法律从业者和政策制定者更准确地预测法院在征用案件中的判决倾向，并为制度设计提供参考。

title: Import Duty Pass-Through to Domestic Gold Prices: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from India's Gold Market, 2024-2026

detail.title: Import Duty Pass-Through to Domestic Gold Prices: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from India's Gold Market, 2024-2026
detail.abstract: This paper estimates how much of India's May 2026 gold import duty hike, from 6 to 15%, passed through to domestic gold prices. Exploiting the sharp and unanticipated policy discontinuity as a quasi-experiment, this paper applies an interrupted time series (ITS) design with Newey-West HAC standard errors to a primary sample of 375 daily observations from the India Bullion and Jewellers Association benchmark price series (July 2024-June 2026), with 346 pre-hike and 29 post-hike trading days. The full dataset comprises 929 daily price observations (824 IBJA PDF circulars and 105 BullionWorld.in gap-fills) spanning January 2022 through June 2026, within a 1,170-row weekday date spine. The duty hike raised the domestic gold premium by Rs. 9,841 per 10 grams, representing 81.7% of the theoretical ceiling, with a 95% confidence interval of 73.3 to 90.1%. Full passthrough is formally rejected (t =-4.26, p < 0.001). Local projections confirm the adjustment was immediate on the first trading day and held on a stable plateau through Day 14 (78.2%), with no evidence of anticipatory pricing. An ARDL bounds test confirms cointegration between domestic and international gold prices in the pre-hike period; the stable local-projection plateau through Day 14 is consistent with the shift persisting rather than mean-reverting within the observation window. Placebo tests and counterfactual methods confirm the result is specific to May 13, 2026. This paper also documents asymmetric price transmission: the duty hike passed through at 81.7% by the first trading day, while the July 2024 cut reached only 65.6% at an equivalent horizon (clean sample, July 2022-May 2026, N = 746). The hike therefore transmitted more completely than the cut, consistent with downward rigidity in duty pass-through. The incomplete pass-through is consistent with supply-side dampening from front-loaded inventory imported at the prior duty rate, seasonal demand weakness, and historical smuggling elasticity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2026年5月印度黄金进口关税从6%骤升至15%这一准自然实验，采用中断时间序列设计，发现关税上调使国内黄金溢价上涨9,841卢比/10克，达到理论上限的81.7%，完全传导被正式拒绝，且关税上调的传导率（81.7%）显著高于之前关税下调的传导率（65.6%），存在不对称性和下行刚性。
AI.research_question: 2026年5月印度黄金进口关税从6%上调至15%的政策，在多大程度上传导至国内黄金价格？
AI.motivation: 印度是最大的黄金消费国之一，关税变动对国内金价有重大影响，但此前缺乏基于准自然实验的严谨因果估计，且关税上调与下调的传导不对称性尚未被充分量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税传导理论、汇率传递理论、价格刚性理论、不对称价格传导（向下刚性）理论。
AI.method: 中断时间序列（ITS）设计，辅以局部投影法、ARDL边界协整检验、安慰剂检验及反事实分析，标准误采用Newey-West HAC估计。
AI.findings: (1) 关税上调使国内黄金溢价上涨9,841卢比/10克，传导率81.7%（95% CI: 73.3%-90.1%），完全传导被拒绝。 (2) 调整在首个交易日即完成，且在第14天保持稳定平台（78.2%），无预期定价。 (3) 存在不对称传导：上调传导率（81.7%）显著高于2024年7月下调的传导率（65.6%），支持向下刚性。 (4) 不完全传导与前期低价进口库存缓冲、季节性需求疲软及历史走私弹性一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用准实验方法（ITS）严格估计关税变动的短期传导率；实证揭示了关税上调与下调传导的不对称性（下调刚性），丰富了关税传导与价格刚性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及新兴市场国家关税政策的定价效应提供量化基准；提示政策制定者关税上调的传导虽高但不完全，需关注库存缓冲、走私弹性等缓解因素；关税下调的传导更弱，可能削弱减税刺激消费的政策初衷。

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-029
title: Does Public Procurement Select (Real) Outsider Innovation? The Interplay Between Tender Design and Supplier Experience
affiliations: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Research, ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, Bundeswehr University Munich - Bundeswehr University Munich, Students, Bundeswehr University Munich and Bundeswehr University Munich

detail.title: Does Public Procurement Select (Real) Outsider Innovation? The Interplay Between Tender Design and Supplier Experience

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-029
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-029

detail.abstract: Public organizations rely on open innovation to maintain and improve public service performance. Suppliers are a key source of such innovation. Public contracting authorities act as the interface between public organizations and supply markets, shaping whether supplier innovations are identified, rewarded, and selected. Combining representative firm-level data from the German Community Innovation Survey with official tender-level data from the Tenders Electronic Daily database, we construct firms' public procurement award histories between 2006 and 2023. We distinguish between four tender categories that differ by geographic scope (domestic versus international) and award mechanism (price-based versus criteria-based). We further differentiate between "real outsiders" and "pseudo-outsiders" based on experience supplying public markets. Using multivariate probit models, we examine how different degrees of innovation novelty are associated with supplier selection across tender categories and outsider status. Three findings emerge. i) Suppliers' category-specific procurement experience increases the likelihood of subsequent selection, indicating rigidity in public procurement markets. ii) Price-based tenders are associated with firm-level novelties, whereas criteria-based tenders are associated with market-specific novelties. iii) These innovation advantages are concentrated among "real outsiders" and largely disappear for "pseudo-outsiders", for whom prior category-specific procurement experience becomes the main predictor of subsequent selection.

AI.tldr: 本文结合德国企业创新调查与公共采购招标数据，研究了供应商创新新颖性与公共采购中标之间的关系。研究发现：采购经验是中标的关键预测因素（表明市场刚性）；价格型招标更青睐企业级创新，标准型招标更青睐市场级创新；这些创新优势主要存在于"真正的外部者"中，而对"伪外部者"而言，经验比创新更重要。
AI.research_question: 供应商不同新颖程度的创新如何影响其在不同类型的公共采购招标中被选中的概率？这种关系如何因供应商的"外部者"身份（真正外部者 vs. 伪外部者）而不同？
AI.motivation: 公共组织依赖开放式创新来维持和提升公共服务绩效，而供应商是创新的重要来源。公共采购机构作为公共组织与供应商市场之间的界面，其招标机制设计（价格型 vs. 标准型）如何影响不同新颖程度创新的识别、奖励和选择，是一个重要的实践和理论问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放式创新理论、公共 procurement 治理机制理论、供应商经验与创新信号理论
AI.method: 将德国社区创新调查的企业层面代表性数据与Tenders Electronic Daily数据库中的官方招标数据匹配，构建2006-2023年间企业的公共采购中标历史。区分四种招标类别（国内/国际 × 价格型/标准型），并区分"真正外部者"（无公共市场经验）与"伪外部者"（有公共市场经验但非该类别经验）。采用多元Probit模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 三组主要发现：i) 供应商在特定类别中的采购经验显著增加后续中标概率，表明公共采购市场存在刚性；ii) 价格型招标与"企业级新颖性"（企业层面的新事物）相关，而标准型招标与"市场级新颖性"（市场层面的新事物）相关；iii) 这些创新优势主要集中在"真正外部者"中，而对"伪外部者"而言，特定类别的采购经验成为中标的主要预测因素，创新优势基本消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公共采购市场中创新与经验之间的权衡关系，区分了不同招标机制对创新类型的差异化筛选作用，并提出了"外部者"异质性的理论区分（真正外部者 vs. 伪外部者），丰富了开放式创新与公共 procurement 的理论交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共采购政策制定者提供了实证依据：若希望引入真正的新供应商和创新，应关注招标机制设计（价格型 vs. 标准型）以及区分不同类型的"外部者"；提示标准型招标可能更有利于市场级创新，而价格型招标可能更有利于企业级创新；同时提醒公共采购存在路径依赖和经验刚性，可能阻碍创新供应商进入。

title:
Getting the Vehicle Emissions Standard Right
How Canada can meet it s Climate and EV Adoption Goals

detail.title:
Getting the Vehicle Emissions Standard Right
How Canada can meet it s Climate and EV Adoption Goals
detail.abstract:
Multiple governments across the world are in the process of revising their light-duty vehicle emissions standards (VES) to achieve climate goals. Using Canada's vehicle emissions standard as an example, we examine the impact of multiple policy design options on GHG emissions, electric vehicle (EV) adoption, vehicle downsizing, and vehicle affordability. 
We find 
For Canada to meet its EV sales goal of 75% by 2035, it needs a VES target of 40 g/mile or lower. 
To reach its climate goals of 45% emissions reduction relative to 2005, Canada needs a more stringent VES target of 30 g/mile or lower by 2035.  
More stringent VES targets can contribute to additional price declines as automakers adjust pricing strategies and expand the availability of lower-cost EV models.  
A single fleet-wide VES target would be more effective at reducing emissions than maintaining separate targets for passenger cars and light trucks , as it would incentivize smaller and lighter vehicles .

AI.tldr: 本文以加拿大为例，研究不同轻型车排放标准（VES）政策设计方案对温室气体排放、电动车普及、车辆小型化及购车负担能力的影响。
AI.research_question: 不同轻型车排放标准政策设计方案对温室气体排放、电动车普及率、车辆小型化及购车负担能力有何影响？
AI.motivation: 多国正在修订轻型车排放标准以实现气候目标，但不同政策设计（如单一车队标准 vs. 乘用车与轻型卡车分开标准）的效果尚不明确，需实证分析以指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排放标准设计与市场行为理论；政策激励对汽车制造商定价策略、产品组合及消费者选择的影响机制。
AI.method: 以加拿大为案例的情景分析与政策模拟。
AI.findings: 1) 加拿大要实现2035年电动车销量占比75%的目标，VES需≤40克/英里；2) 要实现比2005年减排45%的气候目标，VES需≤30克/英里；3) 更严格的VES目标可促使车企调整定价策略、增加低价电动车供给；4) 单一车队标准比乘用车与轻型卡车分开标准更能有效减排，因其激励车辆小型化轻量化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了排放标准严格度与政策设计（统一vs.分类标准）对减排效果、电动车普及及车辆尺寸的差异化影响机制，丰富了环境规制与汽车产业政策互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大及类似国家制定轻型车排放标准提供量化政策参考，明确实现气候目标和电动车销量目标所需的具体标准阈值，并指出统一标准优于分类标准。

title: When Rights Move Online: Public Observability and India's RTE Admission System

detail.title: When Rights Move Online: Public Observability and India's RTE Admission System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research has not been influenced by any organization / personal / financial interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This was an empirical analysis using publicly available data. No patient / participant was required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded research.

keywords: empirical legal studies Right to Education

detail.abstract: How should internet-mediated public administration be evaluated when a statutory right depends on citizens finding, using, monitoring, and challenging a public-facing process? This article develops the construct of public observability: the extent to which a rights-claim pathway is publicly reconstructable through official digital and documentary interfaces. It applies the construct to Section 12(1)(c) of India’s Right to Education Act, which reserves at least 25 percent of entry-level seats in covered private unaided non-minority schools for eligible disadvantaged children. A multi-pass public-source audit of all 28 states and 8 union territories codes ten features across rules, portals, application routes, seat/school information, status tracking, results, guidance, helpdesks, grievance routes, and language/accessibility support. The study does not measure legal compliance, admissions, seat fill, parent experience, or usability; it asks whether a motivated public user or intermediary can reconstruct the claim pathway from official evidence. Results show bifurcation: 17 jurisdictions have High evidence confidence, two Medium, and 17 Low. Better-evidenced jurisdictions often make claim entry visible, but monitorability and contestability remain uneven. The article contributes a rights-pathway framework linking legal entitlement, public interface, claimability, monitorability, and contestability, and proposes minimum observability standards for digital-era rights implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公共可观测性"概念，通过多轮公共来源审计，评估印度《受教育权法》第12(1)(c)条在28个邦和8个中央直辖区实施中的权利主张路径是否可通过官方数字和文档界面被公众重建。结果显示17个辖区证据置信度高，17个低，2个中等，揭示权利实施中存在显着的"可观测性"分化。
AI.research_question: 当法定权利的实现取决于公民能否找到、使用、监测和挑战一个公开流程时，应如何评估互联网中介的公共行政？具体而言，印度《受教育权法》第12(1)(c)条规定的权利主张路径在各邦/中央直辖区的官方数字和文档界面中是否具有公共可观测性？
AI.motivation: 在数字时代，法定权利的实现越来越依赖在线公共界面，但目前缺乏系统的概念和评估框架来衡量公民能否通过这些界面真正理解、追踪和主张自己的权利。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共可观测性（public observability）——权利主张路径通过官方数字和文档界面可被公众重建的程度；权利路径框架（rights-pathway framework）——连接法定权利、公共界面、可主张性（claimability）、可监测性（monitorability）和可争议性（contestability）。
AI.method: 多轮公共来源审计（multi-pass public-source audit），覆盖印度所有28个邦和8个中央直辖区，对10个特征（规则、门户、申请途径、席位/学校信息、状态追踪、结果、指导、帮助台、申诉途径、语言/可及性支持）进行编码。
AI.findings: 17个辖区具有高证据置信度，2个中等，17个低。证据较好的辖区通常使权利主张的入口（申请）可见，但可监测性（追踪状态）和可争议性（申诉/挑战）仍然参差不齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"公共可观测性"这一新概念及权利路径框架，将法律权利、公共界面与公民行动（主张、监测、争议）联系起来，为数字时代权利实施评估提供理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出最低可观测性标准，为政策制定者和行政机构改进数字界面设计、增强权利实施的透明度和问责性提供可操作指南。

title: Measuring Consumption with Credit Card Data: Benchmarking and Beyond
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Measuring Consumption with Credit Card Data: Benchmarking and Beyond
detail.abstract: We introduce a novel monthly county-level consumption dataset constructed from spending data on over 350 million credit cards in the Federal Reserve's Y-14M reports, covering over 3,000 U.S. counties since 2014. We first show that the data closely approximate traditional consumption measures, explaining 92 percent of the variation in monthly adjusted personal consumption expenditures (PCE) growth at the national level and capturing meaningful cross-sectional variation in annual adjusted PCE growth at the state level. As a proof of concept, we use the county-month panel to estimate heterogeneous consumption responses to monetary policy shocks across the county-level income distribution, an analysis infeasible with traditional consumption data. We find that low-income counties exhibit larger spending declines than high-income counties, consistent with heterogeneous agent New Keynesian models. Finally, we provide practical guidance for researchers working with similar data, discussing coverage, sample composition, and the approximation of credit card spending from credit bureau data.

AI.tldr: 本文基于美联储Y-14M报告中超过3.5亿张信用卡的消费数据，构建了2014年以来美国3000多个县级的月度消费数据集，并验证了其可靠性，进而利用该数据发现了低收入县对货币政策冲击的消费反应更大，与异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型一致。
AI.research_question: 如何利用信用卡消费大数据构建高频率、精细地理维度的消费数据集，并研究不同收入水平地区对货币政策冲击的异质性消费反应？
AI.motivation: 传统的消费数据（如PCE）在时间和地理维度上较为粗糙，难以进行县级层面的高频分析，尤其无法有效识别不同收入群体对宏观政策的异质性反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型（HANK），该模型预测低收入群体对货币政策冲击的消费反应比高收入群体更大。
AI.method: 利用美联储Y-14M报告中超过3.5亿张信用卡的月度消费数据，构建2014年以来覆盖3000多个美国县的消费面板数据；通过与官方PCE数据进行对比验证数据的代表性；采用面板回归模型估计货币政策冲击对县际消费的异质性影响。
AI.findings: 该数据集在国家级层面解释了月度调整后PCE增长92%的变异，并捕捉了州级层面的年度消费变化；低收入县在货币政策紧缩冲击下消费下降幅度显著大于高收入县，支持HANK模型预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 为异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型提供了基于县级消费面板数据的微观经验证据，验证了不同收入阶层对货币政策冲击的非对称消费反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 构建了一个高频率、精细地理维度的县级消费数据集，可供政策制定者和研究者用于区域经济分析和政策评估；为使用信用卡数据的其他研究者提供了覆盖范围、样本构成和近似方法等方面的实用指导。

title: People as the Source of Value A People-Centered Theory of Value and Economic Claims in the Data and Automation Age
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: People as the Source of Value A People-Centered Theory of Value and Economic Claims in the Data and Automation Age
detail.abstract: This paper advances a people-centered theory of economic value. Its central proposition is that in a data-driven and increasingly automated economy, people are not peripheral economic actors, nor merely consumers, workers, users, or one stakeholder group among many. They are the primary source from which economic value becomes possible. Every act of human participation, including purchase, attention, trust, loyalty, the generation of behavioural data, the expression of preference, and the sacrifice of alternative options, contributes to economic value. The question this paper addresses is therefore not whether participation creates value, which it takes to be evident, but how the value that people generate can be recognised, measured, recorded, and returned to its human source through an economically workable mechanism. The paper argues that the economic effects of human participation, including trust, consumption, labour, loyalty, attention, and behavioural data, already function as intangible value-bearing resources for firms. They contribute to revenue, brand value, customer retention, goodwill, acquisition premia, and the expectation of future cash flows. Yet existing economic and accounting frameworks permit firms to benefit from these people-generated intangibles while recognising no corresponding claim for the people whose conduct generates them. By analogy to the treatment of natural resources as common or national wealth, where an extracting firm earns a return on its capital, technology, and risk but does not thereby own the underlying resource, this paper argues that firms hold legitimate claims for the capital, organisation, processing, and risk they contribute, but not an automatic and exclusive claim over the whole of the value generated from human participation. This framework is named PAYMAN, standing for People As Your MANdate, denoting the proposition that people, through their participation, hold a mandate over the value they make possible. The paper formalises a set of conditions under which participation-based value can be operationally recognised and repaid, proposes an extension to the accounting identity that records people-generated intangible assets alongside a corresponding participation claim, and introduces the concept of a value flow, distinct from cash flow, together with a secondary market in which participation-based claims could be exchanged. PAYMAN is presented as a foundational theory for a new economic architecture rather than as an already operational system; its empirical calibration and legal development are identified as a research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以人为中心的经济价值理论（PAYMAN），认为人的参与（注意、信任、数据、忠诚等）是经济价值的根本来源，企业不应独占这些价值，而应通过可操作的机制将价值返还给参与者。
AI.research_question: 如何通过经济上可行的机制，识别、衡量、记录并将人类参与所创造的价值返还给其来源（人）？
AI.motivation: 现有经济和会计框架允许企业从人类参与产生的无形资产（信任、注意力、行为数据等）中获益，但未承认参与者的相应权利，这构成了价值归属的不对称。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以人为中心的价值理论；类比自然资源作为公共/国家财富的产权原则；将人类参与视为类似自然资源的基础性价值来源。
AI.method: 理论推演与概念构建；通过类比论证（自然资源处理）；提出新的会计恒等式扩展；引入价值流与二级市场的概念设计。
AI.findings: 人类参与的经济效应（信任、消费、劳动、忠诚、注意力、行为数据）已作为无形资产为企业创造价值；企业拥有资本、组织、加工和风险的合法索取权，但不应对参与产生的全部价值拥有独占权；提出PAYMAN框架，包含价值识别条件、扩展的会计恒等式、以及价值流与二级市场机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"以人为中心"的价值理论（PAYMAN），挑战企业独占参与者创造价值的既有经济假设；将人类参与视为类似自然资源的基础性价值来源，建立新的产权分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为重新设计企业价值分配机制提供理论基础；提出会计恒等式扩展以记录"参与性索取权"；引入"价值流"概念及二级市场，为量化与交易参与价值提供可能路径。

title: Mapping Digital Ecosystems: A Network Analysis of the Early PC Industry (1981-1987)
affiliations: University College London - Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose

detail.title: Mapping Digital Ecosystems: A Network Analysis of the Early PC Industry (1981-1987)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Digital ecosystems are understood as networks of complementary components coordinated across firm boundaries, yet the tools to measure and compare their structure remain underdeveloped. This paper introduces a network-based method that maps ecosystems as components connected through interfaces and tracks how that structure evolves over time. We apply it to an original, hand-collected dataset of the early Personal Computer (PC) industry over 1981 to 1987, covering almost 5,000 products by over 1,000 firms. We partition the network into ecosystems by operating system-proximity and focus on four representative cases: the IBM PC, the Apple II, the Atari 8-bit and the Commodore 64. Using degree centralisation, preferential attachment estimates and layer-by-firm decompositions, we find that the most centralised ecosystems take a near-star rather than a scale-free shape, and that this centralisation arises not from closure as such but from the uneven openness of adjacent layers. Finally, interface-governance case studies trace these patterns to the disclosure of technical documentation, the specificity of essential complements, and the licensing of intellectual property.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于网络的方法来绘制数字生态系统结构，并通过对早期PC行业（1981-1987）近5000种产品的实证分析，揭示了生态系统集中化源于相邻层的不对称开放，而非封闭本身。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量和比较数字生态系统的结构？生态系统的集中化结构从何而来？
AI.motivation: 数字生态系统被理解为跨企业边界的互补组件网络，但衡量和比较其结构的工具仍然不发达。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络理论（度中心性、优先连接估计）、生态系统理论、接口治理理论
AI.method: 基于网络的方法，将生态系统映射为通过接口连接的组件；对手工收集的1981-1987年早期PC行业近5000种产品数据进行实证分析；使用度中心性、优先连接估计和逐层分解；结合接口治理案例研究。
AI.findings: 最集中的生态系统呈现近星形而非无标度形状；集中化源于相邻层的不对称开放，而非封闭本身；技术文档披露、关键互补品的特异性以及知识产权许可是集中化的驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了测量和比较数字生态系统结构的新方法；区分了"集中化"与"封闭"的概念，指出集中化来自不对称开放而非封闭；为生态系统治理理论提供了网络层面的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业和管理者提供了生态系统结构分析与设计的工具；揭示了接口治理（技术文档披露、知识产权许可等）对生态系统集中化的关键作用。

title: Capturing Heterogeneity: Machine Learning Approaches to Implied Volatility Forecasting
affiliations: and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Capturing Heterogeneity: Machine Learning Approaches to Implied Volatility Forecasting

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Despite documented heterogeneity in volatility dynamics across the option surface, standard implied volatility forecasting models apply homogeneous parameters throughout. We introduce a machine-learning framework that uses regression trees to partition the surface along both moneyness and maturity dimensions, identifying data-driven regions where distinct forecasting models perform best. Extending the Surface Heterogeneous Autoregressive (SHAR) framework of Dufays, Jacobs, and Rombouts (2025), we develop tree-based SHAR specifications that preserve interpretable structure while allowing model parameters to vary across the surface. Empirical analysis using S&P 500 options demonstrates that the boosted tree-based specification achieves the lowest out-of-sample forecast errors across all horizons, reducing one-month-ahead RMSE by 13 percent versus the benchmark SHAR model. The improvements are statistically significant and particularly pronounced during stress periods. The estimated tree presents economically interpretable segmentation: short-dated options exhibit higher daily persistence but lower monthly persistence than long-dated options, while deep out-of-the-money calls or puts display distinct dynamics from near-the-money contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于回归树的机器学习框架，将隐含波动率曲面按执行价和期限分区建模，显著提升预测精度，相比基准SHAR模型将一个月期RMSE降低13%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法对期权隐含波动率曲面进行异质性分区建模，以提升预测精度？
AI.motivation: 标准隐含波动率预测模型对整个曲面使用同质性参数，但实际中波动率动态在曲面不同区域存在显著异质性，因此需要一种数据驱动的方法来识别最优建模区域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于SHAR（Surface Heterogeneous Autoregressive）框架，结合回归树（regression trees）和Boosting方法，构建Tree-based SHAR模型。
AI.method: 利用回归树按执行价（moneyness）和期限（maturity）维度对波动率曲面进行数据驱动分区，使不同区域适用不同的预测模型参数，并采用Boosting技术提升预测性能。
AI.findings: 1）提升树模型在所有预测期均取得最低样本外预测误差；2）一个月期RMSE比基准SHAR模型降低13%；3）改进在压力时期尤为显著；4）树结构显示短期期权日度持续性更高但月度持续性更低，深度虚值期权与近值期权呈现不同动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将回归树与SHAR框架结合，提出具有可解释性的波动率曲面异质性分区建模方法，揭示了不同区域波动率动态的结构性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者和风险管理人提供一种更精确的隐含波动率预测工具，尤其在市场压力时期表现优异，有助于改进期权定价和风险对冲策略。

title: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
affiliations: Universitat Pompeu Fabra/CREI, Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
detail.abstract: In dynamic multisector economies, the planner’s optimal capital allocation can serve to minimize the aggregate impact of shocks cascading through nonlinear production networks. We show analytically in a simplified model that, under complementarity and if risk aversion is not too low, (i) optimal capital allocation under uncertainty involves deliberately over-investing, relative to the deterministic optimum, in upstream sectors in order to mitigate severe economic downturns; (ii) this strategy can reduce the average level of consumption and give rise to a high welfare cost of business cycles. Deploying novel deep-learning techniques in a general environment, we show quantitatively that: (iii) the ergodic distribution of the simulated nonlinear economy features higher mean capital levels in key upstream sectors, lower mean levels of macroeconomic aggregates, realistic aggregate volatility, and a welfare cost of business cycles two orders of magnitude larger than in standard one-sector models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在多部门非线性生产网络中，规划者如何通过资本配置来缓解冲击的级联效应。研究发现，在互补性和风险厌恶足够高的条件下，最优策略是在上游部门过度投资（相对于确定性最优水平），以缓解严重经济下行。该策略会降低平均消费水平，并导致显著的福利成本。基于深度学习方法的量化分析显示，模拟经济中上游部门资本均值更高，宏观总量均值更低，经济周期福利成本比标准单部门模型高出两个数量级。
AI.research_question: 在多部门非线性生产网络中，不确定性下的最优资本配置策略是什么？这种策略如何影响经济周期福利成本？
AI.motivation: 传统单部门模型低估了经济周期的福利成本，而现实中生产网络中的冲击级联效应可能放大经济波动。需要研究在非线性生产网络下，规划者如何通过资本配置来缓解冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性生产网络模型、动态多部门经济、互补性与风险厌恶理论、最优资本配置理论
AI.method: 简化模型分析（解析推导）+ 深度学习数值方法（模拟一般环境下的非线性经济）
AI.findings: （i）在互补性和风险厌恶足够高时，最优资本配置应在上游部门过度投资；（ii）该策略降低平均消费水平，提高经济周期福利成本；（iii）量化结果显示上游部门资本均值更高，宏观总量均值更低，福利成本比标准单部门模型高两个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生产网络结构对最优资本配置的重要影响，提出了"上游过度投资"策略作为抗冲击机制，将经济周期福利成本的研究从单部门拓展到多部门非线性网络。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者应对经济冲击提供了资本配置的指导原则：应优先保障上游关键部门的资本投资；提醒注意经济周期福利成本可能被严重低估，需重新评估宏观稳定政策的价值。

title: The Impact of Patient Capital
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU), MIT Sloan School of Management and University of Toronto

detail.title: The Impact of Patient Capital
detail.abstract: We show that investor patience shapes venture-capital (VC) investment strategies and outcomes. Exploiting a 2014 Chinese reform that opened RMB-denominated VC funds to insurers, we compare treated RMB funds to unaffected USD-denominated funds run by the same general partners (GP), both investing in Chinese startups. Insurer entry reshaped the limited partner (LP) base by displacing shorter-horizon investors such as individuals. Consequently, treated funds shifted strategy toward longer holding periods and earlier-stage investments, leading to improved portfolio company exits and innovation. GPs' bargaining power vis-à-vis LPs mediates this response. A randomized experiment with Chinese GPs corroborates the mechanism: managers explicitly tailor fund duration and project holding periods to the perceived horizons of their LP base. Our results highlight the importance of patient ultimate investors in building a successful VC ecosystem, and offer a cautionary note on the ongoing retailization of private markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2014年中国保险资金进入人民币VC基金的政策改革，发现更耐心的有限合伙人（LP）能促使VC基金采取更长持有期、更早期投资的策略，并提升组合公司退出和创新表现。研究揭示了LP耐心对VC生态系统成功的重要性，并对私募市场零售化趋势提出警示。
AI.research_question: 投资者耐心如何影响风险投资（VC）的投资策略和绩效结果？
AI.motivation: 实践中VC基金的LP结构日益多元化（如个人投资者涌入私募市场），但学界对LP耐心程度如何影响GP行为及基金表现缺乏因果证据。本文利用中国2014年允许保险资金进入人民币VC基金的外生政策冲击来识别这一因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论（GP-LP关系）、投资者时间偏好理论、金融中介与创新文献。
AI.method: 准自然实验（双重差分DID）：比较受改革影响的人民币基金与同一GP管理的美元基金（对照组）；辅以随机实验（对人民币GP进行情景模拟）。
AI.findings: （1）保险公司进入后，LP结构从短视的个人投资者转向长期耐心的机构； （2）受处理基金延长持有期、更偏向早期投资； （3）组合公司退出成功率提高、创新产出增加； （4）GP的议价能力是调节机制； （5）随机实验证实GP会根据感知的LP耐心调整基金期限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为LP耐心→VC策略→企业绩效的因果链条提供严谨实证证据；揭示了GP议价能力在GP-LP关系中的作用；丰富了金融中介与企业家精神交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者：鼓励长期资本（如养老金、保险资金）进入VC市场；警示当前私募市场零售化（吸引短视个人投资者）可能损害VC生态系统的创新能力。

title: AI, Task-based Production in General Equilibrium and Distribution of Labour Incomes
affiliations: Department of Economics, Jadavpur University and

detail.title: AI, Task-based Production in General Equilibrium and Distribution of Labour Incomes
detail.abstract: In a multi-sector general equilibrium model of task-based production, we examine the impact of two types of AI-driven finite changes, one in production-tasks in an AI-prone or AI-applicable sector and the other in the sector-composition of the economy, on the real wage and distribution of wage-income among workers of different skills. We establish that, contrary to the conventional wisdom of a sector-specific small Hicks-neutral type technological change unambiguously lowering real wage of the middle skilled workers despite their productivities improving, finite changes can eventually raise their real wage. But, the distribution of wage-incomes changing in favour of the high-skilled workers (relative to the middle-skilled workers) due to AI-driven finite changes will be similar to that due to small technological change, except that the relative gain of the high-skilled workers will smaller in magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多部门任务生产一般均衡模型，研究两种AI驱动的有限变化（AI适用部门的生产任务变化和部门构成变化）对实际工资和不同技能工人工资收入分配的影响。发现与常规认知不同，有限变化最终能提高中等技能工人的实际工资，但高技能工人相对收益仍更大，只是幅度较小。
AI.research_question: 两种AI驱动的有限变化（生产任务变化与部门构成变化）如何影响不同技能工人的实际工资和工资收入分配？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为部门特定的小规模希克斯中性技术进步会降低中等技能工人的实际工资，本文想检验在AI驱动的有限（而非微小）变化下，这一结论是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门任务生产一般均衡模型，区分两种AI驱动变化：AI适用部门的生产任务变化和部门构成变化。
AI.method: 多部门一般均衡模型的理论推导与比较静态分析。
AI.findings: （1）与"小规模技术变革降低中等技能工人实际工资"的传统观点不同，有限变化最终能提高中等技能工人的实际工资；（2）AI驱动的有限变化仍会使工资收入分配向高技能工人倾斜，但倾斜幅度小于小规模技术变革的情形。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"部门特定小规模希克斯中性技术进步必然损害中等技能工人实际工资"的传统认知，揭示了有限变化与微小变化的差异化分配效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解AI对不同技能劳动者的工资影响提供理论依据，提示有限的技术变革可能缓解中等技能工人的工资受损问题。

title: The Standards Are in the Mail: Comparing Credit Card Supply Indicators
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Standards Are in the Mail: Comparing Credit Card Supply Indicators

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We provide the first lender-level analysis linking two independently constructed credit supply measures: the Federal Reserve's Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) and credit card mail offers from Mintel Comperemedia. Using a matched panel of 73 banks from 2000 to 2019, we find that quarterly mail volume growth was 18 percent lower when banks reported tightening credit card lending standards, a relationship robust to including credit demand indicators. In addition, SLOOS responses on credit limits and interest rate spreads are also correlated with these terms observed in mail offers. Our findings validate both measures as informative credit supply indicators.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次在银行层面，将美联储的SLOOS调查数据与Mintel信用卡邮件报价数据进行匹配分析，发现当银行报告收紧信用卡贷款标准时，其季度邮件量增长率下降18%，验证了两种指标作为信贷供给度量的有效性。
AI.research_question: SLOOS调查中的信贷供给变化是否与银行实际的信用卡营销行为（邮件报价）相一致？两种独立构建的信贷供给指标是否相互验证？
AI.motivation: SLOOS是广泛使用的信贷供给调查指标，但其准确性缺乏银行层面的直接验证。同样，信用卡邮件报价数据也常被用于衡量信贷供给，但两者之间的关系尚未被系统检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白，验证两种指标的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷供给变动的测量与验证理论
AI.method: 匹配面板数据分析：将73家银行2000-2019年的SLOOS调查数据与Mintel Comperemedia信用卡邮件报价数据进行银行层面的匹配，采用回归分析检验两者之间的关系，并控制信贷需求指标。
AI.findings: （1）当银行报告收紧信用卡贷款标准时，其季度邮件量增长率下降18%；（2）该关系在控制信贷需求指标后仍然稳健；（3）SLOOS中关于信用额度和利差的问题也与邮件报价中的相应条款相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在银行层面实证验证了SLOOS调查与信用卡邮件报价数据之间的一致性，为两种信贷供给度量指标提供了交叉验证的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和政策制定者提供了信心：SLOOS调查数据和信用卡邮件报价数据均可作为信贷供给变动的有效指标；有助于更准确地监测和评估信贷市场状况。

title: Trade, Risk, and Resilience in General Equilibrium
affiliations: Ifo Institute, University of Applied Sciences Konstanz

detail.title: Trade, Risk, and Resilience in General Equilibrium
detail.abstract: Sanctions, export controls, and friend-shoring shift the margin of trade policy from cost alone to exposure. When supplier risks are correlated, the value of a trade relationship cannot be evaluated in isolation; it depends on the sourcing network in which it is embedded. This paper develops a general-equilibrium theory of relationship-based trade under correlated risk. Countries allocate sourcing across partners whose risks load on common factors, while terms of trade clear markets and scale the uninsured covariance carried by each relationship. The mechanism separates individually optimal de-risking from collective resilience. Reallocation away from a risky supplier raises demand for substitutes; if capacity is scarce, or if substitutes load on the same systemic factor, equilibrium prices can erode, and even reverse, the risk reduction the reallocation was meant to achieve. The model yields a risk-augmented Viner decomposition into trade creation, terms-of-trade redistribution, and induced risk. Quantitatively, this induced-risk channel is small with broad re-sourcing and abundant substitutes, but first-order for critical inputs and high-loading supplier clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个在关联风险下基于关系的贸易一般均衡理论。研究发现，当供应商风险存在相关性时，贸易关系的价值不能孤立评估，而取决于其嵌入的采购网络。模型揭示了“个体最优去风险”与“集体韧性”之间的分离机制：若替代品稀缺或共同加载于同一系统性因子，均衡价格可能侵蚀甚至逆转去风险行动本身旨在实现的风险降低效果。
AI.research_question: 当供应商风险相互关联时，贸易关系的价值如何受采购网络结构影响？个体最优的去风险行为如何影响整体经济韧性？
AI.motivation: 制裁、出口管制和"友岸外包"正在将贸易政策的关注点从单纯的成本转向风险暴露。当供应商风险相关时，传统孤立评估贸易关系价值的方法失效，亟需一个能够捕捉网络关联风险的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关联风险下基于关系的贸易一般均衡理论；风险增强型维纳分解（贸易创造、贸易条件再分配与引致风险的三分法）。
AI.method: 一般均衡理论建模，包含：各国将采购分配给风险加载于共同因子的合作伙伴；贸易条件通过市场出清决定并衡量每段关系所承担的未保险协方差；定量模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1) 个体最优去风险与集体韧性存在分离，从高风险供应商的重新配置会推高替代品需求；2) 若产能稀缺或替代品加载于同一系统性因子，均衡价格可能侵蚀甚至逆转风险降低效果；3) 风险增强型维纳分解将贸易效应分为贸易创造、贸易条件再分配和引致风险三个渠道；4) 在广泛采购且替代品充裕时，引致风险渠道影响较小，但对关键投入品和高风险供应商集群而言是一阶效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将风险相关性纳入基于关系的贸易一般均衡分析；提出风险增强型维纳分解框架；揭示了个体去风险决策与集体韧性之间的内在张力机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估制裁、出口管制和友岸外包政策效果提供了理论工具；警示政策制定者：单纯从高风险供应商分散采购可能因价格效应而适得其反；为关键供应链风险管理提供分析框架。

title: How Resilient Were Emerging Market Economies Through the 2022-23 U.S. Monetary Tightening Cycle?
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: How Resilient Were Emerging Market Economies Through the 2022-23 U.S. Monetary Tightening Cycle?

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The cross-border spillover effects of shifts in U.S. monetary policy have long been a focus of academics and policymakers alike. A common finding in the literature is that changes in the stance of U.S. monetary policy have sizable effects on economic activity and financial markets in emerging market economies (EMEs).

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了美国货币政策变动对新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的跨境溢出效应，指出文献普遍发现美国货币政策立场的变化对EMEs的经济活动和金融市场具有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 美国货币政策变动如何对新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的经济活动与金融市场产生跨境溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 学术与政策制定者长期关注美国货币政策对新兴经济体的跨境影响，但需要系统梳理现有文献的共识与机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨境溢出效应理论、国际货币政策传导机制
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理已有实证与理论研究
AI.findings: 美国货币政策立场的变动对新兴市场经济体的经济活动与金融市场具有显著的跨境溢出效应，这是文献中的普遍共识。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了美国货币政策对EMEs跨境溢出效应的理论机制与实证证据，明确了溢出效应的普遍性与重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场经济体的政策制定者提供了应关注美国货币政策变动的政策启示，有助于增强对跨境金融风险的前瞻性应对。

title: The Regional Specialization Trade-off
affiliations: University of Oxford

detail.title: The Regional Specialization Trade-off
detail.abstract: In 1950, highly specialized U.S. regions had higher per capita incomes than those with greater industrial diversity. Since then, however, the more specialized regions have grown persistently slower. I rationalize this novel finding in a dynamic multi-industry model featuring two opposing forces. On the one hand, specialization raises productivity via agglomeration economies. On the other hand, it increases exposure to sectoral shocks. Real factor adjustment costs and financial frictions make reallocation in response to shocks costly and long-lasting. Disciplined by U.S. Census data, the model explains half of the observed relationship between initial specialization and subsequent growth, with financial frictions accounting for more than half of this adverse effect. A constrained-efficient planner allocation reveals that less specialization can raise welfare by reducing a region’s exposure to industry-specific downturns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国区域专业化与经济增长之间的关系，发现1950年专业化程度高的地区起初收入更高，但随后增长更慢。作者通过动态多产业模型解释了这一现象，认为专业化虽提升生产率，但也增加对行业冲击的暴露，而调整成本和金融摩擦加剧了负面效应。
AI.research_question: 美国区域专业化程度与长期经济增长之间的关系是什么？为什么最初更专业化的地区后来增长更慢？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为专业化通过集聚经济提升生产率，但历史上专业化地区后续增长却更慢。这一矛盾现象缺乏系统性解释，需要理论框架来阐明其背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态多产业模型，包含两种对立力量：（1）集聚经济带来的生产率提升；（2）行业冲击暴露增加带来的风险。引入实际要素调整成本和金融摩擦，使冲击后的资源再配置变得昂贵且持久。
AI.method: 构建动态多产业理论模型，利用美国人口普查数据进行结构化估计与校准，量化模型对数据的解释力度。
AI.findings: （1）1950年专业化程度高的地区收入更高，但后续增长更慢；（2）模型解释了观察到的初始专业化与后续增长关系的约一半；（3）金融摩擦解释了该负面效应的一半以上；（4）从约束有效规划者角度看，降低专业化程度可通过减少对特定行业衰退的暴露来提高社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合集聚经济与行业冲击暴露的两力权衡理论框架，揭示了金融摩擦在区域专业化与增长关系中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域产业政策制定提供了理论依据，表明适度降低专业化、促进产业多样化有助于增强区域经济韧性并提升长期福利。

title: Systemic Vacancy and Proactive Urban Regeneration in U.S. Municipalities

detail.title: Systemic Vacancy and Proactive Urban Regeneration in U.S. Municipalities
detail.abstract: American cities continue to spend millions responding to vacant buildings, yet many legal frameworks still treat vacancy as an isolated code-enforcement issue rather than a systemic governance challenge. This paper argues that local governments should address systemic vacancy as a broader governance, public safety, and public health problem. Using a Kansas municipal framework as a case study, the article examines how land-use authority, vacant property registration ordinances, tax foreclosure reform, land banking, ownership transparency, financing tools, and constitutional safeguards can be integrated into a more effective and equitable revitalization strategy. The paper proposes a governance-based approach that moves beyond punitive enforcement and emphasizes data-informed decision-making, accountability, and community-centered solutions for addressing long-term vacancy.

AI.tldr: 本文批评美国现行法律将空置建筑视为孤立的法规执行问题，主张地方政府应将其作为系统性治理、公共安全和公共卫生挑战来应对。研究以堪萨斯州为案例，整合土地使用权限、空置物业登记、税收 foreclosure 改革、土地银行、产权透明、融资工具及宪法保障等多维工具，提出以数据驱动、问责制和社区为中心的治理型战略，取代惩罚性执法。
AI.research_question: 美国地方政府如何将系统性空置建筑问题从孤立的法规执行问题，转变为更有效、更公平的治理、公共安全与公共卫生战略？
AI.motivation: 美国城市每年花费大量资金应对空置建筑，但现行法律框架仍将其视为孤立的法规执行问题，缺乏系统性治理视角，导致应对低效且不公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理型理论（governance-based approach）；将空置问题重新概念化为系统性治理挑战，而非孤立的法规执行问题。
AI.method: 案例分析：以堪萨斯州的市级法律框架为案例，考察土地使用权力、空置物业登记条例、税收拍卖改革、土地银行、产权透明度、融资工具和宪法保障等多重工具的整合运用。
AI.findings: 提出一种治理型方法，超越惩罚性执法，强调数据驱动决策、问责制和以社区为中心的解决方案，以应对长期空置问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空置建筑问题从孤立的法规执行范畴重新理论化为系统性治理、公共安全与公共卫生挑战，为城市治理研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国地方政府提供了一套整合土地使用、登记、税收改革、土地银行、产权透明及融资等工具的综合性政策框架，有助于制定更有效、更公平的城市复兴战略。

title: How Do Money and Tax Illusion Impact Long-Term Investments? An Experiment
affiliations: , Leibniz University Hannover, Leibniz University Hannover and Leibniz University Hannover

detail.title: How Do Money and Tax Illusion Impact Long-Term Investments? An Experiment
detail.abstract: The wealth effects of inflation and taxes on long-term savings, such as retirement investments, can be substantial. Nonetheless, individuals misperceive the impact of both taxes and inflation. Based on a unified theoretical framework, we distinguish between potential cognitive mechanisms underlying tax and inflation misperceptions and derive their implications for investment behavior. Using an incentivized, pre-registered online experiment, we test how these misperceptions influence individual investment decisions. In our baseline setting, inflation and taxation affect investment outcomes equivalently in real or after-tax terms. The results show that — even though all participants were informed about the effects of inflation and taxes on investment returns — investment distortions remain significant in both settings. Distortions driven by money illusion clearly exceed those caused by tax illusion. We find that both rational inattention and anchoring contribute to these distortions, with anchoring appearing more persistent in the inflation setting. Money illusion is therefore not only larger than tax illusion but also harder to undo. Money and tax illusion become more pronounced when future tax and inflation rates are uncertain. We then test the effectiveness of different communication strategies in this setting. Additional tabular information, visualizations, and attention nudges do not systematically reduce money or tax illusion. We show that requiring participants to view real or after-tax consequences before decision making is the most effective intervention; voluntary access has weaker effects, and later display does not systematically reduce the distortions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论框架和实验研究发现，即使参与者完全了解通胀和税收对投资回报的影响，货币幻觉和税收幻觉仍会显著扭曲投资决策，且货币幻觉比税收幻觉更大、更难以消除。提供额外信息或注意力提醒效果有限，最有效的是强制要求投资者在决策前查看实际或税后收益。
AI.research_question: 通胀和税收的认知偏差（货币幻觉与税收幻觉）如何影响个人的长期投资决策？不同沟通策略能否有效纠正这些偏差？
AI.motivation: 通胀和税收对长期储蓄（如退休投资）的财富效应巨大，但个体对两者的影响存在系统性误判，其背后的认知机制和后果尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一的认知偏差理论框架，区分了货币幻觉（对名义价值而非实际价值的关注）和税收幻觉（对税前而非税后收益的关注），并整合了理性疏忽（rational inattention）和锚定效应（anchoring）两种认知机制。
AI.method: 预注册的激励性在线实验。实验设置中通胀与税收对投资结果的影响等价（实际/税后收益相同），所有参与者均被告知通胀和税收的影响。
AI.findings: （1）即使完全知情，投资扭曲在通胀和税收条件下仍然显著；（2）货币幻觉导致的扭曲显著大于税收幻觉；（3）理性疏忽和锚定效应共同驱动扭曲，锚定在通胀条件下更持久；（4）未来税率和通胀率不确定时，两种幻觉均加剧；（5）额外表格、可视化、注意力提醒效果有限；（6）强制要求决策前查看实际/税后后果是最有效的干预，自愿查看效果较弱，事后展示无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币幻觉和税收幻觉提供了统一的认知机制解释（理性疏忽与锚定），揭示了两种幻觉在大小和可纠正性上的不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构设计退休储蓄干预措施提供了重要指导：强制披露实际/税后收益比提供额外信息或提醒更有效。
