AI.method: 政策分析、经济研究（具体方法未在摘要中详细说明）。
AI.findings: 未在摘要中明确呈现具体研究发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 从自由市场智库的立场出发，为理解税收政策对财富创造者的影响提供分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国税收政策改革提供政策建议，促进对财富创造者保护的认识。

title: Addressing Conflicts of Interest and Corruption in Indonesia's Energy Transition
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chr. Michelsen Institute (CMI), affiliation not provided to SSRN and Basel Institute on Governance

detail.title: Addressing Conflicts of Interest and Corruption in Indonesia's Energy Transition

declarations.ethicsApproval: Project registered with the Norwegian Data Authority (SIKT) ref. 502639 outlining consent procedures and data management plan.
declarations.funderStatement: Funded by FCDO, SDC, Norad, DANIDA, SIDA, BMZ, GIZ, and the Foreign Ministry of Finland.

detail.abstract: Conflicts of interest and corruption in Indonesia's political economy pose significant risks to its energy transition, including the Just Energy Transition Partnership. Existing legal and institutional frameworks are fragmented, inconsistently applied, and often fail to address the risk of state capture by powerful political and economic actors, especially in the extractive and energy sectors. The reliance on fossil fuel industries for political financing and the monopolistic nature of state-owned entities further complicate the shift to a low- or no-carbon system, despite the country's ambitious renewable energy targets. Potential pathways to greater anti-corruption resilience lie in improvements to beneficial ownership transparency and strengthening regulation, monitoring, and sanctioning of conflict of interest violations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度尼西亚政治经济中的利益冲突与腐败问题对其能源转型（包括公正能源转型伙伴关系）构成的重大风险，指出法律和制度框架碎片化、执行不力，以及化石燃料行业政治融资和国企垄断等障碍，并提出了通过提高受益所有权透明度、加强监管与制裁等途径增强反腐韧性的建议。
AI.research_question: 印尼政治经济中的利益冲突与腐败如何影响其能源转型进程，特别是公正能源转型伙伴关系的实施？
AI.motivation: 印尼虽设定了雄心勃勃的可再生能源目标，但腐败和利益冲突可能严重阻碍其能源转型，现有研究对此系统性风险关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家俘获理论、政治经济学中的寻租与腐败理论、能源转型治理理论。
AI.method: 定性分析，基于对印尼法律与制度框架、政治经济结构的文献梳理与案例研究。
AI.findings: 印尼现有法律和制度框架碎片化、执行不一致，无法有效防止政治经济精英俘获国家；化石燃料行业对政治融资的依赖以及国有企业的垄断地位进一步阻碍低碳转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将腐败与利益冲突分析系统性地纳入能源转型治理研究，揭示了国家俘获在阻碍发展中国家能源转型中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼及其他类似发展中国家提供了增强能源转型反腐韧性的政策路径，包括提高受益所有权透明度、加强利益冲突违规的监管与制裁。

title: Social Media Exposure and the Size of the Welfare State
affiliations: University of Granada and Universidad de Granada

detail.title: Social Media Exposure and the Size of the Welfare State
detail.abstract: We study how strategically produced misinformation about the effectiveness of public spending shapes voters' support for redistribution. A profit-maximizing media platform amplifies misleading content, and voters differ both in income and in their ability to detect this content. Two political parties then compete on a tax rate and on a sanction against the platform. We show that the resulting welfare state can be much smaller than what a fully informed electorate would choose. The gap is largest in more unequal societies, where regulation must work harder before it bites. We also find that allowing parties to choose the regulatory sanction freely can partially correct the distortion, since voters tend to demand strong regulation once they value the public good. The correction is partial: the equilibrium tax rate moves closer to the unbiased benchmark than under exogenous regulation, but remains strictly below it. Moreover, even this partial correction is fragile. Whenever regulating the platform is politically costly for the proposing party, through hostile media coverage, lost campaign donations, or enforcement frictions, parties hold back on regulation, and the welfare state shrinks again. The contraction then reflects not what voters want but what the political system is able to deliver. A further consequence is that, under costly regulation, two societies that share every parameter except their level of income inequality can end up with very different welfare states. More equal societies still benefit from the corrective effect of regulation, while more unequal ones do not, so that inequality determines whether a society can reach the redistributive outcome at all.

AI.tldr: 本文研究策略性生产的关于公共支出效力的错误信息如何影响选民对再分配政策的支持。利润最大化的媒体平台放大误导性内容，而选民在收入和识别能力上存在差异。两党就税率和针对平台的监管制裁展开竞争。研究发现，由此产生的福利国家规模可能远小于信息完全充分的选民所选择的结果，且在不平等程度更高的社会中差距更大。允许政党自由选择监管制裁可部分纠正扭曲，但这种纠正是脆弱的——当监管对提出方有政治成本时，福利国家规模会再次缩小，且不平等程度决定了社会能否达到再分配结果。
AI.research_question: 策略性生产的错误信息如何通过媒体平台放大，影响选民对再分配政策的支持，以及政治竞争如何塑造最终的福利国家规模？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中普遍存在关于公共支出效力的错误信息（如"福利依赖"等叙事），这些信息由利益相关方策略性生产并通过媒体放大，可能系统性扭曲选民对再分配的态度，进而影响民主社会的福利国家规模。然而现有文献对这一机制及其政治经济后果的理论分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息政治经济学、错误信息传播模型、政治竞争模型（政党竞争）、再分配政治理论、媒体经济学
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论模型）：构建包含媒体平台、选民（异质性收入和识别能力）、两个政党的多阶段博弈模型，分析均衡税率和监管制裁的决定。
AI.findings: (1) 策略性错误信息可导致福利国家规模远小于完全信息基准，不平等社会中差距最大；(2) 内生监管制裁可部分纠正扭曲，但纠正是部分的——均衡税率仍低于无偏基准；(3) 当监管有政治成本时，纠正效果消失，福利国家再次收缩；(4) 在存在监管成本的条件下，仅不平等程度不同的两个社会可能走向截然不同的福利国家规模——更平等的社会受益于监管的纠正效应，更不平等的社会则无法实现再分配结果。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将错误信息的策略性生产与媒体放大机制纳入再分配政治经济学分析框架，拓展了信息与制度互动的研究；(2) 揭示了"监管悖论"——选民在重视公共服务时会要求强监管，但监管的政治成本可能使政党退缩，导致均衡偏离选民偏好；(3) 提出了不平等程度与监管纠错能力之间的非线性关系，为不同社会再分配结果的差异提供了新解释。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 对政策制定者：警示了错误信息对民主再分配决策的系统性扭曲，特别是对高不平等社会的危害更大；(2) 对媒体监管设计：揭示了内生监管的局限性——自由选择监管制裁虽可部分纠偏，但政治成本易使纠偏失效，需设计更稳健的监管机制；(3) 对民主制度：提醒关注信息环境质量对再分配结果的根本性影响，尤其是媒体平台在塑造公共认知中的角色。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Bank Profitability: What Really Matters?
affiliations: , Prometeia, Prometeia SpA and Prometeia

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Bank Profitability: What Really Matters?
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between digitalization and bank performance by constructing a novel text-based index of digital engagement from the annual reports of more than 50 major banks worldwide over 2009-2023. Using natural language processing, we quantify banks' attention to digital themes and trace their evolution over time. We document a steady increase in digital engagement and find a positive association with profitability indexes. To refine the analysis, we employ large language models to classify AI-related paragraphs by use case and implementation stage. The results show that aggregate AI adoption is linked to profitability and cost reduction; the relation is stronger if AI is fully operational-particularly in customer support, client profiling, and internal process optimization-contributing to efficiency gains. By contrast, early-stage initiatives and applications in regulatory reporting or credit scoring still have to generate measurable returns and represent a tangible cost for the banking system. Overall, our findings highlight that the impact of digitalization depends not only on its intensity but also on the maturity and functional orientation of AI adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2009-2023年全球50多家主要银行的年报，利用自然语言处理和大语言模型，构建了数字化参与度指数，发现数字化和AI应用与银行盈利能力正相关，但效果取决于AI的成熟度和功能定位——成熟运营的AI（如客户支持、客户画像、内部流程优化）能显著提升效率，而早期阶段或特定领域（如监管报告、信用评分）的AI尚未产生可衡量的回报。
AI.research_question: 数字化与AI采用如何影响银行绩效？这种影响是否取决于AI的成熟度和功能定位？
AI.motivation: 银行业正经历深刻的数字化转型，但现有研究缺乏对数字化参与度的精确度量，也未区分不同成熟度和功能定位的AI对银行绩效的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化战略与组织绩效理论；技术采纳与成熟度模型；资源基础观（RBV）
AI.method: 基于50多家全球主要银行2009-2023年年报的文本分析；利用NLP构建数字化参与度指数；使用大语言模型（LLM）对AI相关段落进行用例和实施阶段分类；回归分析检验数字化/AI与银行绩效的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 银行的数字化参与度在样本期内稳步增长；2. 数字化参与度与盈利能力正相关；3. 整体AI采用与盈利能力及成本降低相关；4. 完全运营的AI（特别是客户支持、客户画像、内部流程优化）对效率提升作用更强；5. 早期阶段的AI项目以及监管报告、信用评分等领域的应用尚未产生可衡量的回报，反而带来成本负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于年报文本的数字化参与度量化方法；2. 首次区分了AI采用的不同成熟度和功能定位对银行绩效的异质性影响；3. 丰富了数字化战略与银行绩效关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行管理者提供了数字化投入优先级建议——优先推动成熟运营的AI应用，特别是客户支持、画像和内部流程优化领域；2. 提醒银行对早期AI项目和特定领域（如监管报告、信用评分）的投资需谨慎评估回报；3. 为监管机构和投资者评估银行数字化战略提供了分析框架。

title: Horseshoe meets Knockout Filter
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Horseshoe meets Knockout Filter
detail.abstract: The knockoff filter of Barber and Candès (2015) and Candès et al. (2018) controls the false discovery rate (FDR) in finite samples by constructing synthetic features that are exchangeable with the originals under the null. This is a genuine achievement, but it carries three costs that are rarely accounted for: the model-X variant conditions its guarantee on a known covariate law PX; the procedure returns a bare selected set rather than a posterior; and its operating point is an exogenous level q rather than a risk-optimal threshold. We show, in theory and through empirics, that horseshoe shrinkage equipped with the moderate-deviation threshold tcrit = p log(πn/2) dominates the knockoff filter on the axes that matter for scientific discovery. The Carvalho-PolsonScott log-pole and super-efficiency bounds are the finite-sample precursors of an asymptotically-Bayes-optimal-under-sparsity testing rule whose threshold is derived by integrated-risk minimisation and adapts to unknown sparsity through the global scale. We further place horseshoe selection within the mixture-envelope hierarchical duality of Polson and Scott (2016), which supplies a proximal, trend-filtering-ready dual that the knockoff construction lacks. Making the latent-variable representation explicit shows the horseshoe and trend filtering to be one Gaussian scale-mixture family differing only in whether coordinates or their differences are shrunk; we prove the knockoff construction has no structured analogue and collapses on the near-singular trend-filtering basis. Empirically, across independent and autoregressive designs the horseshoe controls FDR at the nominal level while delivering up to 5.5× the power of knockoff+ and detecting signals where knockoff+ has none, with the advantage widening under dependence; it is essentially deterministic (selection-set coefficient of variation 4% versus 137% for re-drawn knockoffs, which return the empty set 62% of the time on identical data); in a trend-filtering change-point task it recovers 97% of the change-points at controlled FDR while the knockoff filter, defeated by the near-singular step basis, detects none; and on a real, strongly collinear design it recovers a quarter of the planted signals at controlled FDR while the equicorrelated knockoff construction makes no discoveries. The one axis on which knockoffs lead is finite-sample validity; everything else, the horseshoe wins.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，马蹄铁收缩方法配合中等偏差阈值在统计功效、稳定性、对依赖结构的适应性等多个维度上全面优于knockoff滤波器，后者仅在有限样本有效性这一个维度上领先。
AI.research_question: 马蹄铁（horseshoe）收缩方法能否在科学发现的关键维度上优于knockoff滤波器？
AI.motivation: Knockoff滤波器虽然实现了有限样本下的错误发现率（FDR）控制，但存在三大代价：对已知协变量分布的依赖、仅返回裸选集而无后验信息、依赖外生设定的阈值q而非风险最优阈值。本文试图证明马蹄铁收缩可以克服这些局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: Carvalho-Polson-Scott对数极点和超效率界（有限样本先驱）、Polson和Scott（2016）的混合包络层次对偶性、高斯尺度混合族理论、贝叶斯最优稀疏检验理论。
AI.method: 理论推导与实证对比。理论部分：推导中等偏差阈值tcrit = p log(πn/2)的积分风险最小化性质，揭示马蹄铁选择与趋势滤波的统一高斯尺度混合族结构。实证部分：在独立设计、自相关设计、趋势滤波变点检测和真实强共线设计上进行对比实验。
AI.findings: (1) 马蹄铁在独立和自相关设计下以标称水平控制FDR，功效是knockoff+的5.5倍；(2) 马蹄铁选择集变异系数4% vs knockoff的137%，knockoff有62%概率返回空集；(3) 趋势滤波变点检测中，马蹄铁以受控FDR恢复97%变点，knockoff零检测；(4) 强共线真实数据中，马蹄铁恢复25%植入信号，knockoff零发现。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 证明马蹄铁选择是对稀疏性自适应的渐近贝叶斯最优检验规则；(2) 揭示马蹄铁与趋势滤波同属一个高斯尺度混合族，仅在于收缩坐标还是差分；(3) 证明knockoff构造缺乏结构化类比，在近奇异趋势滤波基上崩溃。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科学发现提供优于knockoff的变量选择工具：更高的统计功效、更强的稳定性、对依赖结构的鲁棒性，且无需已知协变量分布和外生阈值。

title: Quasi-Linear Means and Monotone Comparative Statics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Quasi-Linear Means and Monotone Comparative Statics
detail.abstract: We unify two intellectual traditions in the foundations of choice under uncertainty that have, surprisingly, never been written down together. The first is the 1930s Italian axiomatic theory of the mean as a certainty equivalent (Chisini 1929, Nagumo 1930, Kolmogorov 1930, de Finetti 1931), extended in the 1990s by Muliere, Parmigiani, Scarsini, Petrone, and the Bayesian-robustness school of Cifarelli, Regazzini, Fortini, and Ruggeri. The second is the 1990s American theory of monotone comparative statics (Topkis 1978, 1998; Milgrom and Shannon 1994; Athey 1995, 2002). We prove that Athey’s single-crossing condition paired with the monotone likelihood ratio (MLR) is the parametric comparative-statics dual of de Finetti’s quasi-linear-mean characterization. Where de Finetti axiomatizes the certainty-equivalent operator Mφ(F) = φ −1 ( R φ dF), Athey characterizes when Mφ(F(·; θ)) is monotone in θ. The bridge is the Whitt-Karlin-Rinott uniform conditional stochastic order: MLR is equivalent to monotonicity of every conditional certainty equivalent. Parallel results follow for inverse stochastic dominance with the dual cone of n-monotone utilities, and for the rank-dependent (Yaari-Chew) extension: the maximal class of universallyMLR-preserving distortions is characterized by three pointwise conditions on log α ′ corresponding exactly to the three monotonicity consequences of MLR (FOSD shift, reverse-hazard-rate, hazard-rate); the Beta-CDF cone is a strict sub-cone. Three further extensions complete the picture: a joint HLP-Pratt and Athey comparative statics on the certainty-equivalent surface; a multivariate Athey synthesis via Karlin-Rinott; and a characterization of MLR-preservation for generative transports via a single sign condition on the transport Hamiltonian Hθ = ∂yvθ +vθρθ. The Cifarelli-Regazzini concentration function is the unifying coordinate: the Yaari distortion is the concentration function it produces, and any cdf-functional perturbation π(θ) ∝ h(Π0(θ))π0(θ) of a baseline prior preserves the entire predictive synthesis. Five of the six concrete problems we identify are resolved; one is largely resolved.

AI.tldr: 本文统一了20世纪30年代意大利的均值公理化传统（de Finetti的拟线性均值）与20世纪90年代美国的单调比较静态理论（Athey的单交叉条件），证明Athey条件与MLR的配对是de Finetti拟线性均值特征的对偶。通过Whitt-Karlin-Rinott一致条件随机序建立桥梁，并扩展到逆随机占优、秩依赖扩展、多变量合成等问题，最终以Cifarelli-Regazzini集中函数作为统一坐标。
AI.research_question: 如何统一意大利均值公理化传统（de Finetti拟线性均值）与美国单调比较静态理论（Athey单交叉条件），并建立两者之间的对偶关系？
AI.motivation: 两个在不确定性选择基础理论中重要的知识传统——1930年代意大利学派的均值作为确定性等价的公理化理论，与1990年代美国的单调比较静态理论——从未被共同表述过。将它们统一能揭示深层结构联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Chisini-Nagumo-Kolmogorov-de Finetti的拟线性均值公理化；Topkis-Milgrom-Shannon-Athey的单调比较静态理论；Whitt-Karlin-Rinott的一致条件随机序；似然比（MLR）序；逆随机占优；Yaari-Chew秩依赖效用理论；Cifarelli-Regazzini集中函数。
AI.method: 理论统一与对偶证明：证明Athey的单交叉条件配对MLR是de Finetti拟线性均值特征的对偶；通过Whitt-Karlin-Rinott一致条件随机序建立桥梁；扩展到n-单调效用的对偶锥、Yaari扭曲、多变量Karlin-Rinott合成、生成输运的Hamiltonian符号条件等。
AI.findings: 1) Athey的单交叉条件+MLR是de Finetti拟线性均值特征的对偶；2) MLR等价于每个条件确定性等价的单调性；3) 给出了最大类普遍MLR保持扭曲的三个逐点条件；4) Beta-CDF锥是严格子锥；5) 联合HLP-Pratt与Athey比较静态；6) 多变量Athey合成；7) MLR保持的生成输运通过Hamiltonian符号条件刻画；8) Cifarelli-Regazzini集中函数是统一坐标。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将意大利均值公理化传统与美国单调比较静态理论统一，建立了两种传统之间的对偶关系；扩展了MLR保持扭曲的特征刻画；提出了多变量Athey合成；建立了生成输运的MLR保持条件；以集中函数为统一坐标整合了多个分支。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不确定性下的决策理论提供了统一的分析框架；为贝叶斯稳健性分析提供了新的工具（集中函数坐标）；为比较静态分析提供了更一般的条件；六个具体问题中五个已解决，一个基本解决。

title: HSR and the Quality of Merger Policy
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School

detail.title: HSR and the Quality of Merger Policy
detail.abstract:
The Hart-Scott-Rodino Act of 1976  (HSR) required pre-merger notification and review of certain proposed acquisitions.  The statute changed the timing of most, but not all, government challenges from post-acquisition to pre-acquisition. For pre-acquisition challenges the Agencies have no data about post-acquisition performance, so evaluation must be made on the basis of predicted effects. This increased the role of economic modeling in merger analysis. The Clayton Act actually contemplated that development, even though HSR itself was not foreseen by its drafters. By using the language “where the effect … may be substantially to lessen competition,” Section 7 of the Clayton Act invited the use of probable effects to predict merger harm.  The statutory language also made intent irrelevant.

Pre-acquisition evaluation also permits the use of much less intrusive remedies dominated by temporary restraining orders and prohibitory injunctions, rather than the costly divestitures that accounted for most pre-HSR merger remedies. Many mergers are terminated upon a district court’s issuance of a preliminary injunction. This is particularly important because a preliminary injunction can issue long before a full trial on the merits resolves all essential issues.

HSR was not intended to change substantive standards of illegality. Nor was it intended to raise an additional non-substantive bar to merging.  The HSR process, which is costly to participants, was intended to be “enforcement neutral.” It should neither make socially beneficial mergers more risky nor shield harmful mergers from challenge.  Congress itself stated that the process should “neither deter nor impede consummation of the vast majority of mergers and acquisitions.”  To that end, the HSR legislation authorized the Agencies to require only information that was “necessary and appropriate to enable [them] to determine” whether a proposed acquisition was lawful.

Assuming that a significant subset of mergers are harmful, identifying this subset ex ante with some accuracy can be very valuable. Intuitively, one might think that pre-acquisition evaluation is less accurate than post-acquisition evaluation.  Predicted results are never as accurate as actual ones.  In fact, as this paper argues, the differences are not as substantial as one might think.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1976年《哈特-斯科特-罗迪诺法案》（HSR）对并购反垄断审查的影响，指出该法案将大部分政府挑战从并购后转为并购前，虽增加了经济建模的作用，但并未改变实质性违法标准或增加非实质性障碍，且并购前评估的准确性并未如直觉所认为的那样远低于并购后评估。
AI.research_question: HSR法案如何改变并购反垄断审查的时间节点及其对评估准确性的影响？并购前评估与并购后评估的准确性差异是否显著？
AI.motivation: HSR法案将并购审查从并购后提前至并购前，这改变了评估依据（从实际绩效转为预测效果），但直觉上认为并购前预测不如并购后实际观察准确。本文旨在论证这种准确性差异并不像直觉想象的那样显著。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《克莱顿法案》第7条中"效果……可能实质性减少竞争"的措辞，该语言预设了基于可能效果的预测分析，且使意图因素无关紧要。
AI.method: 法律与经济学理论分析，通过比较并购前评估（基于预测效果）与并购后评估（基于实际效果）的差异，论证两者准确性的实际差距。
AI.findings: 并购前评估（基于预测效果）的准确性并非如直觉所认为的那样远低于并购后评估（基于实际效果）；并购前评估允许使用较温和的救济措施（临时限制令、禁止性禁令）而非代价高昂的剥离；HSR旨在"执行中性"，不应使有益并购风险增加，也不应屏蔽有害并购受挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 从法律与经济学视角澄清了并购前评估的准确性认知偏差，揭示了HSR法案与《克莱顿法案》第7条在预测性评估上的内在一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构和市场主体提供了对HSR审查制度的理性认识——并购前审查的准确性并非显著低于并购后审查，且其温和的救济措施更具效率优势；同时强调了HSR应保持"执行中性"，不应过度增加交易成本。

reference: Romanian Journal of European Affairs, Vol. 26, No. 1, June 2026
title: National Policy Integration and Private Governance: SDG Implementation in Romania

detail.title: National Policy Integration and Private Governance: SDG Implementation in Romania

publicationDetails.detailsText: Romanian Journal of European Affairs, Vol. 26, No. 1, June 2026

detail.abstract: In the context of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, this paper investigates how Romania implements the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and conducts an analysis at two levels of governance, namely national policy integration and private governance. It finds that these two levels have a limited interaction, something which could be improved in the future, given the significant role of non-state actors in the achievement of the SDGs. Furthermore, the study identifies that the national policy integration level displays some policy interlinkages, thus avoiding the trap of working in silos, which could hinder the implementation of the goals. While progress has been achieved in terms of data access, organisational structures and policy formulation, more can be done to improve policy coherence, especially concerning SDG 13 on climate action for which a case study was conducted herein. In our view, contradictory policy signals could jeopardise the implementation of this SDG. Along these lines, other risk factors for the 2030 Agenda, in general, are related to the tendency to cherry-pick certain SDGs to focus on, rather than take a holistic approach and integrate all of them across different policy domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了罗马尼亚如何在国家政策整合和私人治理两个层面实施联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs），发现两个层面互动有限，国家层面存在政策关联但需加强一致性，尤其是气候行动（SDG 13）面临政策信号矛盾风险，整体上存在选择性实施而非整体推进的问题。
AI.research_question: 罗马尼亚如何在国家政策整合与私人治理两个层面实施联合国可持续发展目标？两个治理层面之间如何互动？
AI.motivation: 在2030年可持续发展议程背景下，需要理解不同国家如何将SDGs纳入治理体系，尤其是国家政策与私人治理之间的互动关系，以及政策连贯性对SDG实施的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层次治理理论、政策整合理论、私人治理理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，以罗马尼亚为研究对象，分析国家政策整合与私人治理两个层面，并对SDG 13（气候行动）进行专项案例研究。
AI.findings: 1）国家政策整合与私人治理两个层面互动有限；2）国家政策整合层面存在一定的政策关联，避免了各自为政；3）数据获取、组织结构和政策制定方面有进展，但政策连贯性仍需加强；4）SDG 13面临矛盾的政策信号风险；5）存在选择性实施SDGs而非整体推进的倾向。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国家政策整合与私人治理两个层面在SDG实施中的互动关系及其局限性，丰富了多层次治理视角下可持续发展政策实施的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为罗马尼亚及其他国家改进SDG实施提供了政策建议，包括加强治理层面间的互动、提升政策连贯性、避免选择性实施SDGs、以及更加关注气候行动领域的政策一致性。

title: The Law and Economics of the Ai Excuse: Liability, Perception Bias, and the Case for Epistemic Calibration

detail.title: The Law and Economics of the Ai Excuse: Liability, Perception Bias, and the Case for Epistemic Calibration
detail.abstract: Large language models err persuasively, distorting users' beliefs about AI reliability through an architecturally induced perception bias. We model the interaction between a developer, an LLM, and a boundedly rational human decision-maker, and prove three results. First, Liability Separation Failure (Theorems 1 and 1′): no pure liability regime-strict human liability, strict developer liability, or negligence-can implement the first-best across the full range of AI capabilities. Second, Paradox of Human Oversight (Section 5): a reasonableness standard collapses into the biased decision rule, rendering mandated oversight structurally hollow. Third, Restoration Theorems (Theorems 2 and 3): a Calibrated Reliability Score mandate, paired with conditional liability, restores the first-best. Embedded in a Grossman-Hart-Moore framework, perception bias shifts optimal asset ownership toward the AI developer-a new verticalintegration prediction-and a CRS mandate substitutes for ownership reallocation.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型通过架构性感知偏差说服用户，扭曲其对AI可靠性的信念。本文证明：无责任制度可实现最优；人为监督标准实质空洞；校准可靠性评分（CRS）加条件性责任可恢复最优。嵌入GHM框架后，感知偏差使最优资产所有权向开发者转移（纵向一体化新预测），CRS可替代所有权重新配置。
AI.research_question: 在LLM存在架构性感知偏差（说服用户高估其可靠性）的情况下，如何设计法律责任制度与资产所有权结构以实现社会最优结果？
AI.motivation: LLM会以说服性方式出错，扭曲用户对AI可靠性的信念，引发责任归属与治理难题。现有法律框架（严格责任、过失责任）在此类"感知偏差"下可能失效，需要理论建模加以厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全契约理论（Grossman-Hart-Moore框架）、行为经济学中的感知偏差、法律责任经济学（严格责任、过失责任、合理性标准）。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与数学证明。建模开发者、LLM与有界理性人类决策者三方交互，证明多个定理。
AI.findings: (1) 责任分离失败：纯责任制度均无法实现最优；(2) 人为监督悖论：合理性标准在感知偏差下形同虚设；(3) 恢复定理：CRS加条件性责任可恢复最优；(4) 感知偏差使最优资产所有权向开发者倾斜（纵向一体化预测），CRS可替代所有权重配。
AI.theory_contributions: 将感知偏差纳入不完全契约框架，证明其会改变最优资产所有权结构（向开发者转移），并表明信息披露制度（CRS）可作为所有权重新配置的替代机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI治理提供具体政策建议：应采用校准可靠性评分（CRS）加条件性责任制度，而非单纯依赖人为监督或任何单一责任制度；提示资产所有权（纵向一体化）决策需考虑LLM的感知偏差效应。

title: The Generative AI Learning Penalty: Evidence from Chinese Secondary Education
affiliations: Stockholm University - Institute for International Economic Studies (IIES), The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong and University of Hong Kong

detail.title: The Generative AI Learning Penalty: Evidence from Chinese Secondary Education

declarations.ethicsApproval: The data collection and use for this project were approved by the Human Research Ethics Committee of the University of Hong Kong (reference number: EA260129). The study involves analysis of administrative school records and a student survey.

detail.abstract: Using 30 months of panel data on 26,811 Chinese students in grades 7-12, we study how generative AI a¤ects homework productivity and learning. The data combine monthly closed-book exams, high-school and college entrance exams, and homework scores and completion time across nine subjects. We exploit staggered AI adoption in a di¤erence-in-di¤erences design. AI adoption raises homework scores by 18% and reduces completion time by 30%, but lowers monthly exam scores by 20% within six months. High-stakes entrance-exam scores fall by 18 and 24%, with the full penalty emerging only after about two years. The losses are largest in social science subjects, followed by STEM and languages, and are especially large for junior students, high-achieving students, and boys. The learning losses are concentrated among roughly 80% of AI users whose behavior is consistent with homework outsourcing, as indicated by exceptionally short homework completion time coupled with high homework scores. AI users who maintain similar homework completion time as non-AI users experience small learning losses. The authors have no sources of research support, …nancial relationships, or other potential con ‡icts of interest to disclose. The data collection and usage of this project were approved by the Human Research Ethics Committee of the University of Hong Kong with the following reference number:

AI.tldr: 基于中国26,811名中学生的30个月面板数据，使用双重差分法发现：生成式AI的使用使家庭作业分数提高18%、完成时间减少30%，但6个月内月考成绩下降20%，两年后高考/中考成绩下降18-24%。损失主要集中在将AI用于"作业外包"的学生（约占80%），且对社会科学、初中生、高成就学生和男生影响最大。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响学生的作业效率和学习效果？
AI.motivation: AI工具（如ChatGPT）在中小学生中广泛使用，但缺乏长期、大规模的因果证据来评估其对真实学习成果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 作业外包假说（Homework Outsourcing Hypothesis）：学生利用AI替代自身努力完成作业，短期提升作业表现但损害长期学习积累。
AI.method: 利用AI在不同学校/班级逐步推广的准自然实验，采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），使用30个月面板数据（含月考、中考/高考、作业分数和完成时间）。
AI.findings: ①AI使作业分数提高18%、完成时间减少30%；②6个月内月考成绩下降20%；③两年后中考/高考成绩下降18-24%；④社会科学损失最大，STEM和语言学科次之；⑤初中生、高成就学生、男生损失更大；⑥约80%的AI用户表现为"作业外包"模式（极短完成时间+高作业分），学习损失集中于此群体；⑦保持类似完成时间的AI用户学习损失小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供大规模、长期因果证据揭示生成式AI在学习中的"双刃剑"效应——表面效率提升掩盖深层学习损失，并识别出"作业外包"行为机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示教育政策制定者、学校和家长：AI辅助作业可能损害长期学习效果，需引导学生合理使用AI而非完全外包思考过程，尤其是在社会科学和人文学科中。

title: LLM-Powered Virtual Population for Demand Simulation and Pricing
affiliations: and

detail.title: LLM-Powered Virtual Population for Demand Simulation and Pricing
detail.abstract: We develop an LLM-powered virtual population model that simulates demand for pricing decisions, in settings where products are described by rich unstructured information, such as text descriptions and images, and where decision makers need not only mean-demand predictions but also uncertainty estimates for counterfactual prices. Our model represents exposed customers as draws from a finite mixture of customer personas. For each persona, product, and candidate price, an LLM elicits a persona-level purchase probability using both structured persona information and unstructured product information. These probabilities are aggregated through calibrated mixture weights to form a predictive distribution of aggregate demand. The resulting simulator can evaluate counterfactual prices under various pricing objectives, including expected revenue and risk-aware criteria such as conditional value at risk. We test the framework on an online H&M fashion dataset with product descriptions and images. The calibrated LLM-based simulator achieves the best overall predictive performance among the models considered, and supports sample-efficient pricing decisions. Our framework provides a practical way to use LLMs as demand simulators for products with limited historical demand data but rich product information. By producing a full predictive demand distribution rather than only a point forecast, it enables managers to compare candidate prices, quantify demand uncertainty, and choose prices that target either average-case revenue or risk-aware objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于LLM的虚拟人口模型，模拟定价决策中的需求。该模型利用有限混合模型和LLM估计每个 personas 在不同价格下的购买概率，并通过校准的混合权重聚合，形成聚合需求的预测分布。该框架能评估反事实价格下的期望收益和风险意识指标（如CVaR），在H&M时尚数据集上取得了最佳预测性能，支持高效定价决策。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型构建需求模拟器，在具有丰富非结构化信息（文本描述和图片）但历史需求数据有限的产品定价场景中，提供需求预测和不确定性估计？
AI.motivation: 传统定价需求模型依赖结构化数据和大量历史销售记录，难以处理以文本描述和图像为特征的产品（如时尚品），且通常只提供点预测，缺乏不确定性量化。LLM能够处理非结构化产品信息，但如何系统性地用于定价决策的需求模拟仍是一个开放问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限混合模型（Finite Mixture Model）、LLM驱动的Persona级购买概率估计、校准的混合权重聚合、条件风险价值（CVaR）等风险意识定价准则。
AI.method: 将受试客户表示为来自有限混合分布的样本，每个persona对应一个LLM，接收结构化persona信息和非结构化产品信息（文本+图像），估计persona-产品-价格三元组的购买概率；通过校准的混合权重聚合各persona的购买概率，形成聚合需求的预测分布；在H&M在线时尚数据集上验证框架有效性。
AI.findings: 校准后的LLM需求模拟器在所有对比模型中取得最佳整体预测性能；能够支持样本高效的定价决策；不仅提供点预测，还能生成完整的需求预测分布，使管理者能够比较候选价格、量化需求不确定性，并根据均值收益或风险意识目标（如CVaR）选择最优价格。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将LLM作为需求模拟器的系统框架，将LLM的常识推理能力与有限混合模型结合，实现了对具有非结构化产品信息的定价决策进行反事实需求预测和不确定性量化，拓展了定价理论在富信息环境下的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商和时尚零售等行业提供了一种实用的定价决策工具，特别是在新产品上市或历史数据稀缺时，能利用产品文本和图像信息进行需求模拟；支持风险意识定价（如CVaR优化），帮助管理者在不确定性下做出更稳健的定价决策。

title: Incorporating Price Limits into Deep Learning for Stock Return Prediction in the Chinese A-Share Market
affiliations: and

detail.title: Incorporating Price Limits into Deep Learning for Stock Return Prediction in the Chinese A-Share Market
detail.abstract: Daily price limits in the Chinese A-share market impose regulatory bounds on observed daily stock returns, producing a truncated return distribution in which limit-hit observations are censored realizations of a latent return. Standard deep learning models ignore the bounded nature of observed returns and treat all observations as uncensored in the loss function. This paper proposes two components to address this limitation: a bounded sigmoid output layer that constrains predictions to the feasible return interval, and a Student-t Tobit loss function that treats limit-hit observations as censored realizations of a latent return. The two components are evaluated in an ablation framework across four architectures (MLP, LSTM, TCN, and Transformer) on the full Chinese A-share universe from 2019 to 2026. The results show that the bounded output layer helps cross-sectional ranking on limit-hit observations specifically, but does not improve overall performance on its own. The Student-t Tobit loss improves cross-sectional ranking performance over the MSE baseline in three out of four architectures, with the largest gain for MLP (Rank IC from 0.0390 to 0.0666), driven primarily by better performance on non-limit observations. When the two components are combined, performance improves over the baseline in all four architectures, though the combined method does not consistently surpass the Tobit loss alone.

AI.tldr: 针对中国A股市场日涨跌停板导致的收益截断问题，本文提出有界Sigmoid输出层和Student-t Tobit损失函数两种组件，在四种深度学习架构上验证其有效性，发现Tobit损失能显著提升排序性能，有界输出层对涨停样本有帮助，两者组合在所有架构上均优于基线。
AI.research_question: 如何设计深度学习模型以有效处理中国A股市场涨跌停板导致的收益率截断问题，从而更准确地预测和排序股票收益？
AI.motivation: 中国A股市场的日涨跌停板制度使得观测到的收益率分布被截断，触及涨跌停的观测是潜在真实收益的审查（censored）实现值。标准深度学习模型忽略了观测收益的有界性质，将所有观测视为未审查数据纳入损失函数，导致模型估计偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于截断回归（Tobit模型）理论，结合深度学习架构（MLP、LSTM、TCN、Transformer），提出有界Sigmoid输出层（将预测约束在可行收益区间）和Student-t Tobit损失函数（将涨跌停观测视为审查实现值）两种方法。
AI.method: 在2019-2026年中国A股全市场数据上，采用消融实验框架，对四种深度学习架构（MLP、LSTM、TCN、Transformer）分别评估有界输出层、Student-t Tobit损失函数及其组合的效果，以Rank IC为主要评价指标。
AI.findings: (1) 有界输出层仅对涨跌停样本的截面排序有帮助，但单独使用不提升整体表现；(2) Student-t Tobit损失在四种架构中的三种上优于MSE基线，MLP提升最大（Rank IC从0.0390升至0.0666），主要来自非涨跌停样本的改进；(3) 两组件组合在所有四种架构上均优于基线，但并未稳定超越单独使用Tobit损失的效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Tobit审查回归框架系统引入深度学习股票收益预测问题，针对中国A股涨跌停板制度提出了两种有效的模型组件，并通过消融实验揭示了各组件的作用机制和适用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化投资实务中处理涨跌停板数据提供了可直接使用的模型改进方案，Tobit损失函数简单易实现且能显著提升股票排序表现，尤其对MLP架构提升幅度最大，具有较高的应用价值。

title: Abel-Regularized Volterra Solvers for American Option Free Boundaries
affiliations: Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Abel-Regularized Volterra Solvers for American Option Free Boundaries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF-2019R1I1A3A03059382) and BK21 FOUR (No. 5120200913674).

detail.abstract: We present a computational framework for single-and coupled Americanstyle free-boundary problems governed by nonlinear weakly singular Volterra integral equations. The free boundary is parameterized using B-splines, reducing the global continuous problem to a low-dimensional residual system in coefficient space. An Abel-type product-integration scheme regularizes the local near-diagonal Volterra scaling, yielding a consistent residual quadrature and a well-scaled Jacobian assembly. The system is solved via a residualcorrection iteration using a hierarchy of automatic-differentiation-based full Jacobians and computationally efficient reduced Jacobian models. Numerical experiments on American puts, dividend-paying calls, and coupled choosertype contracts across standard and challenging parameter regimes demonstrate stable boundary reconstruction, accurate prices, and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于B样条参数化和Abel型乘积积分方案的数值框架，用于求解美式期权自由边界问题，在多种合约类型和参数条件下实现了稳定的边界重构、准确定价和计算效率。
AI.research_question: 如何高效且稳定地求解由非线性弱奇异Volterra积分方程控制的单资产和耦合美式自由边界问题？
AI.motivation: 美式期权自由边界问题在数学上具有挑战性，现有方法在数值稳定性、计算效率或精度方面存在不足，亟需一种统一的数值框架来有效处理这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性弱奇异Volterra积分方程、B样条参数化、Abel型乘积积分、残差校正迭代、自动微分
AI.method: 采用B样条参数化自由边界，将全局连续问题降为低维系数空间残差系统；使用Abel型乘积积分方案正则化近对角Volterra尺度；通过基于自动微分的全Jacobian与简化Jacobian模型进行残差校正迭代求解。
AI.findings: 在美国看跌期权、分红看涨期权和耦合选择者型合约的标准及挑战性参数数值实验中，该方法展现出稳定的边界重构、准确的定价结果和计算效率优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的数值框架，将美式自由边界问题系统性地转化为系数空间中的残差系统，并引入了新的正则化积分方案和层次化Jacobian求解策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融衍生品定价提供了一种稳定、准确且高效的计算工具，能够处理多种美式期权合约类型及复杂的参数场景。

title: Quiet Booms, Sudden Stops: The Volatility Credit Nexus
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, The University of Hong Kong and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Quiet Booms, Sudden Stops: The Volatility Credit Nexus
detail.abstract: Sudden stops are typically preceded by low volatility in both advanced and emerging market economies. Low volatility is an effective predictor of sudden stops, even after controlling for credit and growth. Moreover, a credit boom associated with low volatility is significantly more likely to end in a sudden stop. To account for these facts, we develop a quantitative model with recursive utility, stochastic volatility in productivity trends, and an occasionally binding loan-to-value credit constraint. The model replicates the dynamic patterns among volatility, credit and sudden stops in the data. Low volatility inflates the price of collateral, reduces concerns about a future binding constraint, and encourages borrowing. We show that both recursive preferences and stochastic volatility of trend shocks are essential for the collateral price effect of volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文发现突发停止（sudden stops）前通常伴随低波动性，且低波动性是突发停止的有效预测因子。通过构建包含递归效用、趋势随机波动率和偶尔约束的贷款价值比信贷约束的量化模型，解释了低波动性如何通过膨胀抵押品价格、降低对未来约束的担忧来鼓励借贷，最终导致突发停止。
AI.research_question: 波动性与突发停止（sudden stops）之间的关系是什么？低波动性如何预测和导致突发停止？
AI.motivation: 实证发现突发停止前通常伴随低波动性，且低波动性是比信贷和增长更有效的预测因子，但现有理论对此缺乏解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 递归效用（recursive utility）、趋势冲击的随机波动性（stochastic volatility in productivity trends）、偶尔约束的贷款价值比信贷约束（occasionally binding loan-to-value credit constraint）。
AI.method: 先进行实证分析（面板数据回归），再构建量化动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型进行数值模拟。
AI.findings: 低波动性通过膨胀抵押品价格、降低对未来约束的担忧来鼓励借贷；信贷繁荣伴随低波动性时更可能以突发停止告终；递归偏好和趋势冲击的随机波动性对抵押品价格效应至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上系统解释了波动性—信贷—突发停止之间的动态关系，揭示了低波动性通过抵押品价格渠道引发突发停止的机制，并强调了递归效用和随机波动性的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明低波动性环境可能是金融脆弱性的预警信号，政策制定者应关注波动性变化而非仅关注信贷扩张来防范突发停止风险。

title: The Economics of Regulating Tokenized Securities
affiliations: University of Oxford,  and University of Florida

detail.title: The Economics of Regulating Tokenized Securities
detail.abstract: We develop an economic model to study the effect of regulation on tokenized securities markets. Tokenizing a security does not exempt it from securities laws, so in our framework token issuers must choose a compliance policy that restricts trading. We characterize the resulting trade-off between regulatory stringency and financial market outcomes, and we derive three main results. First, tighter regulation reduces the liquidity of the tokenized market. Second, tokenization is not commercially viable for sufficiently strict regulation. Third, the tightest level of regulation that tokenization can withstand depends on the characteristics of the tokenized asset.

AI.tldr: 本文构建经济模型研究监管对代币化证券市场的影响。代币化证券仍需遵守证券法，因此代币发行方必须选择合规政策来限制交易。研究发现：第一，更严格的监管会降低代币化市场的流动性；第二，监管过严时代币化不具备商业可行性；第三，代币化所能承受的最严格监管水平取决于代币化资产的特征。
AI.research_question: 监管如何影响代币化证券市场？代币发行方如何在监管严格性与金融市场结果之间进行权衡？
AI.motivation: 代币化证券虽然采用区块链技术，但仍受证券法约束，因此需要研究监管合规政策对代币化市场的影响机制与效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文构建了一个经济模型，将代币发行方的合规政策选择与市场流动性、商业可行性等金融结果联系起来，刻画了监管严格性与市场表现之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 经济模型分析。
AI.findings: 1. 监管越严格，代币化市场的流动性越低；2. 当监管严格到一定程度时，代币化不再具有商业可行性；3. 代币化能承受的最严格监管水平取决于资产本身的特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管合规纳入代币化证券的经济分析框架，揭示了监管严格性与市场流动性、商业可行性之间的内在权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和市场参与者提供了代币化证券的监管政策设计参考，指出监管强度需与资产特征相匹配才能维持代币化的商业价值。

title: Uninitiated Obligation: Fictitious Capital, Deferred Labour, and Who Pays When It Ends
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Uninitiated Obligation: Fictitious Capital, Deferred Labour, and Who Pays When It Ends
detail.abstract: When a speculative price collapses, neoclassical theory says the lost value evaporates, and Minsky says it was transferred along the chain of prior transactions. Neither answer says what the lost quantity is. This paper argues, strictly within the labour theory of value, that the portion of a speculative price unanchored by completed production is an obligation whose substance is labour. To capitalise a claim on future surplus value is necessarily to presuppose the constant and variable capital of a production cycle that has not been initiated. From this single mechanism, the stuffing of an entire future commodity value W′ into present price, the paper derives the interior structure of the gap between price and value, the reason fictitious capital persists as long as it does and no longer, and the exact set of channels through which the obligation is redistributed when its container fails. The framework answers three questions Marx left open and states the conditions under which it would be false.

AI.tldr: 本文在劳动价值论框架内提出，投机价格中超出已完成生产锚定的部分，其实质是对未来剩余价值的劳动义务。通过将未来商品价值W′塞入当前价格这一机制，推导出价格与价值差距的内部结构、虚拟资本存续的时限，以及泡沫破裂时义务的再分配渠道。
AI.research_question: 投机价格崩溃时，损失的"数量"究竟是什么？其本质、结构、存续时限及再分配机制如何？
AI.motivation: 新古典理论认为投机泡沫破灭时价值蒸发，明斯基认为价值沿交易链转移，但两者均未明确"损失的量"究竟是什么。马克思提出了相关问题但未完全解答。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动价值论（Labour Theory of Value）；马克思的虚拟资本理论；未来剩余价值资本化机制。
AI.method: 纯粹的理论演绎和逻辑推导，严格在劳动价值论框架内进行概念分析。
AI.findings: (1) 投机价格中脱离已完成生产的部分本质上是劳动义务；(2) 将未来商品价值W′塞入当前价格是核心机制；(3) 推导出价格-价值差距的内部结构；(4) 解释了虚拟资本存续时限；(5) 明确了泡沫破裂时义务再分配的具体渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 回答了马克思留下的三个未解决问题；明确提出了投机价格中"损失的量"的劳动本质；完善了虚拟资本理论中关于存续时限和再分配机制的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解金融危机中价值损失的实质提供了理论工具；有助于识别和评估投机泡沫中的潜在风险；为政策制定者理解泡沫破裂后的财富再分配渠道提供了分析框架。

title: The Illusion of Competence: Title Inflation, Juniorization, and the Crisis in Cybersecurity Governance and ICT Auditing
affiliations: Cybersecurity Advisor & Implementor

detail.title: The Illusion of Competence: Title Inflation, Juniorization, and the Crisis in Cybersecurity Governance and ICT Auditing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent cybersecurity and IS audit consultant. The author declares no financial or personal relationships with any organization or individual that could have inappropriately influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this paper does not involve human subjects, patients, participant interviews, experiments, or private personal data. The analysis is based on publicly available information, published reports, regulatory materials, and publicly accessible job-market examples.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The global cybersecurity and ICT auditing ecosystem faces a critical structural crisis driven by the convergence of an acute talent shortage, aggressive corporate budget retrenchments, and the systematic juniorization of complex assurance roles. This paper provides a multidimensional analysis of the cybersecurity labor market, examining how unrealistic job descriptions, title inflation, and a cost-arbitrage-driven outsourcing model have compromised the integrity of ICT audits and cybersecurity governance. By contrasting hiring practices in India with those in the United States, the paper analyzes the experience disconnect, the credentialing arms race, the commoditization of governance, risk, and compliance functions through tool-centric hiring, and the resulting failure of policy and control design. It further examines the impact on audit quality, including checklist auditing, checklist fatigue, loss of professional skepticism, and the dangerous state of compliance illusion. The paper concludes with a framework for realigning expectations and restoring integrity to cybersecurity audit practice.

AI.tldr: 全球网络安全与ICT审计生态系统正面临结构性危机，表现为人才短缺、预算削减、岗位低龄化、职位通胀、外包模式泛滥等问题，导致审计质量下降、合规幻觉盛行。本文通过对比印度与美国招聘实践，分析了经验断层、认证军备竞赛、GRC职能商品化等关键挑战，并提出了恢复审计诚信的框架。
AI.research_question: 网络安全与ICT审计生态系统面临的结构性危机是什么？其成因、表现及对审计质量的影响如何？如何重建审计实践的诚信与有效性？
AI.motivation: 全球网络安全审计领域正经历人才短缺、预算削减、岗位低龄化三重压力叠加，导致审计质量严重下滑、合规形同虚设。作者旨在揭示这一系统性危机，并呼吁行业正视问题、重建标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学（人才供需失衡）、组织行为学（职业倦怠与专业怀疑缺失）、审计理论（检查表审计与合规幻觉）、全球化与外包理论（成本套利模式）。
AI.method: 多维分析框架，结合劳动力市场数据、招聘实践对比（印度 vs. 美国）、行业现象归纳与批判性分析。
AI.findings: ① 职位通胀与不切实际的职位描述加剧人才错配；② 成本套利驱动的外包模式导致经验断层；③ 认证军备竞赛替代了真实能力；④ GRC职能被工具化、商品化；⑤ 检查表审计与职业怀疑缺失导致合规幻觉；⑥ 控制设计与政策执行严重失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地整合了人才短缺、外包模式、职位通胀与审计质量下降之间的因果关系，提出了"合规幻觉"这一关键概念，并构建了结构性与行为性因素交织的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全审计行业提供了重建标准的行动框架，包括：重新定义岗位要求、恢复专业怀疑精神、改革认证体系、优化外包策略、强化控制设计质量等，对从业者、企业管理层及政策制定者具有重要参考价值。

title: The Role of Ecosystem Services in Supporting Rural Livelihoods Around Old Oyo National Park, Nigeria
affiliations: Federal University of Technology, Akure and Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA)

detail.title: The Role of Ecosystem Services in Supporting Rural Livelihoods Around Old Oyo National Park, Nigeria
detail.abstract: Ecosystem services play a critical role in supporting rural livelihoods, particularly in communities located around protected areas where dependence on natural resources remains high. This study examined the contribution of ecosystem services to rural livelihood sustainability in communities adjoining Old Oyo National Park, Nigeria. Specifically, the study identified key ecosystem resources utilized by local communities and assessed their importance in supporting household livelihoods and socioeconomic well-being. Primary data were collected through the administration of 384 structured questionnaires among residents of selected support-zone communities surrounding the park using a multistage sampling technique. Data were analysed using descriptive and inferential statistical methods. The findings revealed that respondents derived significant livelihood benefits from ecosystem services provided by the park. Major ecosystem resources identified included fauna resources (80.7%), flora resources (78.6%), fertile land (76.3%), medicinal plants (70.1%), clean water (59.6%), grassland resources (59.9%), and cultural relics (54.4%). Respondents further considered bush meat, bush food, medicinal plants, water resources, and hunting activities as highly important for household sustenance and income generation. The results demonstrate the strong dependence of rural households on ecosystem services for food security, healthcare, employment, and environmental sustainability. The study concludes that ecosystem services provided by Old Oyo National Park contribute significantly to rural livelihood resilience and community welfare. Consequently, conservation policies should 2 integrate biodiversity protection with livelihood improvement strategies to ensure sustainable resource management and long-term ecosystem sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚旧奥约国家公园周边社区对生态系统服务的依赖程度，发现居民高度依赖动植物资源、药用植物、清洁水源等生态系统服务来维持生计和收入，建议保护政策应与生计改善策略相结合。
AI.research_question: 旧奥约国家公园周边社区如何依赖生态系统服务维持生计？这些生态系统服务对家庭生计和社会经济福祉的贡献程度如何？
AI.motivation: 保护区周边社区对自然资源依赖度高，但生态系统服务对农村生计可持续性的具体贡献缺乏实证研究，尤其是在尼日利亚国家公园背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务理论、农村生计可持续性框架
AI.method: 通过多阶段抽样技术对384名保护区周边居民进行结构化问卷调查，采用描述性和推理性统计方法分析数据。
AI.findings: 居民从生态系统服务中获得显著生计收益；主要资源包括动物资源（80.7%）、植物资源（78.6%）、肥沃土地（76.3%）、药用植物（70.1%）等；丛林肉、丛林食物、药用植物、水资源和狩猎活动对家庭生计和收入高度重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了生态系统服务对农村生计韧性（resilience）和社区福祉的重要贡献，为生态系统服务与生计可持续性的理论关联提供了非洲国家公园案例证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及其他发展中国家保护区管理提供政策启示：保护政策必须将生物多样性保护与生计改善策略相结合，以实现资源可持续管理和生态系统长期可持续性。

title: The Objective Fetish: Reflexivity, Behaviour Homomorphism, and the Material Termination of Speculative Regimes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Objective Fetish: Reflexivity, Behaviour Homomorphism, and the Material Termination of Speculative Regimes
detail.abstract: Speculative regimes persist longer than arbitrage should allow and terminate at moments their participants do not anticipate. The dominant explanations, reflexivity and narrative economics, are idealist in structure: the regime is sustained by belief and ends when belief reverses, which explains the reversal by the reversal. This paper supplies the objective floor those accounts lack, by an explicitly dialectical and materialist method. Soros's two functions, the cognitive and the participating, are re-grounded asymmetrically through Lenin's theory of reflection: consciousness reflects an objective base it does not constitute and acts back upon it only within finite material means, so the reflexive loop acquires a floor. Persistence rests on a behavioural mechanism, Behaviour Homomorphism, a structure-preserving map carrying heterogeneous priors onto uniform behaviour while preserving the priors it confirms, grounded in one organism and environment contradiction at two strata and given content by the value-form, the M-M′ fetish in which the production circuit is obscured. The market, a selective environment, sweeps the population toward a behavioural monoculture fitted to price and unfit for realisation. Termination is the reassertion of the base, through the one layer the sweep cannot reach, the liquidity selected on repayment. The paper is ontological.

AI.tldr: 本文运用辩证唯物主义方法（基于列宁反映论），提出"行为同构"机制来解释投机 regime（如泡沫）的持久性与突然终结：市场通过一种结构保持映射，将异质性信念同质化为统一行为，但由于市场是选择环境，最终流动性压力（偿付约束）作为客观基础会强制终结这一过程。
AI.research_question: 投机 regime 为何比套利所允许的持续时间更长，并在参与者未预料到的时刻突然终结？
AI.motivation: 现有的主流解释（反身性理论、叙事经济学）本质上是唯心主义的——用信念的逆转解释逆转，缺乏客观基础。本文旨在提供一个辩证唯物主义的客观基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 辩证唯物主义、列宁反映论、索罗斯的认知与参与功能（经反映论不对称地重新奠基）、行为同构（Behaviour Homomorphism）、价值形式（M-M′ 拜物教）、市场作为选择环境。
AI.method: 本体论分析（ontological analysis），结合辩证法与唯物主义方法进行理论建构。
AI.findings: 投机 regime 的持续性源于"行为同构"机制——一种结构保持映射，将异质性先验信念映射为统一行为，同时保留它所确认的先验信念。市场作为选择环境，将群体推向适应价格但不适应实现（realisation）的行为单一种植。终结是"基础"的重新确立——市场选择无法触及的层面（偿付所依赖的流动性）会强制结束该 regime。
AI.theory_contributions: 为投机 regime 的持续与终结提供了客观的、唯物主义的基础，填补了反身性理论和叙事经济学的唯心主义空缺；将索罗斯的认知/参与功能通过列宁反映论重新奠基，实现了不对称的辩证综合；提出"行为同构"概念作为结构保持映射，解释信念异质性与行为同质性的共存。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解金融危机、市场泡沫等投机现象的动力学提供了更坚实的理论框架，揭示了单纯的信念分析无法触及的客观限制条件（流动性、偿付约束）。

title:
Derivatives Clearing: A Comprehensive Guide 
Risk Management, Regulation, and the Future of the Markets (Introduction and Chapter 1)

detail.title:
Derivatives Clearing: A Comprehensive Guide 
Risk Management, Regulation, and the Future of the Markets (Introduction and Chapter 1)
detail.abstract:
Derivatives are indispensable to modern finance, yet the infrastructure that makes them safe to trade at scale remains under-researched. The over-the-counter derivatives market alone exceeds USD 700 trillion in notional outstanding (BIS, 2023), and every trade within it depends on a finely engineered sequence of execution, clearing, and settlement. This book offers a comprehensive, systematic, and practice-oriented account of the pivotal phase within that sequence: clearing—the mechanism by which a central counterparty (CCP) interposes itself between the parties to a trade, assumes counterparty risk, and guarantees performance.

While excellent references exist on derivative products, pricing, and market risk, works that treat clearing itself systematically—its mechanics, risk management, regulation, and recent evolution—have remained scarce, particularly in Japanese. This book aims to fill that gap. It locates clearing within the trade lifecycle; explains the roles of CCPs, clearing brokers, and clients; and rigorously analyzes the core risk-management apparatus: initial and variation margin (SPAN® and VaR-based models, MPOR, procyclicality), the default waterfall, stress testing, and default auctions. It surveys the regulatory framework that emerged from the post-2008 G20 reforms—the CPMI-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures, Dodd-Frank, EMIR, and Japan's Financial Instruments and Exchange Act—and the practical realities of client onboarding and documentation. It concludes with an investigation into the evolutionary trajectory of client clearing: sponsored access, direct clearing, the convergence with prime brokerage, and the transformative impact of DLT and AI.

Throughout, clearing is treated not as back-office processing but as critical market infrastructure—an intellectually demanding, strategic discipline whose design determines where risk concentrates and how market stability is preserved.

AI.tldr: 本书系统阐述中央对手方（CCP）清算机制——包括交易生命周期、风险管理（初始/变动保证金、违约瀑布、压力测试及拍卖）、G20后监管框架（CPMI-IOSCO原则、Dodd-Frank、EMIR、日本《金融商品交易法》），以及客户清算的演化趋势（赞助准入、直清、主经纪商融合、DLT与AI的影响），填补了清算领域系统性文献的空白。
AI.research_question: 场外衍生品交易中中央对手方（CCP）清算机制如何运作？其风险管理、监管框架及演化趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管衍生品定价与市场风险领域已有大量优秀文献，但清算这一关键环节——包括其机制、风险管理、监管及最新演变——的系统性论述极为匮乏，尤其是日文文献。本书旨在填补这一空白，强调清算是决定风险集中度与市场稳定性的战略性市场基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不适用（本书为实务导向的系统性论述，非理论检验型论文）。核心概念框架包括：中央对手方（CCP）中介机制、交易生命周期（执行-清算-结算）、保证金体系（SPAN®和VaR模型、MPOR、逆周期措施）、违约瀑布与违约拍卖、G20后PFMI监管原则。
AI.method: 系统性的文献综合与实务分析，融合监管框架梳理、风险模型解析（如SPAN®和VaR）、案例式制度比较（美国、欧盟、日本）及演化趋势的前瞻讨论。
AI.findings: （1）清算绝非后台处理，而是决定风险集中与市场稳定的战略环节；（2）CCP通过保证金、违约瀑布、压力测试和违约拍卖构成核心风险防御体系；（3）G20后形成了以CPMI-IOSCO PFMI为核心的全球监管框架；（4）客户清算正朝着赞助准入、直接清算、主经纪商融合及DLT/AI技术应用方向演进。
AI.theory_contributions: 将清算从"后台处理"重新定义为"战略性市场基础设施"，为金融基础设施研究提供了系统化的分析框架。特别对日文文献贡献显著。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者（CCP、清算经纪人、客户）提供了一站式清算实务指南，涵盖风险管理操作、监管合规要点、客户准入与文档流程，并前瞻分析了DLT和AI对清算基础设施的变革影响。

detail.abstract: This paper provides a structured synthesis of valuation-multiple evidence for U.S. heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) service businesses in the lower middle market. Drawing on publicly-disclosed transaction data, SEC 10-K filings of publicly-traded HVAC consolidators (Comfort Systems USA, EMCOR Group, Watsco), practitioner valuation reports, and the academic literature on private-company acquisition pricing, the synthesis documents five empirical patterns. First, valuation multiples exhibit a strong size-tier gradient: businesses with under one million dollars in Seller's Discretionary Earnings (SDE) typically transact at 2.0 to 3.0 times SDE through SBA-financed individual-buyer channels, while businesses with twenty-five million dollars or more of trailing EBITDA have transacted in 2024–2026 at platform-level multiples in the 13 to 20 times range, indicated by press-derived references for transactions including the November 2024 Sila Services and February 2026 Champions Group transactions. The transition from SDE-based to EBITDA-based valuation at approximately one million dollars in annual owner economic benefit is identified as a discontinuous threshold rather than a smooth gradient. Second, recurring-revenue intensity is associated with material multiple expansion: practitioner reporting consistently identifies an additional 0.5 to 1.0 times EBITDA premium for HVAC businesses with thirty percent or more revenue from maintenance-agreement membership programmes, with a structural floor at the 2.0 to 3.0 times annual-recurring-revenue valuation level for plan portfolios considered standalone. Third, buyer-archetype differentiates achievable price: PE platform sponsors, PE add-on capital, search funders, family offices, and strategic acquirers exhibit distinguishable multiple ranges and cash-versus-rollover-versus-earnout deal-structure preferences. Fourth, observable value-driver characteristics (geographic concentration in the Sun Belt, commercial versus residential revenue mix, management depth, owner-dependency, fleet age, license-holder structure, customer concentration) compress or expand multiples within the size-tier band by margins documented in practitioner reporting. Fifth, the academic literature on private-company acquisition discounts (Officer, 2007) provides theoretical grounding for the directional pattern that LMM private HVAC transaction multiples remain below the multiples of publicly-traded mechanical-services consolidators; the magnitude of the gap, however, cannot be cleanly attributed to the Officer mechanism alone, because the available listed comparables (Comfort Systems USA, EMCOR Group, Watsco) differ from the Tier 5 private platforms by approximately one order of magnitude in EBITDA scale, by material business-mix composition, and by cycle-specific data-centre construction demand exposure. The synthesis is situated within the academic literature on buy-and-build value creation (Hammer, Marcotty-Dehm, Schweizer, & Schwetzler, 2022; Heisig, Kick, & Schwetzler, 2022) and the empirical literature on industry consolidation. Acknowledged limitations include the absence of audited deal-level multiple data at the LMM-private-transaction level, the practitioner-aggregated source character of the size-tier and buyer-archetype pricing ranges, and the U.S.-centric scope.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国中低端市场（LMM）暖通空调（HVAC）服务企业的估值倍数进行了结构化综合梳理，基于公开交易数据、SEC 10-K文件、从业者估值报告及学术文献，总结了五个经验规律：规模层级梯度、经常性收入溢价、买方类型差异、价值驱动因素及私人公司收购折价的理论解释。文章指出SDE到EBITDA估值切换存在非连续阈值，并强调了数据来源局限和美国中心视角的研究边界。
AI.research_question: 美国中低端市场HVAC服务企业的估值倍数呈现怎样的结构化特征？不同规模、收入模式、买方类型和价值驱动因素如何影响估值倍数？
AI.motivation: LMM私人交易缺乏审计级的交易数据，现有学术文献对中小型HVAC服务企业的估值规律关注不足，因此需要整合多方来源（交易数据、10-K文件、从业者报告）提供系统性的经验证据综合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私人公司收购折价理论（Officer, 2007）；买进并构建（buy-and-build）价值创造理论（Hammer et al., 2022; Heisig et al., 2022）；行业整合实证文献。
AI.method: 结构化综合法（structured synthesis）：整合公开交易数据、SEC 10-K文件、从业者估值报告及学术文献，对多源异质证据进行系统性归纳和模式识别。
AI.findings: （1）估值倍数存在强规模梯度：SDE<100万美元的企业以2.0-3.0倍SDE交易，EBITDA≥2500万美元的平台级交易可达13-20倍；SDE向EBITDA切换在约100万美元处呈非连续阈值。（2）经常性收入（≥30%来自维护协议）带来0.5-1.0倍EBITDA溢价，独立维护组合估值有2.0-3.0倍ARR的结构性底部。（3）买方类型（PE平台、PE附加、搜索基金、家族办公室、战略买家）表现出可区分的倍数区间和交易结构偏好。（4）太阳带地理集中、商业/住宅收入构成、管理层深度等价值驱动因素可在规模带内压缩或扩张倍数。（5）私人公司收购折价理论解释了LMM倍数低于上市整合商的总体方向，但倍数差距不能仅归因于Officer机制——上市可比公司（Comfort Systems USA, EMCOR, Watsco）在规模、业务组合和数据中心需求暴露上存在量级差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将私人公司收购折价理论（Officer, 2007）应用于HVAC细分行业，揭示了该理论在解释LMM私人交易与上市公司倍数差距时的局限性——差距部分源于规模量级、业务组合和周期需求暴露的混杂因素，而非单纯的流动性折价。同时，补充了buy-and-build文献在HVAC行业的具体实证情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LMM HVAC服务企业的买卖双方、估值从业者、PE投资者提供了基于规模层级、收入模式、买方类型和价值驱动因素的结构化估值参考范围；明确了SDE到EBITDA估值切换的非连续阈值（~100万美元），有助于定价决策和交易结构设计。

detail.abstract: The U.S. residential and commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) services industry has experienced one of the most extensively documented private-equity (PE) consolidation cycles of the past decade. This paper provides an empirical case-study synthesis of that cycle, drawing on publicly-disclosed platform-formation events, sponsor press releases, SEC filings of publicly-traded consolidators, and the academic literature on buy and-build strategies. The synthesis is organised around three observable cycle stages applied to the U.S. HVAC industry: an early-cycle platform-formation window (2016–2019), a mid-cycle add-on-acquisition expansion (2019–2023), and a late-cycle transition (2024–2026) characterised by consolidator-of consolidator transactions, secondary-market platform recapitalisations, and the emergence of a structural divergence between the residential and commercial sub-segments. Five platform-level cap-table transactions closed in the eighteen months preceding this paper (Sila Services to Goldman Sachs Alternatives in November 2024, Apex Service Partners 3.4 billion dollar single asset continuation in May 2025, Redwood Services to Altas Partners at approximately 1.1 billion dollars in May 2025, Service Logic to Bain Capital and Mubadala in December 2025, and Champions Group to Blackstone BXPE in February 2026), and a sixth (a strategic minority investment in Apex Service Partners by Apollo Funds) was announced May 28, 2026 with closing expected in Q4 2026, together documenting the late-cycle dynamic with particular clarity. Three synthesis results are reported. First, the U.S. HVAC industry remains substantially fragmented at the establishment level (approximately 50,000 to 100,000 independently owned operators, with IBISWorld 2026 reporting industry revenue of 159.4 billion U.S. dollars), but the active count of named PE-backed and publicly-traded consolidators (27 or more identified, per practitioner inventory in Capstone Partners, 2025), the ubiquity of trade-press coverage of consolidation as a defining industry theme, and the platform-level transaction trajectory documented in Section 4 together place the industry in the late-cycle stage on the operational signals derived from the industry-life cycle tradition (Klepper, 1996, 1997) and the buy-and-build empirical literature (Hammer et al., 2022; Heisig et al., 2022). Second, the residential and commercial sub-segments are diverging in cycle stage and value-creation mechanics, with residential exhibiting consolidator-of-consolidator dynamics and modest multiple compression while commercial HVAC remains in mid cycle expansion driven by data-center demand and mission-critical preventative-maintenance contract economics. Third, the 2024–2025 regulatory transition from R-410A to A2L refrigerants (with refrigerant input cost increases of approximately six-fold and technician recertification requirements) is acting as an asymmetric structural tailwind to consolidation by raising the fixed-cost barrier to small-operator viability. The synthesis is situated within the academic literature on buy-and-build returns and multiple arbitrage (Hammer, Marcotty-Dehm, Schweizer, & Schwetzler, 2022; Heisig, Kick, & Schwetzler, 2022) and the industry-life-cycle tradition originating with Gort and Klepper (1982). Limitations include the inability to observe non disclosed transactions, the absence of audited cross-deal multiple data at the platform level, and the U.S.-centric scope.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国住宅与商业HVAC（暖通空调）服务行业的私募股权并购周期进行了实证案例研究，识别了三个周期阶段（2016-2019平台形成、2019-2023补强收购扩张、2024-2026晚期转型），发现行业仍高度分散但并购整合已进入晚期阶段，住宅与商业子领域出现结构性分化，且2024-2025制冷剂监管转型正成为推动整合的非对称结构性顺风。
AI.research_question: 美国住宅与商业HVAC服务行业的私募股权并购周期经历了怎样的阶段性演变？住宅与商业子领域是否存在结构性分化？监管变化如何影响行业整合进程？
AI.motivation: HVAC服务行业是过去十年中私募股权并购整合最被广泛记录的行业之一，但缺乏系统的实证案例研究来梳理其周期阶段、子领域分化和监管影响。该行业巨大的碎片化程度（约5-10万家独立运营商）与高度活跃的PE整合活动形成了鲜明对比，值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行业生命周期理论（Klepper, 1996, 1997；Gort & Klepper, 1982）和"买进并建造"（buy-and-build）策略实证文献（Hammer et al., 2022; Heisig et al., 2022），特别是关于并购收益、多重套利（multiple arbitrage）以及并购周期阶段划分的相关理论。
AI.method: 实证案例综合研究。数据来源包括：公开披露的平台形成事件、赞助商新闻稿、上市整合商的SEC文件、以及关于买进并建造策略的学术文献。围绕三个可观察的周期阶段对美国HVAC行业进行结构化分析。
AI.findings: 1）尽管HVAC行业在机构层面仍高度碎片化（约5-10万家独立运营商，2026年行业收入1594亿美元），但活跃的PE支持的整合商数量（已识别27+家）和平台级交易轨迹表明行业已进入并购周期晚期阶段。2）住宅和商业子领域在周期阶段和价值创造机制上出现分化：住宅领域呈现"整合商的整合商"动态并伴随有限的多重压缩，而商业HVAC因数据中心需求和关键预防性维护合同经济仍处于中期扩张。3）2024-2025年从R-410A到A2L制冷剂的监管转型（制冷剂投入成本增加约6倍，技师重新认证要求）正通过提高小运营商固定成本门槛，成为推动整合的非对称结构性顺风。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行业生命周期理论与买进并建造策略实证框架应用于HVAC服务行业的特定并购周期，识别了并购周期晚期的关键信号（整合商的整合商交易、二级市场平台再资本化、子领域结构性分化），拓展了对私募股权并购周期阶段演变的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权投资者、行业从业者和政策制定者提供了HVAC行业并购周期的系统分析，揭示了住宅与商业子领域的差异化投资机会和风险，以及监管变化对行业结构重组的影响，有助于指导未来并购决策和行业战略规划。

title: Atomic Finance: The Quiet Alchemy of Modern Markets
affiliations: Regional Advisory Commision on Financial Markets

detail.title: Atomic Finance: The Quiet Alchemy of Modern Markets
detail.abstract:
In tiny moments of trade, the economy breathes its next instant. Purchase orders fill one half of the order book, as sell orders drain the other half. These transactions have negligible size relative to the scales of the world, are saturated in nuance and subtlety, and unfold at a furious tempo, the air crackling with their soundless symphony.

For most markets and ecosystems, these fleeting seconds coalesce into an economic pulse with shape, colour, touch, and smell. It carries wear, rhythm, and often the response of a dawn chorus. In sharp contrast, traditional finance relegates its humming ecology to distant whispers. Cancelling the noise altogether renders play and expression invisible, yet they still lie at the heart of the economy's evolution. A market transforms the tiny world into poetry; the tiny world, softly, stillness; the score of evolution, heartbeat. Emotion in numbers has always inspired artists, and these artists continue their work, now with the tools of precision finance.

Atomic finance creates a quiet instrument of strange, resonant beauty. Market microstructure becomes pure data, a fine-grained record of player behaviours. The departure from conventional finance lies largely in a reversal of tradition: transparency and trust create precise data; precise data become credible risks; credible risks govern reward. It is a gentle, peaceful evolution, yielding deep, colourful maps of the tiny world's poem.

AI.tldr: 本文以诗意的语言探讨了微观金融（原子金融）如何将市场微观结构转化为精细数据，通过透明与信任建立可信风险，从而颠覆传统金融范式，揭示微小交易中蕴含的经济演化诗篇。
AI.research_question: 微观层面的交易行为如何通过数据化方式被捕捉、理解并重构金融市场的风险-回报机制？
AI.motivation: 传统金融将市场中的微观交易视为噪声而忽略，但作者认为这些微小瞬间正是经济演化的核心脉动，需要一种新的视角（原子金融）来重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、原子金融（Atomic Finance）、数据驱动的风险定价机制
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论述，通过文学化的隐喻与对比分析，阐述原子金融对传统金融范式的颠覆。
AI.findings: 原子金融通过透明与信任产生精确数据，精确数据转化为可信风险，可信风险主导回报，形成与传统金融相反的良性循环，揭示微观交易世界的诗意与美感。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出原子金融作为理解市场微观结构的新框架，强调透明度和信任在数据-风险-回报链条中的核心作用，挑战传统金融将微观交易视为噪声的认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高频交易、订单簿分析、市场设计等金融实践提供哲学基础和方法论启示，鼓励从业者关注微观层面的数据价值。

title: Sovereign Logistics, Absent Diplomacy: Azerbaijan, the Silent Keystone of ASEAN–Europe Supply Chain Connectivity
affiliations: Independent Researcher
