Enrollment estimates are positive but statistically indistinguishable from zero. The results suggest that hard mandates generate a strong filing first stage, but the associated rise in grant and scholarship aid may be too modest to incentivize additional enrollment effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国四个州实施的高中毕业前强制FAFSA（联邦学生资助免费申请表）填写的硬性规定，发现该政策使FAFSA完成率提高12.3个百分点，联邦学生资助申请人数每名毕业生增加0.087人，州政府助学金和奖学金上升至公立大学平均学费的3.5%，但入学率影响不显著，表明政策虽然有效促进了资助申请，但增加的资助金额不足以激励更多学生入学。
AI.research_question: 高中毕业前强制FAFSA填写政策对FAFSA完成率、联邦学生资助申请、州政府助学金及大学入学率的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有研究提供了州级因果证据，但缺乏跨州比较和对下游效应（资助发放及入学）的系统估计。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估硬性FAFSA强制政策的全链条效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育经济学中的信息壁垒与财政援助理论，认为简化申请流程和强制填写可以降低学生获取资助的信息成本，从而影响资助申请行为、资助发放及最终的大学入学决策。
AI.method: 采用双重重磅识别策略：学校层面的Sun-Abraham事件研究法估计FAFSA完成率的处理效应，以及州-年份固定效应模型估计下游反应（资助申请、资助发放和入学率）。
AI.findings: （1）硬性强制使FAFSA完成率提高12.3个百分点；（2）联邦学生资助申请人数每名毕业生增加0.087人；（3）政策实施后几年内，州政府助学金和奖学金上升至公立大学平均学费的3.5%；（4）入学率估计为正但统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统估计了硬性FAFSA强制政策的跨州因果效应及全链条下游结果，揭示了"强第一阶段但弱第二阶段"的效应模式，为信息干预政策的有限传导机制提供了理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据：强制FAFSA填写能有效提高申请率并增加资助发放，但增加的资助规模可能不足以显著改变入学决策，需配合更大力度财政激励措施才能实现入学率提升目标。

title: The Perceived Importance of Olfaction in Eating Behaviour: Independent Effects of Culture, Age, and BMI in Adults aged over 55 Years
affiliations: University of Sri Jayewardenepura, Rambhai Barni Rajabhat University, Thailand, Southwest University, University of Nottingham, Massey University, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), Macquarie University, Dresden University of Technology, Deakin University and

detail.title: The Perceived Importance of Olfaction in Eating Behaviour: Independent Effects of Culture, Age, and BMI in Adults aged over 55 Years

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest. None of the commercial products used in this study causes conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research was primarily approved by the College Human Ethics Advisory Network at RMIT University, Australia (Low Risk Ref: 23866) and conducted in accordance with the National Statement on Ethical Conduct in Human Research (2007). For international data collection, the RMIT ethics approval was reciprocated or supplemented based on the requirements of each co-author’s institutional ethics board. In cases where local ethics approval was required, separate applications were submitted and approved. In countries where reciprocal approval was permissible, data collection proceeded under the oversight of RMIT’s ethics protocol, in consultation with local collaborators.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Using an online survey, we investigated how the importance of olfaction influences eating behaviour among adults aged 55 and over across six countries/regions (n=627): Australasia (Australia and New Zealand), China, Germany, Sri Lanka, Thailand, and the United Kingdom (UK). Participants (self-reported as healthy) were assessed on four olfactory importance subdomains: application, consequence, association, and aggravation. Additional self-reported measures included body mass index (BMI). Both univariate and multivariate analyses revealed significant country/region-level differences with participants from Western countries reporting lower overall olfactory importance than those from Asian countries (F(5,618) = 20.79, p<0.001). Country/region-level analyses further confirmed this pattern, with the higher scores on overall olfactory importance observed in China, Sri Lanka, and Thailand, and lower scores in Australasia, Germany, and the UK. Notably, these cultural and country/region differences remained consistent irrespective of age, gender, or BMI. However, age and BMI showed independent effects: individuals over 70 years reported greater olfactory importance than younger groups (F(5,618)=4.77, p=0.020), while higher BMI was associated with lower importance ratings (F(5,618)=3.92, p=0.037). Principal component and cluster analyses identified two distinct clusters: one with higher olfactory importance, primarily consisting of participants from Asian countries/regions, and another with lower importance, predominantly from Western countries/regions. These clusters were unrelated to age, gender, or BMI. The findings indicate that cultural context plays a stronger role than individual demographic factors in shaping the perceived importance of olfaction during eating. This suggests the need for culturally sensitive approaches when designing olfactory interventions and highlights the significance of assessing perceived relevance alongside psychophysical measures when evaluating the importance of olfaction in eating behaviour in older people.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对六个国家/地区（澳大利亚亚、中国、德国、斯里兰卡、泰国、英国）55岁以上健康成年人（n=627）的在线调查，发现文化背景比个人人口因素（年龄、性别、BMI）更能塑造进食过程中嗅觉重要性的感知。亚洲国家参与者报告的嗅觉重要性普遍高于西方国家参与者，且这一模式独立于年龄、性别或BMI。
AI.research_question: 在不同国家/地区（东西方文化背景下），55岁以上成年人对嗅觉在进食中的重要性感知存在何种差异？年龄、性别、BMI等个体因素与文化背景的影响力孰轻孰重？
AI.motivation: 老年人嗅觉功能下降与饮食行为改变密切相关，但以往研究多关注客观嗅觉能力（如嗅觉阈值），忽视了主观上人们对嗅觉重要性的感知。了解不同文化背景下老年人对嗅觉重要性的认知差异，有助于设计更具文化敏感性的嗅觉干预策略，改善老年人饮食行为与营养状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嗅觉重要性四维度框架：应用（Application）、后果（Consequence）、关联（Association）、加重（Aggravation）。
AI.method: 在线问卷调查，覆盖6个国家/地区（n=627）；使用嗅觉重要性量表评估四个子维度；收集BMI等自我报告数据；采用单变量分析、多变量分析、主成分分析和聚类分析。
AI.findings: (1) 西方国家对嗅觉重要性的评分显著低于亚洲国家；(2) 文化/国家差异独立于年龄、性别和BMI；(3) 年龄有独立效应：70岁以上组评分高于较年轻组；(4) BMI有独立效应：BMI越高，嗅觉重要性评分越低；(5) 聚类分析形成两个簇：高嗅觉重要性（以亚洲国家为主）和低嗅觉重要性（以西方国家为主）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统比较东西方文化背景下老年人主观嗅觉重要性的差异，证实文化背景比个体人口因素更能预测嗅觉重要性感知，丰富了嗅觉与饮食行为的跨文化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示设计针对老年人的嗅觉干预方案时需考虑文化敏感性；建议在评估老年人嗅觉与饮食行为关系时，同时纳入主观重要性测量和客观心理物理测量。

title: Algorithmic Joint Business Planning (JBP): A Twelve-Dimension Framework for Reshaping Supplier-Retailer Commercial Relationships in Agent-Mediated Trade

detail.title: Algorithmic Joint Business Planning (JBP): A Twelve-Dimension Framework for Reshaping Supplier-Retailer Commercial Relationships in Agent-Mediated Trade

declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: The Joint Business Plan is the dominant commercial governance instrument between consumer goods suppliers and retail trade partners across grocery, consumer electronics, beauty, and adjacent categories. The instrument was engineered for a human-to-human commercial era. It assumes two human parties negotiating annual terms through relationship, escalation, and judgement. Algorithmic mediation collapses that assumption. When the retailer's buyer is an AI procurement agent, the supplier's pricing logic is a structured data feed, or both, the traditional Joint Business Plan breaks across specific, identifiable dimensions. This paper introduces the Algorithmic Joint Business Planning framework. The framework specifies twelve dimensions of the traditional Joint Business Plan that change structurally under algorithmic mediation, prescribes the supplier-side and retailer-side capability adaptations required for each dimension, and maps four retailer archetypes onto the framework to handle heterogeneity in agentic exposure. The argument is anchored in capability theory (Teece, Pisano, & Shuen, 1997; Teece, 2007; Day, 1994, 2011) and dyadic relational governance (Hingley, Lindgreen, & Grant, 2015; Shahzad et al., 2018). It is positioned against the existing Joint Business Planning and category management literature. Two illustrative empirical anchors are offered: a 1,000-respondent Brazilian grocery shopper panel fielded by Appinio in April 2026, and a documented in-market diagnostic of AI agent behaviour in the São Paulo consumer electronics category in May 2026. Both anchors are illustrative, not validatory. Full empirical testing is reserved for subsequent work. The paper contributes a structured conceptual scaffold that suppliers, retailers, and researchers can use to diagnose and redesign the supplier-retailer commercial interface for conditions of agent-mediated trade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出算法化联合业务计划（Algorithmic Joint Business Planning）框架，系统分析了当零售采购方为AI代理、供应商定价为结构化数据流时，传统JBP在12个维度上的结构性断裂，并提出了相应的能力适配方案与零售商类型学映射。
AI.research_question: 在算法中介（AI采购代理、结构化数据定价）条件下，传统的供应商-零售商联合业务计划（JBP）在哪些维度上发生结构性变化？供应商和零售商需要什么样的能力调整？
AI.motivation: 传统JBP假设由两个人类主体通过关系、升级和判断进行年度谈判，但算法中介（如AI采购代理）打破了这一假设。当零售买方是AI、供应商定价是结构化数据流时，现有JBP框架失效，亟需新的理论框架来诊断和重新设计商业接口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力理论（Teece, Pisano & Shuen, 1997; Teece, 2007; Day, 1994, 2011）和二元关系治理理论（Hingley, Lindgreen & Grant, 2015; Shahzad et al., 2018）。
AI.method: 概念框架构建，辅以两个说明性实证锚点：2026年4月Appinio实施的1000名巴西杂货购物者面板调查，以及2026年5月圣保罗消费电子品类中AI代理行为的市场诊断。两个锚点均为说明性而非验证性。
AI.findings: 传统JBP在12个维度上因算法中介而发生结构性变化；提出了供应商和零售商各自的能力适应方案；将零售商映射为四种原型（基于代理暴露程度的异质性）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能力理论与二元关系治理理论拓展至算法中介的商业交易场景，系统性地识别了传统JBP在AI代理环境下的维度性断裂，为后续实证研究提供了结构化概念支架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应商和零售商提供了一个可操作的诊断与重新设计框架，帮助他们在算法中介贸易条件下识别自身能力缺口并制定适应策略；为零售商的四种原型提供了差异化的能力建设指引。

title: The Fifth Quadrant: A New Category of Economic Existence in the Age of Infinite Replication

detail.title: The Fifth Quadrant: A New Category of Economic Existence in the Age of Infinite Replication
detail.abstract: Robert Kiyosaki's Cashflow Quadrant framework (Employee, Self-Employed, Business Owner, Investor) provided a dominant late-twentieth-century taxonomy of economic positioning. However, the emergence of the digital economy, characterized by zero marginal cost replication and autonomous system orchestration, has created a new category of economic existence that escapes this four-fold classification. This paper proposes a "Fifth Quadrant": the Engine Builder. The Engine Builder is an individual who constructs autonomous, self-propagating digital systems (engines) that generate value and operate independently of continuous human labor, physical presence, geographic location, or institutional credentials. This paper distinguishes the Fifth Quadrant from traditional software-as-a-service (SaaS) and traditional entrepreneurship, maps the economic and transaction cost parameters of this new category using Coasean firm theory, and introduces a formal diagnostic metric: the Engine Builder Index (EBI). It examines the implications of this framework for the future of work, wealth creation, and career transition in a post-geographic world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数字经济催生了超越传统“现金流四象限”（雇员、自由职业者、企业主、投资者）的“第五象限”——引擎构建者（Engine Builder）。引擎构建者指那些构建能够自主运转、持续创造价值的数字系统的人，其经济活动不依赖持续人力劳动、物理存在或机构认证。文章基于科斯企业理论分析了这一新类别的经济与交易成本参数，并提出了引擎构建者指数（EBI）作为诊断指标，探讨其对未来工作、财富创造和职业转型的启示。
AI.research_question: 在数字经济时代，传统现金流四象限分类是否已经过时？能否提出一个“第五象限”来捕捉新型经济存在形式，并对其进行理论化与度量？
AI.motivation: Robert Kiyosaki的现金流四象限框架在20世纪末具有主导地位，但数字经济的兴起（零边际成本复制、自主系统编排）创造了超出该四类划分的新型经济存在，亟需新的理论分类与分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科斯企业理论（Coasean firm theory）——用于分析新类别的经济与交易成本参数；现金流四象限框架（Cashflow Quadrant framework）——作为对比基准。
AI.method: 理论推演与概念构建：基于科斯交易成本理论进行参数映射；提出正式诊断指标（Engine Builder Index, EBI）进行量化度量。
AI.findings: 提出了“第五象限”（引擎构建者）这一新类别，将其与传统的SaaS和创业活动区分开来；界定了其经济与交易成本参数；开发了引擎构建者指数（EBI）作为诊断工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了经典的现金流四象限分类框架，提出了适应数字经济的新型经济存在分类；将科斯企业理论应用于数字自主系统的分析，丰富了交易成本经济学的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人在数字经济中的职业定位和转型提供了新的分类与诊断工具（EBI）；为理解后地理时代的财富创造和工作形态提供了实践框架。

reference: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 09/2026
title: CIP Violations as Functional Components of the Dynamic Cross-currency Basis Curve
affiliations: Swiss National Bank and Swiss National Accident Insurance Fund (Suva)

detail.title: CIP Violations as Functional Components of the Dynamic Cross-currency Basis Curve

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 09/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss National Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The general search for US dollars in forward currency markets, combined with the balance-sheet constraints of intermediary dealers, induces persistent failure of covered interest parity (CIP). We investigate these CIP deviations across the entire maturity spectrum by analyzing the daily dynamics of the USD/CHF cross-currency basis curve. Applying functional principal component analysis, we identify three components that explain virtually all curve dynamics: a persistent, slow-moving level component, a temporary steepener, and a short-end component inducing sharp basis widenings and contractions around quarter-end dates. We provide empirical evidence that CIP-implied carry opportunities and US monetary policy announcements widen the entire basis curve, whereas Fed swap line announcements tend to narrow it. During periods of global turmoil, the slope inverts in response to rising credit and capital stress among dealer banks, while funding stress steepens the curve as swap line usage mitigates short-end distortions. Reporting date effects, funding stress, and deteriorating market liquidity widen the basis primarily at the short- end. We further show that regulatory reporting dates generate systematic window-dressing distortions not only at the short end but also in the slope of the basis curve. This effect has weakened since 2022, which is consistent with recent changes in the regulatory landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文利用函数主成分分析（FPCA）研究美元/瑞郎（USD/CHF）交叉货币基差曲线的日度动态，发现三个主成分（水平、斜率、短期端）几乎解释了全部曲线变动。基差曲线受CIP套利机会、美国货币政策、美联储互换额度、交易商银行信用与资本压力、融资压力、市场流动性以及监管报告日等多种因素影响，且2022年后监管报告日的窗口粉饰效应有所减弱。
AI.research_question: 外汇远期市场中，覆盖利率平价（CIP）持续偏离的驱动因素是什么？特别是不同期限的交叉货币基差曲线受哪些因素影响？
AI.motivation: 传统CIP理论假设无套利条件成立，但现实中尤其是美元相关的远期市场存在持续偏离。已有研究多聚焦短端，本文意在系统分析整个期限结构的基差曲线动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 覆盖利率平价（CIP）条件；金融中介资产负债表约束理论；功能主成分分析（FPCA）方法。
AI.method: 采用函数主成分分析（FPCA）对USD/CHF交叉货币基差曲线的日度数据进行分析，识别不同期限结构的主成分，并回归检验各类经济与政策因素的驱动作用。
AI.findings: 1. 三个主成分（缓慢移动的水平成分、临时斜率陡峭化成分、短期端成分）解释了基差曲线几乎全部动态。2. CIP隐含套利机会和美国货币政策公告使整条基差曲线走阔；美联储互换额度公告使曲线收窄。3. 全球动荡时期，交易商银行的信用和资本压力导致斜率倒挂；融资压力使曲线陡峭化。4. 监管报告日效应不仅影响短端，也扭曲斜率，且此效应在2022年后减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将功能主成分分析首次系统应用于交叉货币基差曲线的全期限结构分析，揭示了不同期限维度的差异化驱动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外汇市场参与者（套利者、风险管理者和政策制定者）理解和预测不同期限基差变动的驱动因素提供实证依据，尤其对监管报告日效应及其近年弱化的观察具有政策参考价值。

title: OM Grand Challenges: SDG 7 - Managing Decentralized Assets and Actors for the Clean Energy Transition
affiliations: Harvard University - Technology & Operations Management Unit, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Stanford University

detail.title: OM Grand Challenges: SDG 7 - Managing Decentralized Assets and Actors for the Clean Energy Transition
detail.abstract: Achieving SDG 7 requires closing persistent energy access gaps while simultaneously scaling renewable generation and reliably integrating intermittent supply into electricity systems. In 2024, 655 million people remain without access to electricity, and about 2 billion still rely on polluting cooking fuels. Simultaneously, clean energy technologies are increasingly cost-competitive and deployment is accelerating. Still, adoption and scaling remain constrained by affordability, supply-chain and infrastructure bottlenecks, coordination failures among decentralized actors, financing, and institutional frictions. We highlight the grand challenges behind these operational frictions and discuss how the operations management research community can contribute to the progress towards SDG 7 targets.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了实现联合国可持续发展目标7（SDG 7）面临的运营挑战，包括能源接入差距、可再生能源规模化、供应链瓶颈、协调失灵、融资和制度摩擦等问题，并指出运营管理研究可以如何为此做出贡献。
AI.research_question: 运营管理研究如何帮助解决实现SDG 7（确保人人获得负担得起的、可靠和可持续的现代能源）过程中面临的运营摩擦和挑战？
AI.motivation: 尽管清洁能源技术成本下降且部署加速，但仍有6.55亿人无电可用、约20亿人依赖污染烹饪燃料，能源转型存在诸多运营层面的障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展目标（SDG 7）框架、运营管理理论（涉及供应链、协调失灵、融资、制度摩擦等）
AI.method: 概念性/观点性论文，基于对当前能源接入现状和挑战的系统性梳理，提出运营管理研究的贡献方向。
AI.findings: 实现SDG 7的主要运营挑战包括：可负担性限制、供应链和基础设施瓶颈、去中心化行为者之间的协调失灵、融资困难以及制度摩擦。运营管理研究可通过优化供应链、设计协调机制、创新融资模式等方式做出贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 将运营管理的视角引入可持续发展与能源转型领域，识别出实现SDG 7过程中被忽视的运营摩擦，并指出未来研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、能源企业和国际组织提供了运营管理层面的解决思路，帮助弥合能源接入差距并加速清洁能源转型。

title: Intelligent Monitoring and Fault Detection Systems for Gas Pipeline Networks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Intelligent Monitoring and Fault Detection Systems for Gas Pipeline Networks

keywords: Petroleum and Gas Engineering Intelligent Monitoring Systems

detail.abstract:
Gas pipeline networks are critical components of modern energy infrastructure, responsible for the safe and efficient transportation of natural gas from production facilities to end users. Ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational efficiency of these networks is a major challenge due to factors such as pipeline aging, corrosion, leaks, equipment failures, and external environmental impacts. Traditional monitoring and inspection methods often rely on periodic maintenance and manual assessments, which may be insufficient for detecting faults in real time and preventing operational disruptions. In recent years, intelligent monitoring and fault detection systems have emerged as advanced solutions for enhancing pipeline integrity and operational performance through the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Internet of Things (IoT), sensor technologies, and real-time data analytics. 

This study examines the role of intelligent monitoring and fault detection systems in gas pipeline networks, focusing on their applications in leak detection, anomaly identification, predictive maintenance, and infrastructure health monitoring. Advanced AI-driven models, including deep learning algorithms and pattern recognition techniques, are capable of analyzing large volumes of sensor and operational data to identify abnormal conditions and predict potential failures before they occur. The findings indicate that intelligent monitoring systems significantly improve fault detection accuracy, reduce response times, minimize operational downtime, and enhance overall pipeline safety. Furthermore, these technologies contribute to cost savings, environmental protection, and regulatory compliance by enabling proactive maintenance and risk management strategies. Despite these advantages, challenges such as data quality issues, cybersecurity risks, high implementation costs, and integration with legacy infrastructure remain significant barriers to adoption. The study concludes that intelligent monitoring and fault detection systems are essential for the development of resilient, efficient, and sustainable gas pipeline networks and highlights future research opportunities in digital twins, edge computing, and explainable artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了智能监控与故障检测系统在燃气管网中的应用，重点讨论了AI、ML、IoT等技术在泄漏检测、异常识别、预测性维护和基础设施健康监测中的作用。研究发现，这些系统显著提高了故障检测准确性、缩短了响应时间、减少了运营停机并增强了整体安全性，同时带来了成本节约和环保效益，但仍面临数据质量、网络安全、高实施成本和与旧系统集成等挑战。
AI.research_question: 智能监控与故障检测系统在燃气管网中如何发挥作用？其在泄漏检测、异常识别、预测性维护和基础设施健康监测中的应用效果如何？
AI.motivation: 燃气管网面临老化、腐蚀、泄漏、设备故障等挑战，传统监控方法依赖定期维护和人工评估，难以实时检测故障并防止运营中断。因此需要探索基于AI、ML、IoT等技术的智能监控方案来提升管网完整性和运营性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习算法、模式识别技术、AI驱动的预测模型、IoT传感器技术、实时数据分析等理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合分析，聚焦智能监控和故障检测系统在燃气管网中的应用，通过整合已有研究和案例，评估其在泄漏检测、异常识别、预测性维护等方面的效能。
AI.findings: 智能监控系统显著提升了故障检测准确性、缩短了响应时间、减少了运营停机、增强了管网安全性。此外，这些技术通过支持主动维护和风险管理策略，带来了成本节约、环境保护和合规性提升。但数据质量问题、网络安全风险、高实施成本和与旧基础设施的集成仍是主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地梳理了AI、ML、IoT等技术在燃气管网智能监控领域的应用框架，为数字孪生、边缘计算和可解释人工智能等前沿方向提供了理论展望。
AI.practical_contributions: 为燃气管网运营商提供了智能监控系统的应用指南，展示了其在提升安全性、降低成本、保护环境和实现合规方面的实际价值，同时也指出了实施过程中需要克服的关键障碍。

title: Promoting Societal Development through Digital Activism: A Case Study of a Guatemalan Tragedy
affiliations: California State University, Los Angeles, University of Auckland Business School and The University of Kansas

detail.title: Promoting Societal Development through Digital Activism: A Case Study of a Guatemalan Tragedy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Information Technology, Online first, 2025. DOI:10.1177/02683962251380597

detail.abstract: Digital activism is on the rise as activist organizations worldwide rely on information and communication technology (ICT) to mobilize public support for their causes. In this article, we focus on ICT’s capabilities to cultivate values relevant to societal development in environments characterized by political repression. We examine how activist organizations can use ICT to bypass barriers in traditional communication channels, enabling them to promote values pertinent to broader societal development. Our findings demonstrate how ICT enables activists to challenge dominant narratives by presenting alternative perspectives, which are then integrated into a unified message that amplifies values of solidarity and accountability. We propose that these capabilities stem from the interplay of two distinct and innovative framing mechanisms: divergent framing and convergent framing. This study advances the IS research literature by enriching our understanding of ICT’s role in opening spaces that contribute to the reinforcement of values essential for advancing societal development. The full paper is available at  https://doi.org/10.1177/02683962251380597

AI.tldr: 本文研究在政治压制环境下，维权组织如何利用ICT绕过传统沟通壁垒，通过"发散性框架"和"汇聚性框架"两种创新机制，挑战主导叙事、传播替代视角，从而弘扬团结与问责等社会价值观。
AI.research_question: 在政治压制环境下，维权组织如何利用ICT的能力来培育与社会发展相关的价值观？
AI.motivation: 数字 activism 日益兴起，但在政治压制环境中，传统沟通渠道受限，ICT如何帮助维权组织突破障碍、传播社会价值观尚待深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发散性框架（Divergent Framing）与汇聚性框架（Convergent Framing）两种框架机制的相互作用。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体研究方法，但属于质性或案例研究导向。
AI.findings: ICT使维权组织能够挑战主导叙事、呈现替代视角，并将这些视角整合为统一信息，从而放大团结与问责的价值观。这种能力源于发散性框架与汇聚性框架两种创新机制的互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富IS研究文献中对ICT在政治压制环境下开辟空间、强化社会发展相关价值观作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为维权组织和数字 activism 实践者提供策略参考，说明如何利用ICT的框架机制在受限环境中有效传播社会价值观。

title: Long-term Vertical Contracts, Geography, and the Persistence of Brand Shares
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Economics, Queen's University and Imperial College Business School

detail.title: Long-term Vertical Contracts, Geography, and the Persistence of Brand Shares

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Previous research documents persistent regional differences in national brand market shares, often attributed to geographic differences in consumer preferences and early entry advantages (Bronnenberg et al. 2007, 2009). This paper asks how much of this persistence is a feature of demand and how much operates through retailers. Using NielsenIQ data from the same product categories as Bronnenberg et al. (2007), we decompose the variance in national-brand shares into Brand × Retailer and Brand × Market components using the leave-out estimator of Abowd et al. (1999) and Kline et al. (2020). Retailer effects explain more than half of the variance, compared with under a fifth for market effects, and roughly half of the well-known "city of origin" gradient disappears once retailer heterogeneity is absorbed. We interpret these patterns as evidence of steering rather than consumer sorting, with asymmetric vertical arrangements such as category captaincy and slotting agreements as the leading candidate mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NielsenIQ数据，将国民品牌市场份额的持久性差异分解为品牌×零售商效应和品牌×市场效应，发现零售商效应解释了超过一半的方差，而市场效应解释不到五分之一。约一半的"原产地城市"梯度在吸收零售商异质性后消失，这表明零售商引导（steering）而非消费者分类（sorting）是主要机制，品类领航权和上架费协议是可能的解释。
AI.research_question: 国民品牌市场份额的地区持久性差异在多大程度上源于需求特征，又在多大程度上通过零售商渠道运作？
AI.motivation: 已有文献（Bronnenberg et al. 2007, 2009）记录了国民品牌市场份额存在持续的地区差异，通常归因于消费者偏好的地理差异和先发优势。本文旨在区分这种持久性究竟是需求驱动的还是零售商驱动的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者偏好地理差异理论、先发优势理论、零售商引导（steering）与消费者分类（sorting）理论、不对称纵向安排（品类领航权、上架费协议）理论。
AI.method: 使用与Bronnenberg et al. (2007)相同的产品类别的NielsenIQ数据，采用Abowd et al. (1999)和Kline et al. (2020)的leave-out估计量，将国民品牌份额方差分解为品牌×零售商效应和品牌×市场效应。
AI.findings: 零售商效应解释了超过一半的方差，市场效应解释不到五分之一；约一半的"原产地城市"梯度在控制零售商异质性后消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化零售商渠道在国民品牌市场份额地区持久性差异中的主导作用，揭示了零售商引导（steering）而非消费者分类（sorting）的关键机制，为品类领航权和上架费协议等不对称纵向安排提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 对国民品牌经理人而言，理解零售商关系管理（尤其是品类领航权安排）比关注地区消费者偏好差异更为重要；对零售商和监管机构而言，揭示了纵向安排可能对品牌竞争格局产生的深远影响。

title:
The Doctrine of the Affected Party 
Realigning Standing, Notice, and the Burden of Proof in Interdependent Urban Structures
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Doctrine of the Affected Party 
Realigning Standing, Notice, and the Burden of Proof in Interdependent Urban Structures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is self-represented in ongoing civil and administrative proceedings in Portugal concerning matters structurally similar to those discussed in this paper. The theoretical framework presented here was developed in part through that practical engagement and is offered in general form independent of any specific proceeding; no specific party, case, or jurisdiction is addressed in this paper. The author is also the founder of a commercial venture (KYC.co) whose broader product and policy work intersects with some of the institutional design concepts discussed here.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical and doctrinal legal analysis; it does not involve human subjects, personal data collection, or empirical research requiring ethics review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Portuguese administrative and civil law treat physically interdependent properties inconsistently, and the inconsistency runs in a predictable direction. Article 68(1) of the Código do Procedimento Administrativo grants legitimacy to constitute oneself as an interested party broadly enough, on its text, to capture the owner of a structurally connected property1 — yet municipalities routinely deny that status through a doctrine holding that any effect on a neighbouring property is a mere reflexo de facto, outside the scope of a licensing decision. Article 1347 of the Civil Code, governing excavation damage, then assigns liability to whoever performed the works regardless of precautions taken, without asking whether the damaged structure’s condition was already compromised and documented before anyone broke ground. The same two properties, in other words, are legal strangers when one of them seeks to be heard, and a single interdependent system the instant liability needs somewhere to land. The convenience of switching between those two characterisations is the whole of the problem, and it does not stop at liability. It reappears, in exact mirror, on the side of benefit. Where two units stand on one shared structure under a single alvará, a municipality will treat them as one interdependent whole when it grants and charges the first owner for a structural enhancement — a deeper foundation, an added storey — yet as two separate properties when the second owner later needs the very same enhancement. That need is not a matter of preference: the two units share a single foundation system, and a structure built to one depth standing against a neighbour later built to another is among the most common causes of differential settlement and cracking at the join — the same physical interdependence Criterion A is built to recognise produces, on the benefit side, a structural necessity to match what the first owner was already granted. The second owner therefore pays again for an entitlement the shared structure requires regardless of preference, or goes to court to establish a parity the municipality itself created and then declined to recognise. Liability flows to whoever is treated as connected; benefit is withheld from whoever is treated as separate; and which characterisation applies is determined, in both directions, by whichever answer costs the institution least. This paper argues that the inconsistency is not incidental but mechanical: it is the means by which Portuguese law converts ordinarily compliant property owners into bad-faith ones, by rewarding concealment and silence at every stage where disclosure would be cheap and contesting it later is not. Drawing on a documented administrative history before the Câmara Municipal de Cascais and a structurally comparable incident in Lisbon, this paper proposes the Parte Afetada — the Affected Party — a status triggered only by objective, thirdparty-verified conditions, operating through a notice protocol that protects builders as much as neighbours, and requiring no new courts, no new institutions, and no admission of fault from any party it touches. The reform is structured so that every institution it implicates — the município, the courts, and the insurer underwriting the property — has reason to adopt it independently of whether the others do.

AI.tldr: 葡萄牙行政法和民法对物理上相互依赖的不动产处理存在系统性不一致：行政机关在听证阶段视相邻房产为"法律上的陌生人"，在责任归属时又视其为"相互依赖的整体"；在利益分配时则反向操作。这种不一致不是偶发而是机制性的，其后果是将合规产权人转化为恶意的，并系统性地奖励隐瞒与沉默。本文提出"受影响方"身份改革方案，该方案可由市政机构、法院和保险公司独立采纳。
AI.research_question: 葡萄牙法律对物理上相互依赖的不动产为何存在系统性的不一致处理，这种不一致如何将合规产权人转化为恶意的，以及如何通过制度改革加以解决？
AI.motivation: 葡萄牙行政法第68(1)条广泛承认利害关系人身份，但市政当局通过"反射事实"学说拒绝相邻产权人参与；民法第1347条在挖掘损害中不问过错即归责。同一组房产在听证和归责时被截然不同地对待，且这种不一致还有利于市政方——在责任侧视其为整体，在利益侧视其为分离，从而系统性地惩罚主动披露者、奖励隐瞒者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律一致性理论、产权理论、相邻关系理论、程序正义理论、"反射事实"学说、结构性相互依赖理论。
AI.method: 法律条文分析（行政法典第68(1)条、民法典第1347条）、行政案例研究（Cascais市政厅的行政记录）、比较案例研究（里斯本的类似事件）、制度设计分析。
AI.findings: (1) 葡萄牙法律对相互依赖房产的处理存在可预测的方向性不一致：行政法拒绝相邻产权人的利害关系人地位，民法却将相邻房产视为整体归责；(2) 同一不一致在利益侧镜像出现：首任业主获得结构增强（如加深地基），第二任业主即使因结构一体性必须相同增强，也得重新付费或诉诸法院；(3) 这种不一致是机制性的，它通过将责任流向被视作整体的一方、将利益从被视作分离的一方抽走，系统性地将合规产权人转化为"恶意的"；(4) 该机制奖励隐瞒与沉默，因为早披露成本低但会被利用，晚抗争成本高但更可能成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了法律不一致并非偶然而是实现"将合规产权人转化为恶意"这一功能的机制性工具，丰富了法律与制度设计理论中对"策略性法律不一致"的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"受影响方"制度——由客观的第三方验证条件触发、通过通知协议操作、同时保护建设方和邻居、不要求新设法院或机构、不要求任何一方承认过错，且市政、法院和保险公司均有独立采纳的激励。

title: Mindful or Mindless? How and why Virtual Communities Fail to Contain Information Pollution Across Different Disasters
affiliations: University of Southampton, Durham University Business School, Missouri University of Science and Technology and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Mindful or Mindless? How and why Virtual Communities Fail to Contain Information Pollution Across Different Disasters
detail.abstract: People visit virtual communities to find trusted information (i.e. verifiable, accurate and reliable information) during disasters. Virtual communities are open spaces where people interact and share information. However, virtual communities often suffer from information pollution (including too much information and false or contradictory information) which decreases peoples’ ability to find trusted information. Oddly, some virtual communities will develop useful practices for combatting information pollution during one disaster, but subsequently fail to effectively employ the same practices or adapt them in subsequent disasters. We conducted a longitudinal, exploratory cross-case study to better understand how and why this occurs. Using the lenses of organisational mindfulness/mindlessness, we find three factors: (i) organisational forgetting, (ii) blaming, and (iii) social fracturing that may cause virtual communities to act mindlessly and prevent them from containing information pollution during a disaster. Practically, virtual communities may avoid mindlessness by (i) codifying past successful practices and adapting them, (ii) monitoring the rhetoric of blame and building trust in authorities, and (iii) avoiding inconsequential debates and promoting shared values. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1177/02683962251376678

AI.tldr: 本文通过纵向跨案例研究，探讨了虚拟社区在灾难中为何有时能成功应对信息污染、有时却失败的原因。基于组织正念/失念理论，发现组织遗忘、指责和社会分裂三个因素导致虚拟社区失念，从而无法有效遏制信息污染。
AI.research_question: 虚拟社区为何在应对一次灾难中的信息污染后，未能在后续灾难中有效沿用或调整相同的成功实践？
AI.motivation: 虚拟社区在灾难中是人们寻找可信信息的重要场所，但信息污染（信息过载、虚假或矛盾信息）严重阻碍了人们获取可信信息。令人困惑的是，一些虚拟社区在某次灾难中发展出了应对信息污染的有效做法，却在后续灾难中未能沿用或调整这些做法，这背后的原因值得深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织正念（organisational mindfulness）与组织失念（organisational mindlessness）理论。
AI.method: 纵向探索性跨案例研究。
AI.findings: 三个因素导致虚拟社区陷入失念状态，从而无法遏制信息污染：（i）组织遗忘（organisational forgetting），（ii）指责（blaming），（iii）社会分裂（social fracturing）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织正念/失念理论引入虚拟社区与灾难信息管理领域，揭示出虚拟社区在灾难情境下失念的三大成因机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟社区提供三条避免失念的实践建议：（i）将过去的成功经验编码并加以调整适应；（ii）监控指责话语并建立对权威的信任；（iii）避免无意义的争论并促进共享价值观。

title: Disclosure in the Shadow of Bankruptcy: From Reckoning to Reemergence
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business, University of Virginia - Darden School of Business and University of Southern California Gould School of Law

detail.title: Disclosure in the Shadow of Bankruptcy: From Reckoning to Reemergence
detail.abstract: For firms in financial distress, the choice of what and how much to disclose about their straits presents a challenge, since their counterparties' responses can have sharper consequences for their real operations and control. Forthright disclosure could facilitate survival through, e.g., recapitalization by reducing information asymmetry, or accelerate decline in a "self-fulfilling prophecy." But research to date provides little understanding of how such disclosure affects outcomes for non-bank firms. We measure how much distressed firms disclose about their financial straits using a large language model (LLM) in a process that is hallucination-free by construction, highly reproducible, and substantially more predictive than prior textual feature measures, within a sample of firms that are matched on ex ante bankruptcy risk and fundamentals. To address remaining endogeneity, we instrument firms' distress-year disclosures with their preestablished disclosure practices. We find that disclosure drives faster negative market reactions, customer pullback, tighter supplier credit, and deterioration in the capital-market conditions that could facilitate recapitalization, and hastens and increases the probability of bankruptcy filing. But after filing, once the bankruptcy court's powers are in place, the same prior disclosures facilitate smoother resolution. High-disclosure firms are valued more accurately upon entering bankruptcy, emerge faster, and are more likely to resolve through a Section 363 sale, consistent with disclosure reducing the valuation uncertainty that drives holdouts. We contribute by identifying how distress disclosure affects bankruptcy for non-bank firms, and tracing its impact through the resolution process, with an improved measurement approach.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型衡量财务困境企业的披露程度，发现更多披露会加速负面市场反应、客户收缩和破产，但进入破产程序后有助于更顺畅的资产清算和重组。
AI.research_question: 财务困境企业的披露行为如何影响其实际运营、破产概率及破产后重组结果？
AI.motivation: 困境企业的披露面临两难：坦诚披露可能通过减少信息不对称促进资本重组，但也可能引发"自我实现的预言"加速衰落。现有研究对非银行企业的披露影响缺乏了解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、自我实现预言理论、破产法下的估值不确定性理论。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLM）测量困境企业披露水平（无幻觉、可复现、预测力优于传统文本指标），结合倾向得分匹配控制内生性，并以企业预先存在的披露实践作为工具变量。
AI.findings: （1）披露加速负面市场反应、客户撤回、供应商收紧信贷及资本市场恶化；（2）增加并加速破产申请；（3）破产后，高披露企业估值更准确、重组更快，更可能通过Section 363销售完成清算。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了困境披露对非银行企业破产的双重影响机制——破产前加速恶化 vs. 破产后促进顺畅重组；以实证证据链接披露与破产法框架下的资产处置效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 为困境企业管理层提供披露策略指导，提示破产前谨慎披露但破产后坦诚披露的差异化价值；为监管者和债权人评估信息披露的后果提供实证依据。

title: Contextual factors influencing the performance of clinical preceptors: A scoping review protocol
affiliations: Universidad San Sebastian, Universidad San Sebastian, Universidad San Sebastian, Universidad San Sebastian and Universidad San Sebastian

detail.title: Contextual factors influencing the performance of clinical preceptors: A scoping review protocol
detail.abstract: The clinical preceptor plays a fundamental role in health professionals training. Their performance influences the acquisition of clinical competencies, the development of professional identity and the integration of ethical standards by students. Although interventions exist to strengthen preceptors' teaching competencies, there is a gap concerning the contextual factors that affect the transfer of these competencies into real clinical training settings. The aim of the present study is to describe contextual factors that influence the performance of clinical preceptors in health professions, explicitly documenting differences across health disciplines and by countries’ income levels. The review will follow JBI and PRISMA-ScR guidelines.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在系统梳理影响临床导师在健康专业中教学表现的情境因素，并分析不同健康学科和国家收入水平之间的差异，为优化导师培训干预措施提供依据。
AI.research_question: 影响健康专业临床导师表现的情境因素有哪些？这些因素在不同健康学科和国家收入水平之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 临床导师对健康专业学生的能力培养、职业身份发展和伦理标准融入至关重要。虽有针对导师教学能力的干预措施，但关于影响这些能力向真实临床培训环境转化的情境因素存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于JBI和PRISMA-ScR系统综述框架，涉及学习迁移理论、情境学习理论等。
AI.method: 系统范围综述，遵循JBI和PRISMA-ScR指南，明确记录不同健康学科和国家收入水平的差异。
AI.findings: 预期识别出影响临床导师表现的多层次情境因素（如组织支持、工作负荷、文化环境等），并发现不同学科及国家收入水平间的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了临床导师教学能力转化情境因素的理论空白，丰富了学习迁移和情境学习的应用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同国家和学科设计针对性的临床导师培训干预措施提供实证依据，优化健康专业人才培养质量。

title: Managerial Work in Tech Startups: Subjectivity and Politics of Cooperation

detail.title: Managerial Work in Tech Startups: Subjectivity and Politics of Cooperation

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by a SSHRC Joseph-Armand Bombardier CGS Doctoral Scholarship (#767-2020-1100)

detail.abstract: This article explores managerial labour as a form of political labour in relation to the concepts of bio-power and virtuosity. Based on my interviews with managerial workers in tech startups, I argue that immaterial and affective labour embodies crucial role in reproduction of workers' subjectivities as communicative, emotionally transparent, and cooperative. Virtuosity as performance of being in the presence of others and bio-power as a form of control over life are instrumental concepts in the theories of Paolo Virno and Maurizio Lazzarato. Virno's theorization of the general intellect which includes the codes and rules of capitalist social relations, and Lazzarato's description of contemporary workplaces as specially designed "worlds" for workers, reveal how contemporary workplaces are political terrains that enclose social relations and the potentialities of labour-power. I conclude that understanding affective and immaterial labour of managerial workers as political labour can expand the meaning and implications of these concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨管理劳动作为一种政治劳动形式，结合生命权力与技艺概念，通过对科技初创企业管理者的访谈，论证非物质劳动和情感劳动在再生产工人主体性（沟通性、情感透明性、合作性）中的关键作用。研究揭示了当代工作场所作为政治场域，封闭了社会关系和劳动潜能的本质。
AI.research_question: 管理劳动如何作为一种政治劳动形式，通过生命权力和技艺的概念来理解？管理者的情感劳动与非物质劳动在当代工作场所中如何塑造主体性？
AI.motivation: 传统管理劳动研究多聚焦于效率与控制，忽视了其政治性维度。本研究旨在通过Virno和Lazzarato的激进政治理论，重新审视管理劳动在当代资本主义工作场所中的政治意涵。
AI.theoretical_framework: Paolo Virno的生命权力（bio-power）与一般智力（general intellect）理论；Maurizio Lazzarato的技艺（virtuosity）概念及"设计世界"（designed worlds）理论；非物质劳动与情感劳动理论。
AI.method: 质性研究：对科技初创企业管理者的访谈。
AI.findings: 管理者的非物质劳动和情感劳动在再生产工人主体性中起核心作用，使工人成为沟通性、情感透明和合作性的主体。当代工作场所是精心设计的政治场域，通过封闭社会关系和劳动潜能来实现对生命的控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将管理劳动重新概念化为政治劳动，拓展了生命权力和技艺概念的含义与适用范畴；揭示了当代工作场所作为政治场域的理论深度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒管理者与被管理者认识到管理劳动的政治性本质，有助于批判性反思科技初创企业中的权力关系与主体塑造机制。

title: Load-Sensitive Fluid Policies for Network Revenue Management
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen,  and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

detail.title: Load-Sensitive Fluid Policies for Network Revenue Management
detail.abstract:
We study finite-capacity network revenue management policies that implement an ex-ante fluid LP through online randomized control. A natural question is whether one fluid-LP policy can produce a smooth performance certificate connecting capacity-independent worst-case constants with capacity-sensitive finite-instance guarantees that converge to one as capacities grow. We answer this question by introducing a load-sensitive one-resource envelope Γ(c, θ), defined as the worst-case approval probability of a c-unit resource under total offered load at most θc for θ ∈ [0, 1]. The envelope interpolates between light-load and full-load regimes. At θ = 1, it recovers the usual full-load one-resource OCRS/magician guarantee, while for smaller θ it captures the stronger marginal guarantees available after thinning. We characterize Γ(c, θ) through a Poisson-limit ODE and establish structural lower bounds that can be plugged into network-level guarantees.

We use this envelope to construct a load-sensitive fluid-LP perturbation policy. After applying a common thinning factor θ, each resource-wise controller is certified at its induced normalized load, which is at most θ, and a product is accepted only if all required resources approve. The resulting guarantee recovers the full-load resource-wise certificate 1-L/√(3+c_min) as the no-thinning endpoint, where L is the maximum number of resources consumed by any product and c min is the minimum resource capacity. Optimizing over the thinning factor yields a finite-capacity certificate at least 1/(4L-2), strictly improving the classical uniform 1/(4L) perturbation bound. Moreover, when c_min ≥ 3, the optimized guarantee strictly exceeds 1/(1+L) , an important benchmark for finite-instance NRM policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限容量网络收益管理中的流体LP在线随机控制策略，提出了一个负载敏感的单资源包络Γ(c, θ)，该包络在轻负载和满负载之间实现插值，并基于此构建了负载敏感的流体LP扰动策略，获得了优于经典均匀扰动界的有限容量保证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种流体LP策略，使其能够产生一种平滑的性能保证，连接容量无关的最坏情况常数与容量敏感且随容量增长收敛到1的有限实例保证？
AI.motivation: 现有流体LP策略要么提供容量无关的绝对最坏情况保证（如均匀1/(4L)扰动界），要么提供容量敏感但渐近的最优性保证，两者之间存在断层。需要一种策略既能应对有限容量场景，又能平滑过渡到渐近最优。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负载敏感单资源包络Γ(c, θ)：定义为在总供给负载不超过θc的条件下，c单位资源的最坏情况批准概率。该包络通过泊松极限ODE刻画，在θ=1时还原为满负载OCR/魔术师保证，在较小θ时捕捉经过稀疏化后更强的边际保证。
AI.method: 1. 提出并刻画负载敏感单资源包络Γ(c, θ)（通过泊松极限ODE）；2. 构建负载敏感流体LP扰动策略：先施加共同稀疏化因子θ，每个资源控制器在其诱导归一化负载（≤θ）下运行，产品需所有所需资源均批准才被接受；3. 优化稀疏化因子以获得最佳有限容量保证。
AI.findings: 1. 所提出策略恢复满负载资源证书1 - L/√(3+c_min)作为无稀疏化端点；2. 优化稀疏化因子后，获得至少1/(4L-2)的有限容量证书，严格优于经典均匀1/(4L)扰动界；3. 当c_min ≥ 3时，优化保证严格超过1/(1+L)这一有限实例NRM策略的重要基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提出负载敏感单资源包络Γ(c, θ)这一概念，连接了轻负载与满负载场景；2. 通过泊松极限ODE为包络提供了可计算的特征描述；3. 构建了负载敏感的流体LP扰动策略框架，填补了容量无关最坏情况保证与容量敏感渐近最优性之间的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为网络收益管理提供了可操作的有限容量策略，在资源容量有限的实际场景中具有更好的性能保证；2. 策略通过优化稀疏化因子实现了严格优于经典均匀扰动界的保证，提升了实际部署效果；3. 当最小容量c_min≥3时，策略保证超过1/(1+L)基准，具有实际应用价值。

title: Systematic Insights into Digital Transformation in Healthcare: A Comprehensive Review of Reviews
affiliations: Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna di Pisa and Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna

detail.title: Systematic Insights into Digital Transformation in Healthcare: A Comprehensive Review of Reviews

declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by Sant ’Anna School of Advanced Studies, in the framework of the Progetto di Interesse Nazionale (PRIN) - DIGITRANS-PAR: Drivers and impact of digital transformation of the Italian PA at the regional level (Prot. 2022RCSPF3). The views and opinions expressed are solely those of the authors.

detail.abstract: Digital transformation (DT) is reshaping how society addresses new challenges and opportunities (Kraus et al., 2021; Schiavone et al., 2021). The pandemic has accelerated DT in the public sector, ensuring the continued provision of services through non-physical means. DT is defined as “a process that aims to improve an entity by triggering significant changes to its properties through combinations of information, computing, communication, and connectivity technologies” (Vial, 2019). Recently, there has been a growing body of research on DT. While some has focused on the conceptual and terminological aspects of DT (Dal Mas et al., 2023), practical implications, particularly in the healthcare sector, remain underexplored. Given this shift and the emphasis on new paradigms, there is a pressing need to systematize and organize the existing literature on DT in healthcare. This is essential to understand the uses and applications of digital health initiatives that are transforming and redesigning healthcare processes. In order to fill this gap, this study employs a review of reviews and examines the practical implications and adaptation of digital transformation in healthcare by analyzing the current state of reviews on DT inhealthcare, in the context of the European Union. This study aims at answering the following key questions: (i) What is the current stage of research in the field of DT in healthcare reviews? (ii) What are the types of innovations, units of analysis, and practical applications DT in the healthcare sector? To address these questions, we conducted an extensive review of reviews by performing a literature search to gather all relevant literature on our topic. We then organized our findings into relevant categories, providing a snapshot of the major trends, gaps, and barriers in the practical applications of DT that are transforming the healthcare sector. A review of reviews was conducted and presented following PRISMA methodology. The databases Scopus and Web of Science were searched for original publications in English between the 1st of January 2010 and 30th of May 2024. Studies were included for title and abstract screening if they were review article published in English discussing digital transformation in healthcare. A categorization of selected article was determined on several attributes, namely: innovation type; unit of analysis; sub-unit of analysis; contextual framework; gaps; barriers; dimension under study. The search yielded a total of 1319 articles. After duplicate removal and title/abstract screening, at the actual stage 16 review studies were included, meanwhile, another 49 articles are still being reviewed by the authors to determine whether to include them in the study. Of the included papers, four reported on the use of digital health technology among practitioners and two reported on the use of digital health technology among patients. Three studies analyzed the role of digital health literacy in the digital health transformation. Other studies analyzed the implementation of electronic patient records in hospitals or the implementation of specific devices in healthcare. Our preliminary findings revealed both promising implications and noticeable gaps. Many studies have analyzed the role of practitioners and their involvement in new models of health service deployment. Patients are also well-represented in research, highlighting their fundamental role in DT initiatives. However, not all stakeholders within the healthcare system, such as nurses, are adequately represented. This creates opportunities for further research and the need for deeper analysis. An emphasis on digital methods for learning and training healthcare staff has emerged, highlighting the importance of developing innovative approaches to address the new challenges arising from the diffusion of DT. At the current stage of research, this study aims to contribute to scholars, practitioners, and managers alike. For scholars, it offers a valuable systematization of existing research, outlining the current state of the field and paving the way for future studies. Practitioners can gain clear insights into practical examples of digital innovations in healthcare, enhancing their understanding of digital technology trends and their application in real-world contexts. Finally, the study provides managers with summarized directions and suggestions for future practical tools, aiding in the design of organizational change to ensure the successful implementation of digital transformation initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对2010-2024年间欧洲医疗保健领域数字化转型的综述文献进行系统性回顾，揭示了该领域的研究现状、主要趋势、空白与障碍，初步发现16篇综述重点关注了从业者、患者和数字健康素养的作用，但护士等群体代表性不足，为未来研究提供了方向。
AI.research_question: (i) 医疗保健数字化转型综述领域的研究当前处于什么阶段？(ii) 医疗保健领域的数字化转型涉及哪些类型的创新、分析单元及实际应用？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字化转型在医疗保健领域的实践意义重大，但相关文献的系统化整理不足，尤其是对实际应用和适应性的深入研究匮乏，因此有必要对这一领域的综述进行系统梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型定义（Vial, 2019）；PRISMA系统综述方法；基于创新类型、分析单元、子分析单元、情境框架、空白、障碍、研究维度等多维分类框架。
AI.method: 采用"综述的综述"方法，检索Scopus和Web of Science数据库2010年1月1日至2024年5月30日的英文综述文献，经过去重和筛选后纳入16篇综述，另有49篇在审。
AI.findings: 初步发现：4篇关注从业者使用数字健康技术；2篇关注患者使用情况；3篇分析数字健康素养；其余关注电子病历或特定设备实施。从业者和患者均有较好代表性，但护士等利益相关者代表性不足；数字健康培训与学习成为新兴重点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为学者系统化梳理了现有研究现状，勾勒出医疗保健数字化转型综述领域的整体图景，识别了研究空白和未来方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助从业者了解数字创新在医疗保健中的具体应用实例和趋势；为管理者提供未来实践工具的设计方向和变革管理建议，以推动数字化转型成功实施。

title: The Impact of Interest Rates on U.S. Housing Prices: Evidence from the Pre- and Post-COVID-19 Periods

detail.title: The Impact of Interest Rates on U.S. Housing Prices: Evidence from the Pre- and Post-COVID-19 Periods

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, professional, or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this study. The author has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, human subjects, personal health information, or animal research. The research is based on publicly available data, published literature, and secondary sources. Therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between U.S. interest rates and housing prices from January 2015 to December 2024, focusing on whether the COVID-19 pandemic altered this relationship structurally. Using 120 monthly observations from the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) and the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA), an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) multiple regression model is estimated with the seasonally adjusted Housing Price Index (HPI) as the dependent variable, the Federal Funds Rate as the primary explanatory variable, and a binary COVID-19 dummy variable that captures the structural shift beginning in March 2020. The results show a statistically significant positive coefficient on the Federal Funds Rate (β1 = +16.974, p < 0.001). After controlling for the COVID-19 structural break, a 1-percentage-point increase in the Federal Funds Rate is associated with a 16.97-point increase in the HPI. This positive relationship reflects the co-trending of rising rates and prices during the economic expansion of 2015 to 2019, underscoring the importance of controlling for structural breaks in time-series housing data. The COVID-19 dummy variable is also strongly positive and significant (β2 = +103.867, p < 0.001), confirming a major structural upward shift in housing prices following the onset of the pandemic. Together, these two variables explain 93.4% of the variation in U.S. housing prices over the sample period (R 2 = 0.9341, F = 828.67, p < 0.001). These findings add to the growing empirical literature on monetary policy, structural shocks, and housing markets, and they offer evidence relevant to current debates on housing affordability in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2015年1月至2024年12月的月度数据，通过OLS多元回归模型发现美国联邦基金利率与房价指数呈显著正相关（β₁=+16.974），同时COVID-19疫情带来了显著的结构性向上偏移（β₂=+103.867），两个变量共同解释房价变动的93.4%。
AI.research_question: 美国利率与房价之间的关系如何？COVID-19疫情是否改变了这一关系的结构性特征？
AI.motivation: 已有文献对利率与房价关系存在争议，且疫情作为重大外生冲击可能改变了利率与房价之间的结构关系，作者希望通过实证检验加以澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策的利率传导机制；结构性断点（structural break）理论；时间序列住房市场分析框架。
AI.method: 采用2015年1月至2024年12月共120个月度观测值，数据来源为FRED和FHFA；使用季节调整后的HPI作为因变量，联邦基金利率为主要解释变量，并引入COVID-19二元虚拟变量捕捉2020年3月开始的结构性变化；估计方法为普通最小二乘法（OLS）多元回归。
AI.findings: 联邦基金利率系数显著为正（β₁=+16.974, p<0.001），利率每上升1个百分点，HPI上升约16.97点；COVID-19虚拟变量显著为正（β₂=+103.867, p<0.001），确认疫情后房价出现结构性大幅上移；模型R²=0.9341，F=828.67，解释力强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币政策与住房市场的实证文献增添了新证据，强调了在时间序列住房数据中控制结构性断点（如疫情）的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前美国住房可负担性政策辩论提供了实证依据，有助于理解疫情后房价飙升的驱动因素。

title: Faith Leaders as First Responders: Countering COVID-19 Sectarian Misinformation Through Interfaith Risk Communication in Pakistan - A Practitioner's Design Case Study, Situated in International Crisis Communication Practice

detail.title: Faith Leaders as First Responders: Countering COVID-19 Sectarian Misinformation Through Interfaith Risk Communication in Pakistan - A Practitioner's Design Case Study, Situated in International Crisis Communication Practice
detail.abstract: A Note on Scope This paper analyses the design of a rapid-response USAID/DAI grant activity, "Bringing Communities and Groups Together on COVID-19," which I personally conceived and managed as DAI's point of contact under the Azm-e-Pakistan (AeP) programme in April-May 2020. The analysis draws on the original grant agreement, which specifies the intervention's design, partnership structure, and theory of change in detail. As with my related work on this programme, this paper analyses intervention design against international crisis communication practice; it does not claim independently evaluated outcome data beyond what the design documents specify as intended.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者亲身管理的USAID/DAI快速响应赠款活动“Bringing Communities and Groups Together on COVID-19”，分析了该干预措施的设计，并与国际危机沟通实践进行了对比，但未提供独立评估的结果数据。
AI.research_question: 该快速响应赠款活动的干预设计如何与国际危机沟通实践相匹配？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间需要快速响应的社区沟通干预，作者作为项目管理者，希望从设计层面对该活动进行系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际危机沟通实践理论
AI.method: 基于原始赠款协议的设计文件分析，包括干预设计、伙伴结构、变革理论，并与国际危机沟通实践进行对照分析。
AI.findings: 文章未提供独立评估的结果数据，仅说明干预设计与国际危机沟通实践的匹配情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 将危机沟通理论应用于快速响应赠款活动的设计分析，验证理论在实践中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为类似快速响应人道主义援助项目提供设计参考，展示如何基于理论框架设计危机沟通干预措施。

title: When Systems Break: Statistical and Evolutionary Approaches to Systemic Transformation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: When Systems Break: Statistical and Evolutionary Approaches to Systemic Transformation
detail.abstract: Contemporary complexity frameworks-including self-organized criticality, early-warning signals, complex adaptive systems, NK-landscapes, and informational synergetics-treat crisis triggers as atomized, structureless, and memoryless perturbations defined solely by magnitude. This article demonstrates that this foundational assumption creates a systemic explanatory gap, leaving the specificity, asymmetric scaling, and directional determination of individual transformations systematically unanswered. To resolve this limitation, this study introduces an alternative paradigm based on the theory of Concentrative Causality. This approach reconceives the trigger as a historically structured entity co-evolved with systemic vulnerabilities within a shared macro-historical process. The article provides a conceptual formalization of this relational framework, replacing the orthodox assumption of stochastic independence with a conditional probability model of topological fit. Ultimately, this reorientation shifts the analytical focus from the aggregate epidemiology of crisis populations to the precise causal anatomy of singular systemic events.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了当代复杂性框架将危机触发因素视为原子化、无结构、无记忆的扰动，并基于"集中因果性"理论提出替代范式，将触发因素重新概念化为与系统脆弱性共同演化的历史结构化实体，用拓扑拟合的条件概率模型取代随机独立假设，将分析焦点从危机总体的聚合流行病学转向单一系统性事件的精确因果解剖。
AI.research_question: 如何克服当代复杂性框架中危机触发因素被视为无结构、无记忆扰动的根本性缺陷，从而解释特定性、非对称缩放和方向性决定等系统性未解答的问题？
AI.motivation: 当代复杂性框架（自组织临界性、早期预警信号、复杂适应系统、NK景观、信息协同论）将危机触发因素视为仅由量级定义的原子化、无结构、无记忆扰动，这一根本假设导致了系统性的解释空白，无法回答特定转化事件的特定性、非对称缩放和方向性决定问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集中因果性理论（Concentrative Causality）；拓扑拟合的条件概率模型；历史结构化实体与系统脆弱性共同演化的宏观历史过程框架。
AI.method: 概念形式化（conceptual formalization），提出替代正统随机独立假设的拓扑拟合条件概率模型。
AI.findings: 当代复杂性框架对危机触发因素的原子化假设存在系统性解释空白；集中因果性范式能够重新概念化触发因素为与系统脆弱性共同演化的历史结构化实体；拓扑拟合的条件概率模型可替代随机独立假设，将分析焦点转向单一系统性事件的精确因果解剖。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入集中因果性理论到危机分析领域，挑战了复杂性科学中关于触发因素的主流假设；提出了拓扑拟合的条件概率模型作为替代性形式化框架；将分析范式从危机总体的流行病学转向单一事件的因果解剖。
AI.practical_contributions: 为危机预测和管理提供了更精细的因果分析工具，使研究者能够超越仅基于扰动量级的预警，转向理解触发因素与系统脆弱性之间的具体关系结构。

title: Kenya's Fiscal Pressure and the Productivity of Infrastructure
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Kenya's Fiscal Pressure and the Productivity of Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none

detail.abstract: This paper reads the World Bank's July 2026 Kenya Economic Update: Sustaining Macroeconomic Gains, Advancing Fiscal Reforms against Amonya's Infrastructure Productivity: The Metabolism of Capital Formation. The World Bank presents an economy that has preserved important elements of macroeconomic stability while facing weakening growth, persistent revenue shortfalls, rising expenditure pressures, high debt-service costs, growing dependence on domestic borrowing and limited creation of productive formal employment. The conflict in the Middle East has intensified fuel, food and external-account pressures, but the deeper vulnerabilities are domestic and structural. Amonya's framework extends the diagnosis by asking how Kenya converts gross fixed capital formation into economic capability. Using the concepts of scaling appetite, metabolic response and metabolic pathology, the paper distinguishes construction activity from long-term transformation. Kenya has historically shown a strong appetite for capital formation and a meaningful association between investment and growth. Yet the current fiscal position suggests that debt obligations, maintenance demands and recurrent spending may now be advancing faster than the productive and revenue gains generated by recent investment. The comparison reveals a problem of infrastructure coupling: roads, energy, finance, firms, skills, maintenance, markets and public revenue do not always move as one system. The paper concludes that Kenya's next phase of infrastructure policy must be judged by conversion. Capital formation must enlarge productive capacity, formal employment, resilience and fiscal strength. The central task is therefore to improve the metabolism through which infrastructure becomes economic life.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比世界银行《2026年7月肯尼亚经济更新》与Amonya的《基础设施生产率：资本形成的代谢》，揭示了肯尼亚在宏观经济稳定表象下的深层结构性脆弱性。核心问题在于：资本形成未能有效转化为经济能力，基础设施各要素（道路、能源、金融、企业、技能、维护、市场和税收）未能作为一个系统协同运转。论文提出，基础设施政策必须以"转化率"为评判标准，通过改善"代谢"过程，使资本形成真正扩大生产能力、正式就业、经济韧性与财政实力。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚如何将固定资产形成总额转化为经济能力？基础设施投资与长期经济转型之间存在怎样的"耦合"问题？
AI.motivation: 世界银行的报告揭示了肯尼亚在保持宏观经济稳定的同时面临增长疲软、收入短缺、支出压力上升、债务成本高企等矛盾。而现有分析未能解释为什么大量的资本形成未能带来相应的生产性扩张和财政收入增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: Amonya的"基础设施生产率"框架，核心概念包括：规模食欲（scaling appetite）、代谢反应（metabolic response）、代谢病理（metabolic pathology），以及基础设施耦合（infrastructure coupling）。
AI.method: 文献比较分析，将世界银行的国家经济报告与Amonya的理论框架进行对照解读。
AI.findings: 肯尼亚在资本形成方面具有强烈的"规模食欲"，投资与增长之间也存在有意义的统计关联。但当前的财政状况表明，债务偿还、维护需求和经常性支出的增长速度快于近期投资所创造的生产力和收入增长。基础设施各子系统未能协同演进，导致资本形成未能有效转化为经济能力。
AI.theory_contributions: "代谢"视角将基础设施投资从单纯的工程或财政问题重新定义为经济生态系统的转化问题。区分了"建设活动"与"长期转型"，揭示了资本形成规模与转化效率之间的概念鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及类似发展中国家提供了新的政策评估标准：不应仅看投资规模或增长率，而应衡量投资向生产能力、正式就业、经济韧性和财政实力的转化效率。强调基础设施各要素的系统性协同是政策成功的关键。

title: The Class Pay Gap in Public Accounting: Does Socioeconomic Background Matter?
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business, Stockholm School of Economics, Stockholm School of Economics and Stockholm School of Economics

detail.title: The Class Pay Gap in Public Accounting: Does Socioeconomic Background Matter?

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study has been evaluated and approved by the Regional Ethical Review Board in Stockholm, Sweden (Dnr 2023-07508-02).

detail.abstract: We examine whether there is a class pay gap in the auditing profession. We explore this question using 20 years of unique administrative data in Sweden, an egalitarian society and top-ranked meritocracy. We document a significant income disparity across all professional levels within Big 6 firms between auditors from higher-and lower-socioeconomic backgrounds (SEB), with the gap peaking at the partner level. We explore two potential underlying mechanisms: differential performance and workplace segregation. While we find no evidence that high-SEB auditors deliver higher quality audits, we find robust evidence of substantial workplace segregation. Higher-SEB CPAs manage larger portfolios and more prestigious clients (indicating horizontal segregation), and are more likely to qualify as CPAs, reach partnership, and join Big 6 boards (indicating vertical segregation). Beyond these disparities in economic and professional achievements, class-based inequality also appears to take a toll on mental health: we find that auditors from lower-SEB backgrounds are significantly more likely to be diagnosed with depression, suggesting that the psychological burdens of the profession fall disproportionately on those from less privileged origins. Collectively, these findings challenge the meritocratic narrative of public accounting and serve as a call to action for audit firms to ensure equal opportunity and address systemic class-based inequalities.

AI.tldr: 本文利用瑞典20年的行政数据，发现审计行业中存在显著的阶层薪酬差距，高社会经济背景的审计师在职业晋升、客户组合等方面均占优势，且低背景审计师患抑郁症风险更高，挑战了审计行业的精英论叙事。
AI.research_question: 审计行业是否存在阶层薪酬差距？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 审计行业常被视为精英制（meritocracy）的典范，但阶层背景是否在薪酬与职业成功中扮演隐性角色尚不清楚。作者希望用客观数据检验这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会分层理论、精英制与阶层再生产理论、职场隔离（水平隔离与垂直隔离）理论。
AI.method: 利用瑞典20年的行政数据（覆盖Big 6事务所），采用定量分析方法，检验阶层背景（SEB）与收入、晋升、客户组合、审计质量及心理健康之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）高SEB审计师在所有职业层级收入均更高，合伙人层级差距最大；（2）未发现高SEB审计师审计质量更高；（3）存在显著职场隔离：高SEB审计师管理更大客户组合和更优质客户（水平隔离），更易获得CPA资格、晋升为合伙人及进入Big 6董事会（垂直隔离）；（4）低SEB审计师患抑郁症概率显著更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了审计行业作为纯粹精英制的理论假设，揭示阶层背景在专业服务业中持续发挥作用，丰富了社会分层与职场不平等的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计事务所提供实证依据，敦促其反思招聘、晋升与资源配置中的隐性阶层偏见，推动建立更公平的行业环境。

title: LIA: A Scope-Contract Control Plane for Surgical, Auditable Contract Editing

detail.title: LIA: A Scope-Contract Control Plane for Surgical, Auditable Contract Editing
detail.abstract: AI contract-editing systems often replace whole clauses where expert redlines use smaller, distributed tracked changes. We call this descriptive difference the surgicality gap. It may arise from model judgment, the editing harness, or both. This paper presents LIA, a proposed control-plane architecture, and a prospective protocol for estimating the harness contribution while preserving rubric-defined sufficiency. LIA adapts computer-assisted-translation concepts—segmentation, precedent memory, match-rate leverage, and banded routing—and applies the narrower security principle that a model may propose an action while code outside the model determines whether the action is permitted. The architecture uses a hierarchical document map with versioned structural anchors and cross-revision reconciliation; a leverage pass that separates reuse similarity from policy-based action eligibility; hard-veto features for predefined high-risk differences; scope contracts enforced at the only document-write boundary; run-scoped provisional memory; and a fresh-session whole-document audit that cannot retrieve the current run’s unapproved outputs. Its intended guarantee is limited and mechanical: edits that violate an expressible scope rule are rejected before document mutation. It does not guarantee legal correctness, complete detection of meaning reversal, or immunity from prompt injection. We contribute the architecture, a scope-contract schema and enforcement model, provenance-aware diagnostics, and a paired two-harness evaluation design with falsifiable morphology and rubric-defined sufficiency hypotheses. LIA is under active implementation, and this paper reports no experimental results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIA架构，借鉴计算机辅助翻译概念，通过控制平面设计缩小AI合同编辑中的"手术性差距"（大段替换 vs. 精确保留修改），在模型外部强制执行范围约束，确保编辑符合预设规则但不过度承诺法律正确性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种控制平面架构，在AI合同编辑系统中缩小"手术性差距"（即模型倾向于整段替换，而专家使用分布式修订），同时保持基于规则定义的充分性？
AI.motivation: 现有AI合同编辑系统往往以整段替换方式修改文本，与人类专家使用分散、精确保留的修订方式存在差距（手术性差距）。这一差距可能源于模型判断、编辑框架或两者共同作用。需要分离出编辑框架的贡献，并确保编辑符合预设的充分性规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算机辅助翻译（CAT）概念（分段、先例记忆、匹配率杠杆、分带路由）；最小安全原则（模型可提议动作，但由模型外部代码判断动作是否被允许）。
AI.method: 概念设计与架构提案。包括：分层文档映射与版本化结构锚点、跨修订协调；杠杆通道（分离复用相似性与策略行为资格）；硬否决特征（预定义高风险差异）；范围合约（仅在文档写入边界强制执行）；运行范围临时内存；全新会话全文档审计（无法检索当前运行的未批准输出）。
AI.findings: 本文无实验结果（LIA正在积极实现中）。提出的主要贡献包括：LIA架构、范围合约模式与执行模型、溯源感知诊断工具、配对双框架评估设计（含可证伪形态学假设和基于规则定义的充分性假设）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将计算机辅助翻译的概念框架（分段、先例记忆、匹配率杠杆等）系统性地迁移到合同编辑领域；提出将模型提议与行为许可分离的最小安全原则应用于LLM编辑系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可执行的架构设计以减少AI合同编辑的"手术性差距"；设计范围合约模式以在规则层面控制编辑行为；提供溯源感知诊断和可验证的评估设计框架。

title: Racing Against Automation: Dynamic Incentives When AI Can Preempt the Human
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management, The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics,  and

detail.title: Racing Against Automation: Dynamic Incentives When AI Can Preempt the Human
detail.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), and AI agents in particular, are reshaping innovation by enabling autonomous search, evaluation, and iteration toward new discoveries. Yet human researchers remain essential in novel and poorly structured settings. A human agent may be more productive but privately chooses effort, creating a moral hazard problem; the AI agent requires no incentives but is costly to operate and can preempt the human agent’s success. This raises a natural question: When, if ever, should the firm race the AI agent against the human agent rather than rely on either one alone? We develop a continuous-time principal–agent model in which a principal draws on both a human agent and an independent AI agent in the search for innovation. We establish that when the AI agent is not cost-effective, the principal never deploys it and relies on human-alone search. In contrast, when the AI agent is cost-effective, a natural conjecture is that the principal should always keep it active as a rival, since it can accelerate breakthroughs and, by threatening to preempt the human agent, strengthen the human agent’s incentives. We show that this intuition can fail: persistent AI rivalry may lower both the human agent’s and the principal’s payoffs relative to human-alone search, so aggressive competition can hurt both parties. Instead, the optimal contract may begin with human-alone search, transition to a human–AI race, and finally switch to autonomous AI search if no breakthrough occurs. Relative to a human–human benchmark, deploying the AI agent alongside the human can also align the preferences of the principal and the focal human agent over whether competition should come from an AI agent or another human. In an extension with imperfect AI-generated outcomes, the optimal contract features time-varying verification. In sum, AI rivalry is a double-edged sword: it can accelerate discovery and discipline human effort, but deploying it too early crowds out valuable human-alone search, so firms may optimally delay it even when the AI is productive.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业在创新搜索中应如何配置人类代理人（存在道德风险）和AI代理人（无激励问题但有成本）。最优策略并非简单地将AI作为持续竞争对手，而是分阶段切换：先人类独立搜索，再人类与AI竞速，最后若未突破则转为AI自主搜索。过早引入AI竞争反而会降低双方收益。
AI.research_question: 在创新搜索中，企业何时应让AI代理与人类代理"竞速"，而非仅依赖其中一方？
AI.motivation: AI代理（尤其是AI agent）正在重塑创新过程，但人类在结构模糊的探索中仍不可或缺。人类存在道德风险（需激励），AI无激励问题但成本高且可能抢占人类成果。这一权衡引出了最优配置问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间委托-代理模型（principal–agent model），包含一个委托人（企业）、一个人类代理人（存在道德风险、私下选择努力）和一个独立的AI代理人（无需激励但有运营成本）。
AI.method: 连续时间博弈论建模与最优契约分析，包含人类-人类基准比较和AI产出不完美的扩展分析。
AI.findings: （1）当AI成本不经济时，企业不应部署AI；（2）即使AI成本经济，持续保持AI竞争可能同时降低人类代理人和委托人的收益；（3）最优契约是分阶段的：先人类独立搜索，再过渡到人类-AI竞速，最后若未突破则切换到AI自主搜索；（4）相对于人类-人类竞争，AI的引入可以调整委托人与代理人对竞争来源的偏好；（5）AI结果不完美时，最优契约涉及时变验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI竞争的双刃剑效应：既能加速发现、约束人类努力，但过早引入会挤出有价值的人类独立搜索；建立了将AI竞争纳入动态激励契约的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供AI部署的时序决策指南：不应一味追求AI竞争，而应根据创新阶段动态调整人类与AI的协作/竞争关系，最优策略可能分阶段切换。

title: The Luxury Tax of Being Unique: Reputational Leadership Through the Lens of Hate

detail.title: The Luxury Tax of Being Unique: Reputational Leadership Through the Lens of Hate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest regarding this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval is not applicable for this theoretical study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

keywords: the luxury tax of being unique

detail.abstract: This essay examines a paradox of contemporary public leadership in the age of the internet and artificial intelligence: institutional invisibility is equivalent to professional non-existence, while public visibility systematically provokes destructive criticism. The work introduces a dichotomy between the "free bonus" and the "luxury tax of being unique," proposing a microeconomic model and a derived Uniqueness Tax Index (UTI) as a practical self-diagnostic tool for public leaders.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了互联网与人工智能时代公共领导力面临的一个悖论：制度性 invisibility 等同于职业上的不存在，而公开 visibility 又系统性地引发破坏性批评。研究引入了“免费红利”与“独特性的奢侈税”之间的二分法，提出了一个微观经济模型以及作为公共领导者实用自我诊断工具的独特性税收指数（UTI）。
AI.research_question: 在互联网和人工智能时代，公共领导者如何应对“不露面即不存在，露面即遭批评”的悖论？
AI.motivation: 解释当代公共领导力中 visibility 与 invisibility 之间的结构性矛盾，并为其提供可操作的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观经济模型；独特性税收指数（UTI）；“免费红利”与“独特性奢侈税”二分法。
AI.method: 理论推演与模型构建，提出 UTI 作为自我诊断工具。
AI.findings: 公共领导者在追求可见性时面临系统性批评成本，即“独特性的奢侈税”；而保持制度性不可见则意味着职业性消亡。UTI 可为领导者量化这种成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济学中的税收/成本概念引入公共领导力研究，提出一个新的二分法框架和可量化的 UTI 指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共领导者提供一个自我诊断工具（UTI），帮助其在 visibility 与 invisibility 之间做出更理性的策略选择。
